abstract: This Unquestionably, Internet of Things (IoT) stands as a novel and more prominent internet based communicating architecture for future applications includes smart cities, smart transportations, smart grid etc. However the most concentrated and research aspect of IoT is security provision to the devices connected and the data transmitting through it. Since the devices communicate through internet in IoT, there exist number of adversaries/ attacks which tries to compromise the network. Herein this leads into the loss of confidentiality, integrity, availability and trust of the devices and network resources. This paper presents a brief survey on the possible attacks happening in different layers of IoT and also presents the possible mitigation schemes to reduce the effect of attacks.

articleTitle: Design, Simulation and Implementation of UWB Wearable Antenna
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Design of circular patch antenna with diamond slot is proposed and used for medical application. The antenna is designed to operate in resonant frequency of 4.8GHz which is made to cover and function in the frequency range from 2GHz to 7GHz. The cloth fabric materials are used as substrate. Three different types of cloth fabric material are used namely, jeans, cotton and cordura considering its dielectric constant. Ansoft HFSS software tool is used for designing and simulation. Optimization of the wearable antenna design is done using finite element method using HFSS. The designed wearable antenna is placed in close to human body for investigation. The parameters considered for evaluating the results are efficiency, VSWR, SAR (Specific-absorption rate) and S-parameter. The designed antenna prototype is fabricated and tested for three different fabric material; jeans, cotton and cordura. The results show good performance for jeans material. Comparative study between simulated and measured result is done.

articleTitle: Handwritten Signature Verification using TensorFlow
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Many different methods are being tested by researchers for the correct identification of original signatures from forged ones. The objective of the research reported in this paper is to set up a new system that can be used reliably for the recognition of signatures in legal documents and cheques used in banks. The proposed system was designed using TensorFlow, which is used widely for deep learning. The Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) used in the designed system is capable of accurately verifying the characters unique to the original signature. The effectiveness of the system is measured using two parameters which are False Rejection Rates (FRR) and False Acceptance Rate (FAR). The proposed system showed FAR and FRR values as 5 percent and 5 percent respectively while testing and the overall accuracy of the system is 90 percent.

articleTitle: Intelligent Ambulance Management System with A* Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Road traffic management has become a large problem in contemporary society. Where the ambulance gets blocked in the traffic load and has to wait for some minutes to hours to clear the road. This may cause loss of live because of lack of treatment at proper time. To overcome this problem and to save many lives, a model proposed in this project which provides the functionality that, the ambulance can reach the patient through finding the shortest path. The shortest path finding is done by using A* algorithm. The traffic junctions along the shortest path are giving priority for ambulance manually. The traffic congestion is also considering here. The route map will be dynamic as per the traffic load. This scenario is done by creating a data base. The message regarding accident is provide to the ambulance by server after getting the location of the accident site. The location of vehicle will automatically upload to the server at the time of accident. The shortest path is upload to the dashboard that is provided for the ambulance. So the ambulance can reach the accident location speedily. Keywords-Automatic accident detection, A* algorithm, Shortest path

articleTitle: YouTube Data Analysis using MapReduce on Hadoop
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: There is a tremendous growth and popularity of YouTube. It has the potential to touch billions of lives globally as the no. of YouTube users is growing day by day. YouTube, owned by Google, a video streaming site which has billions of users and 400 hours of videos are being uploaded every minute. Almost billions of videos are watched on YouTube every single day, generating mammoth amount of data daily. Since YouTube data is generally in unstructured form, there is an increased demand to store, process and analyze such real time Big Data. YouTubers can analyze their own channel performance with YouTube Analytics. But one can not analyze other channels. The proposed system uses MapReduce framework of Hadoop for processing and analyzing real time YouTube datasets. It will help in discovering how competitors are performing on YouTube. One can easily identify what content works best on YouTube. These analytical data can be represented in demographic form which can be used by individuals and organizations for making immediate actionable decisions so as to gain competitive advantages.

articleTitle: Detection of Heart Disease Applying Fuzzy Logics and Its Comparison with Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Now a days, healthcare and its related issues are very common worldwide. And the most common complication is related to heart. These days Computer technology holds an essential importance in the fields of medical science including diagnosis, performance of illness, suitable supervising of patients etc. The objective of my paper is to provide a fuzzy skilled system for forecast of cardiovascular syndrome. We had used seven input attributes for our proposed system. The Data sets are taken from UCI (Machine learning repository). Seven important attributes are used and one output is processed. We get our result from the system design which is obtained from the fuzzy based algorithm. The seven inputs attributes are: Age, Blood pressure, Cholesterol, Heart Rate, Blood sugar, E.C.G, Thallium scan. In our projected paper all the inputs range, its membership function and its graphs are properly shown. In the later section we had successfully tested and compared our result using testing data sets performance with other algorithm which is neural networks. A proposed new and innovative Graphic user interface (GUI) for our proposed system which can compare our results with both these algorithms and display the results is also given.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimization for Efficient Home Energy Management System using Differential Evolution Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Home Energy Management System (HEMS) has a considerable influence to control the selected household appliances and keep the total energy consumption below a certain pre-specified limit. The objective of this research is to develop an algorithm for the optimal scheduling of the domestic appliances to realize minimum energy consumption as well as optimum comfort for the users. For the optimal scheduling of the domestic appliances, Multi-Objective Differential Evolution (MODE) algorithm based on HEMS was developed. The optimization method consists of DE algorithm linked with two conflicting objective functions subjected to the operating limits of the appliances. The two conflicting objectives are the electrical energy cost and customer comfort. For the energy cost assessment, Real Time Pricing (RTP) scheme is employed. The developed optimization algorithms were applied for determining the optimal schedule of the domestic appliances in the test system.

articleTitle: Engagement Detection using Video-based Estimation of Head Movement
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: We explore how computer vision methods can be utilized to identify engagement where person in video will be doing writing activity similar to the student doing writing activity in front of monitor. Person will be provided engagement annotations concurrently during the writing activity. We utilized one of computer vision method to extract features from videos that is local binary patterns in three orthogonal planes (LBP-TOP). These highlights were utilized as a part of managed learning for detection. KNN (K nearest neighbour) classifier was used to find classifying accuracy. Conventional camera was used to capture persons head movement activity to further create feature vector to produce best results.

articleTitle: FIRE SAFETY AND ALERTING SYSTEM IN RAILWAYS
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In earlier systems during summer and high temperature seasons faulty detection of temperature sensors will occur due to high heat meanwhile gas sensor that had been used also considers the external environment smoke in the air as compartment. These wrong signals from the sensors to the controller will cause unwanted enabling of the buzzer, wrong information to the locomotive pilot, unwanted chaos, and delay of trains. This involves confusion to the total railway system. The proposed method provides longer communication using GSM and enables the rescuing methodology while fire accidents in the train by utilizing gas/smoke sensors integrated with LM35 along with automated fire suppression systems. In this method there are many suction ducts will be present at each partition of the train compartment along with CO2 fire extinguisher for fire suppression. If the temperature is greater than 80°C and the output value from the gas and the smoke sensor senses the smoke then the Arduino gives the command to enable buzzer, alerting signal to GSM network, fire extinguisher. The automatic braking system is enabled which will be utilized to split the fired compartment from the unaffected compartments, else there is no action will be taken.

articleTitle: Power Quality Improvement Using Hybrid Filters
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The power quality problems would reduce the life time and efficiency of the equipment. The highly dependent end user equipment will be affected by quality of power delivered. But the various external and internal factors have an effect on the eminence of power distributed to the end user. They are like voltage and frequency variations, faults, harmonics, outages etc. Thus, to improve the performance of end consumer equipment and the system these problems should be minimized or completely cancelled out. The main affect caused by these problems is the existence of harmonics (both current and voltage harmonics). The solution to overthrow these problems is to filter out the harmonics. In this paper a hybrid filter of shunt active filter and shunt passive filter configuration is used. And also the paper confers the hysteresis control strategy to control the filter in such a way that the harmonics are reduced. The proposed control strategy and overall power quality improvement technique is simulated in MATLAB SIMULINK and the results are presented.

articleTitle: Implementation of Hungarian Algorithm to obtain Optimal Solution for Travelling Salesman Problem
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This paper illustrates and gives a complete picture of the TSP using Hungarian algorithm. The problem will notify the salesman with the order of places in which he has to travel, when the salesman has to travel to some places within districts of Karnataka (ex, Haveri, Bangalore, Hubli), the algorithm using assignment model method of Operation Research and gives the salesman the order in which he has to visit the districts. This will give us the exact distance and a optimal solution rather than a feasible solution. This paper also dipicts the importance of Hungarian algorithm in solving a typical Traveling Salesman Problem.

articleTitle: RTL Power Estimation: Early Design Cycle Approach for SoC Power Sign-Off
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: VLSI industry is driven by three main factors. They are Power, delay and area. In 180nm and 90nm days, IP (Intellectual Property) and SoC (System on Chip) designs were less complicated because of lower transistor density. As technology is miniaturizing, more number of transistors are packed within the same area. This further has impact on packaging and cooling requirements of the chip. Thus there exists necessity to estimate the power early in the design space exploration. Power evaluation is done immediately after RTL (Register Transfer Level) design is available so that packaging and cooling requirements are validated. Added advantage of estimating power early in the ASIC (Application Specific Integrated Circuits) flow is that the details of power distribution across various IPs in SoC can be analyzed. By proper analysis of power distribution, suitable power optimization techniques can be exercised to save power. All these factors motivate to estimate power after RTL design stage. In this paper, RTL power estimation flow for industrial design using Joules tool of Cadence is developed. RTL power numbers are estimated for different IPs and SoC maximum collate power is evaluated. RTL power numbers are validated by correlating the power numbers obtained after P & R stage by Voltus tool from Cadence. There will be expected mismatch in the power numbers between RTL and P & R stages, as RTL stage doesn't contain information pertaining to wires and interconnects. Results verify that RTL power numbers are within 5.007% accuracy loss with respect to P & R stage power numbers.

articleTitle: Bandwidth and Gain Enhancement of Microstrip Array Antenna using Stacked Layer of Parasitic Patches
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The bandwidth and gain improvement of microstrip array antenna using stacked layer of parasitic patches and air as an efficient substrate is proposed. An array of 2x2 microstrip patches is suspended on air. This increases the efficiency as well as gain of the antenna. Suspending it on air also increases the height of antenna thereby enhances the bandwidth. Further a layer of parasitic patches is introduced above the main array to improve the overall bandwidth of the antenna. The S11 is less than −9.5 dB over 3.87 – 5.54 GHz. This implies to 1.67 GHz about 31.5% impedance bandwidth for operating frequency 5.3 GHz. The maximum gain of 13.26 dB with gain variation of less than 2 dB over 4.26 - 5.8 GHz is obtained. This gives 1.54 GHz of gain bandwidth. This antenna offers Front to Back lobe ratio (FBR) = 20.42 dB which is >20 dB. It covers 4 - 5.54 GHz frequencies of satellite communication C-Band. The simulation is performed on ANSYS HFSS software. The measured results of the prototype are in agreement with simulation results.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Detect Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This paper targets on the early detection of leukaemia and is made possible using recently emerged technologies in image processing wherein different algorithms and methodologies can be applied for processing the medical images digitally. The upgradations in the optical devices such as microscopes and digital cameras has directed to a blue-ribbon input dataset. Firstly, the patient's blood smear image is subjected to pre-processing. Secondly, detect the white blood cells, segment the lymphocytes, identify the lymphoblasts and count them. The aim here is to develop a foundation for a system which detects the harmful cancer cells, allowing a person to diagnose such hematic conditions at an early phase. The proposed system can be extended to a prototype of a handy machine in the near future. Ultimately, the motto of this proposal is to promote the principle- “prevention is better than cure”.

articleTitle: Wireless Sensors Network for Environmental Radiation Monitoring using IOT
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Due to various activities in nuclear power plants such as radiation leakage, nuclear fuel recycling and other activities, low level radiation causes various health issues such as infertility, weakened immunity. When a nuclear radiations are leaked to an open environment the atmospheric parameters like temperature, smoke, humidity, sound and carbon monoxide level increases. In this paper, minimal effort, Linux based freely available Things Speak Web server, which is turned to a system situated on the Internet of Things (IoT), is used to monitor the above mentioned parameters. By monitoring these parameters, we are detecting the radiation leakage. The changes of all these parameters are measured by sensors and display of those data can be done by Things Speak Web server.

articleTitle: Power Amplifier Input Back-Off Optimization in Ideally Predistorted OFDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Input back-off optimization in ideally predistorted OFDM systems is considered, in terms of maximizing the signal-to-distortion ratio. An approximate closed form expression for the input back-off is derived, providing achievement over a recently published state-of-the-art iterative optimization procedure. The back-off is shown to be entirely determined by the quotient between squared amplifier saturation voltage and the power of the channel or system noise. The theoretical findings are illustrated by numerical examples of practical relevance. Further, it is shown that maximizing the signal-to-distortion ratio is, in this particular case, equivalent to minimizing the normalized mean-squared-error.

articleTitle: A 2.4GHz CMOS Double Balanced Down Conversion Gilbert Cell Mixer Design Using 180nm Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This paper presents the modified design of an analog CMOS down conversion double balanced Gilbert cell frequency mixer for RF receiver front end application operating at 2.4 GHz input RF frequency and 1.8V power supply. Mixers are frequency translation circuit i.e it translates incoming RF signal to an intermediate frequency (IF), by multiplying with local oscillator signal (LO). The mixer has conversion gain of 9.6dB and linearity analysis parameter with 1-dB compression point is about -4dBm and noise figure of 9dB for 180nm technology. Spectre simulator of Cadence is considered for simulation of mixer schematic. The local oscillator frequency of the proposed mixer is 2.41 GHz. Virtuoso layout editor is used for layout design.

articleTitle: Assistive Technology: An IoT based device for Physically Challenged People and Hospital Inmates
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In a world where we have Google Assistant, Siri, Cortana, Alexa and other voice assistive technologies, making the lives of normal people easier, we do not have any sort of such technology for people who are physically challenged or the temporary hospital inmates. Census report of 2011 (2016 updated) reveal that, 2.21% of the total Indian population are disabled. Putting that in numbers, 2.68 Crore people fall into the category. Hospital inmates too do not have an assistance device to inform their needs to the nurse in charge. In this paper, we present an assistive technology in the form of an embedded system solely focused to help physically challenged people and hospital patients communicate with their assistant for assistance, with just a push of a button. The user will have to press a button as per his/her need. Upon pressing, the message is wirelessly transmitted to outside the room and is displayed on the assistant's TV. The same message will also be sent to the assistant in the form of a SMS in case he/she is not present in the vicinity of the TV, thereby ensuring that the services are not missed at any cost. The system uses ARM controller at the transmitter/user end and a Raspberry Pi at the receiver/assistant end. The wireless communication is achieved using zig-bee protocol.

articleTitle: Convenient and Secured Voting System
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: E-voting systems are becoming popular with the widespread use of computers and embedded systems. Security is the vital issue should be considered in such systems. This paper is dealing with the convenient and secured voting machine, which is useful to the voters and society. Two major features of this voting machine is to make the voting system convenient and secured by using few hardware and software resources. Most of people will fail to vote because the voting station where the person was registered to vote might be very far and due to some of the security issues many votes have been wasted. All such problems can be solved by our proposed voting system. We have designed voting system using RFID tag, RFID reader as authentication purpose, and voting machine is designed using microcontroller and other input and output devices and GSM technology. Here in this proposed system people belonging to any place or city can be able to vote from any place or city which is nearby to them. All the voting information is sent to one central station via GSM so that the data obtained will be secured here even if it lost in respective stations. Hence voting efficiency can be increased so that the eminent and good leader can be elected for the better India.

articleTitle: Gain and Bandwidth Boosting of Transimpedance Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In many useful systems, accuracy is desired. The accuracy is directly related to the amplifier open loop gain. Thus, it is necessary to have higher gain for better accuracy and performance of the amplifier. In transimpedance amplifier, many techniques have been employed to increase its gain. Conventional techniques used flipped voltage follower to increase the gain of the amplifier. In this work, a transimpedance amplifier using flipped voltage follower, a DTMOS technique has been used to increase gain. The basic idea behind the proposed work is to enhance the transconductance of the MOSFET transistor with the help of biasing technique via gate and bulk terminals. Since the ampifiers open loop gain is directly proportional to the transconductance of the MOSFET, the gain increases by increase in the transconductance. The bandwidth is also proportional to the increased transconductance, thus the bandwidth also increases.An additional improved bandwidth is also obtained. A gain of 16.84dB and a bandwidth as high as 8.09GHz is obtained by using DTMOS technique. It can be concluded that the proposed technique is very effective in increasing the gain and bandwidth of the transimpedance amplifier.

articleTitle: Partition Based Strategic Node Placement and Efficient Communication Method for WSN
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Today, the Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) is having a very vast area in the various field of research and development. The main focus of WSN is to intensify the existence of WSN by decreasing the energy depletion. The lifetime of WSN is depended on many factors like energy depletion, transmission range, communication range and sensing range. But mainly, the lifetime of WSN is highly dependent on energy utilization. So we have to reduce the wastage of energy of sensor nodes. There is a way that can save the energy of nodes by placing them in an elegant manner. In this paper, we propose an Advanced Specific Node Formation (ASNF) strategy and communication method for WSNs. This strategy is performed in four rounds. In the first round, the sensor nodes are positioned in the circular pattern in inner region. In the second round, we positioned the nodes in hexagonal and pentagonal patterns called hexa circular node formation and penta circular node formation respectvely in outer region. The partition of whole area in distinct pattern is performed in third round. After that, the selection of CHs in respective areas takes place in fourth round. The selection of a Cluster Heads (CHs) can be based on many parameters like residual energy and the distance from the nodes etc. Particularly, under this strategy, we select the CHs with the premises of optimum energy. In this way, the whole area will be covered with least nodes. With these nodes, we can aggregate the information. So, with the help of this strategy, we can assess higher proficiency for network lifetime and energy depletion. The simulation results shows higher proficiency of energy depletion, dead node and delay etc.

articleTitle: Enhancement of Underwater Deblurred Images using Gradient Guided Filter
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Underwater imagery is extremely essential owing to the eminence of imagery which captures underwater. While capturing such imagery, excellence of descriptions corrupt owing to various factor similar to wrinkle within water, lack of accessibility of radiance, organic material dissolve in water as well as images capture as of a very little distance. Hence it should be process before applying it on this imagery. Existing weighted guided filter be able to lessen halo artifacts but it fail to maintain boundaries. In our paper, we propose to overcome this drawback by using gradient domain guided image filter which will improve the excellence, restrain the blare, and conserve the boundaries into imagery. Tentative effect shows improved performance, evaluated to former schemes, mainly close to the boundaries.

articleTitle: Verification of Interconnection IP for Automobile Applications using System Verilog and UVM
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: As the SoC complexity is increasing day by day to incorporate more functionalities, verification is also becoming complex and time consuming. To enable faster verification, a structured methodology is required. Universal Verification Methodology (UVM) is one such method consisting of a library of base classes based on SystemVerilog which can be extended for the required functionality. In this paper, an interconnection soft Intellectual Property (IP) used in automobile applications for incorporating complex functionalities is verified efficiently using UVM. The IP is highly programmable and parameterized for wide range of products. The basic metrics of verification, namely, code coverage and functional coverage are achieved in an efficient manner using the methodology. The code coverage was found to be 80.3% and functional coverage was found to be 82.08%.

articleTitle: Bearing fault diagnosis using TQWT based Entropy features
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The rolling element bearing plays a significant role in any mechanical manufacturing industry. Bearing fault diagnosis using vibration signal processing has been a vital subject of study over past many years. In present work, an automated bearing fault diagnosis technique using Tunable Q-factor Wavelet Transform based time-frequency decomposition is proposed. Proposed technique is carried out in three methodological steps. Firstly, vibration signals are decomposed into time-frequency coefficients using Tunable Q-factor Wavelet Transform. Further, entropy based features are computed from decomposed time-frequency coefficients as features of vibration signals in second step. In the third step, classification of vibration signals is performed using three soft computing methods viz. Support Vector Machine, Artificial Neural Network and Random Forest Tree classifier. Classification results revealed that presented methodology has potential to design and develop a real time bearing fault diagnosis system. In present work, classification accuracy of 100% is achieved using Support Vector Machine Classifier.

articleTitle: Sliding Mode Controller (SMC) Governed Speed Control of DC Motor
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The sliding mode controller is one of best tool to analyze the second order dynamic system. This paper provides comparative study of control techniques of DC motor under loaded condition. The design of sliding mode control is based on the variable structure system (VSS).the trajectory path of the system depend on the control signal of SMC controller. The main objective of the controller is to reduce the settling time and peak overshoot of the system. Particularly, in robotics DC motor is used and it's very essential to control the speed under loaded condition. The SMC gives best performance in Linear and nonlinear of system. Stability of the system and performance of dc motor under load condition can easily analyzed by using sliding mode nonlinear control. The proposed system model simulate and developed in MATLAB.

articleTitle: Power Grid Strategies for Minimum IR Drop In Multi Power Domain Design
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Semiconductor companies are stressing more on the implementation of low power methodology, reduction in die size and low technology process for improvement in overall margins. Power grid delivers the power & voltages required from location of pad to all device components in the design. Hence, designing of power grid should be in such a way, that grid must be able to supply power to all components in IC within the acceptable forte to escape problems like failure of various components, decreasing speed of operation and improve IR drop. Efficient power planning is one of the key concerns of modern SoC designs. In multi voltage designs, providing power to the different power domains is challenging. Every power domain requires independent local power supply and grid structure and some designs may even have a separate power pad. The objective is to analyze various power grid structures for achieving best static and dynamic IR drop using the least routing resources in multi power domain designs.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Surface Mounted Permanent Magnet Synchronous Machine under Different Rated Speeds
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Permanent magnet synchronous machine (PMSM) are slowly replacing induction machines from the domain of variable speed drives owing to its high torque /weight ratio, power density and efficiency. In this paper, an analysis over surface mount permanent magnet synchronous machine (SPMSM) is carried out with respect to the performance indices of torque ripple and power factor at different rated speeds. As surface mount synchronous machine is not a self-starting machine, v/f closed loop control strategy is implemented to start the machine from standstill to rated speed, then switched to back EMF based sensor-less field oriented control (FOC) for its continuous run. In further simulation and analysis of performance indices over SPMSM is carried out for different rated speed in MATLAB - Simulink platform.

articleTitle: Copy Move Forgery using Hu's Invariant Moments and Log-Polar Transformations
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: With the increase in interchange of data, there is a growing necessity of security. Considering the volumes of digital data that is transmitted, they are in need to be secure. Among the many forms of tampering possible, one widespread technique is Copy Move Forgery (CMF). This forgery occurs when parts of the image are copied and duplicated elsewhere in the same image. There exist a number of algorithms to detect such a forgery in which the primary step involved is feature extraction. The feature extraction techniques employed must have lesser time and space complexity involved for an efficient and faster processing of media. Also, majority of the existing state of art techniques often tend to falsely match similar genuine objects as copy move forged during the detection process. To tackle these problems, the paper proposes a novel algorithm that recognizes a unique approach of using Hu's Invariant Moments and Log-polar Transformations to reduce feature vector dimension to one feature per block simultaneously detecting CMF among genuine similar objects in an image. The qualitative and quantitative results obtained demonstrate the effectiveness of this algorithm.

articleTitle: Data Acquisition and Actuation for Aquaponics using IoT
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) is a network of interconnected devices ranging from sensors to actuators in real time on the internet. This new age technology is revolutionary in terms of reducing to almost replacing the human intervention and need into day to day mundane activities by replacing humans with this interconnected network. This network has the great capability of scalability and on the run connectivity. The network is similar to an ad-hoc network but with a difference of the internet as its communication backbone. It has a wide range of applications in the fields of healthcare, automobile, construction, education, hospitality, corporate sector etc. We are using IoT in the field of agriculture, aquaponics in specific. Aquaponics is an emerging field of agriculture which is a hybrid between hydroponics (soil-less farming) and aquaculture (fish-farming). Aquaponic farming removes a lot of the disadvantages present in the individual parent techniques. In this farming method freshwater fish and plants are cultivated in a closed loop ecosystem where they depend on each other to grow. Aquaponics by itself is not perfect, it has its own set of problems. It is a simulation of a natural ecosystem where there are many factors involved in running and managing the farm and a drastic change could cause farm failure. This results in a massive knowledge barrier for this farming technique. Constant monitoring of the different parameters gives us an insight as to how the farm is performing. We propose a completely flexible and scalable control system for aquaponic farming. This control system will monitor various environmental parameters and over time it will be able to manipulate the functioning of the farm to provide a completely automated system.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of Application of Power Electronic Converters in Fuel Cell Hybrid Electric Vehicles: A Review
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The growth of Renewable based power industry is increasing rapidly. Renewable based power industry is basically two types: Grid connected system and Standalone system. In this paper the discussion about various power electronics system and fuel cell application. As current density increase, fuel cell voltage level also get reduces because of varies type of loss component in fuel cell. The maintenance of large size of fuel cell is tough without proper technique and mechanism. In this way to improve the quality, performance and efficiency of renewable based power industry, the integrated system i.e. store energy and higher level research technology are mainly focused in this paper.

Author Keywords: Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cell Hybrid Electric Vehicle

articleTitle: Conditional Battery Charging in Solar PV Based System
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Insolation, temperature and array voltage largely affect the electric power received from the solar arrays and battery voltage, state of charge (SOC) and charging current affects the battery operation and its lifetime. Therefore it is needful to control the operating points by looking into both the battery parameters and the maximum power operating points from the solar array. The objective of this paper is to introduce additional control along with the maximum power point tracking (MPPT) control so as the power drawn from the solar panel can be adapted in a way to charge the battery as per the standard charging mechanism. The controller thus developed can be applied to the power processing units that are provided in appliances connected directly to the PV system. The simulation results of the buck converter with the proposed control strategy are successfully brought about by using MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach using Big Data Analytics to Improve the Crop Yield in Precision Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Agriculture is the main work field in India. Farming industry adopts less innovative technology compared to other industries. Information and Communication Technologies provides simple and cost effective techniques for farmers to enable precision agriculture. The work propose a state of the art model in agriculture field which will guide the rural farmers to use Information and Communication technologies (ICT) in agriculture fields. Big data analytics is used to improve the crop yield. It can be customized for precision agriculture to improve the quality of crops which improves the overall production rate.

articleTitle: Retracted: Identification of Efficient Features for Detection of diabetes through Iris patterns
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Iridodiagnosis is one of the diagnostic strategies in Naturopathy that relies upon changes in Iris for diagnosing disease conditions it's an alternative diagnostic technique using which several diseases are detected through the Iris patterns, colors, and other characteristics. More than 62 million individuals in India are currently diagnosed with_Type 2Diabetes Mellitus [1]. We have developed a non-invasive tool which apart from detecting diabetes can also identify pre-diabetes and objectively ascertain subjective I risk to develop diabetes in the recent future._This project aims to develop a quantitative non-invasive tool for detection of diabetes. Early diagnosis of diabetes might facilitate taking appropriate life- style interventions in preventing diabetes_Images of Iris from diabetic and non-diabetic individuals were obtained using Iris scope and areas in the iris representing liver area_were isolated through segmentation,_extraction of spatial features from GLCM and the features such as contrast, correlation, homogeneity, dissimilarity, difference variance and entropy were identified as the most efficient for classification.

articleTitle: Development of a Functional Testing System for Test Automation and Statistical Analysis of the behavior of health care device used to treat Deep Vein Thrombosis
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Deep Vein Thrombosis (DVT) is a health condition caused by a blood clot formed in a vein lying deep below the skin. It is treated by increasing the venous blood flow in the affected limb. The DVT health care device achieves this by mimicking the body's natural muscle contractions using a pressure controlled air bag placed on the affected limb. Functional testing of such portable devices is important to detect any deviations from the intended behavior and to collect data for statistical analysis. In this study, a functional testing system is developed to extensively test a DVT health care device and collect data for statistical analysis to predict its behaviour. The testing requires simulating a certain sequence of the end user's actions, which is automated by the testing system. The test is initiated using a mobile app which communicates with the testing system using Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE). The testing system then starts the DVT device, feeds in different pressure values through BLE communication and observes its behavior by collecting pressure sensor readings at various time intervals. Based on the medically acceptable range for peak and stabilized pressure values, the test is declared as successful. The test results for all the DVT devices are communicated to the mobile app. This test automation considerably reduces the time and effort to test all the manufactured DVT devices. Data analysis tools are used to perform descriptive statistical analysis that provides a summary of the collected data and its visualization. Inferential statistical analysis is performed to estimate the behavior of the manufactured DVT devices during long operational hours. The inferences are validated by performing parametric statistical tests on the collected data. Statistical data analysis is done using Python.

articleTitle: A Low Power Hybrid CMOS-Memristor based Ring Oscillator for Hardware Security Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This paper proposes implementation of a low power hybrid CMOS-Memristor Ring Oscillator (RO), with a higher randomness value compared to existing technologies. A comparison of conventional CMOS inverter, memristive load inverter and a two memristor inverter based RO is done in terms of frequency of oscillation, power consumption and the randomness in oscillation frequency. Memristors because of their non-volatile nature, compatibility with CMOS technology and low area and power consumption are being widely used for low power VLSI design. This concept is well supported with the simulation results. Randomness for the proposed two memristor based RO is found to be 51.16μ which is 2.065x and 1.596x of the CMOS based RO and memristive load based RO respectively. The power consumption of the circuit is highly improved. Maximum power of the design is reported as 270μW which is 86.4% and 35.25% lesser than that of the CMOS and memristive load based designs respectively.

articleTitle: Data Mining: Consumer Behavior Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The whole world is overloaded via innumerable data like scientific data, financial data, mathematical data, geographic data, employment data, and other various kinds of data. Manually analyzing or summarizing this data is impractical, the reason behind this is incredible increment in data in this generation of information and network distribution. Objective of Data mining is to extract the required information, instruction, and pattern from a huge quantity of information and data by the help of multiple tools and techniques. Therefore, it is very essential to select significant techniques to mine the database, because of the several other varieties of data in data base and every data has their individual mining techniques. In this research paper we are going to analyze the consumer behavior, that can help us not only in the retailer market/industry but we can use it in the medical, online shopping etc. Here we are talking about consumer behavior analysis, so we are taking market industry data. Data mining techniques are most conventional and sufficient technique for behavior analysis. Main target of this paper is to recognize behavior of a consumer, his/her psychological condition, consumer's decision making during purchase and then finding how much suitable methods of data mining are applied to enhance the conventional method. Here association rules are deployed to mine out required rules for customer applied in purchased data in retailers shop or organization. After that the required rule can be used for further required filed line online shopping, medical field etc.

articleTitle: Frequency Based Power Flow Control In Distributed Generation
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: For the islanded smart grid, renewable energy is considered as the large power generation, and among all the RES Solar PV generation is cost effective and is widely used. So the generated power from Solar is a major factor that influences the grid stability. The imbalance between power generations and power consumptions is happened regularly, and it leads to continuous frequency variation in the grid. So this paper mainly focuses on the control of power flow from solar to grid based on the change in grid frequency that is if the load demand in the grid is greater than that of power generation, grid frequency gets decreased below 50Hz and based on this change in frequency the extra power demand is supplied from solar to the grid to make grid frequency back to 50Hz. The power transfer from Solar PV to grid is controlled by controlling the angle between inverter voltage and grid voltage that is the phase angle or the power angle. This proposed control is achieved by SPWM technique and Fuzzy logic controller. The system simulation is realized by using MATLAB/ Simulink software.

articleTitle: Security of Passengers and their Belongings in Railways by Solar Power
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In Indian Railways everyday some of crime activity is happening. Security of passengers and their belongings is of paramount importance for Indian Railways. In case of any untoward incident of crime against passengers and their belongings matter can be reported to railway police station. In the proposed work, the working model of train based on solar power and automatic control by micro controller is implemented. By using solar power, environmental pollution can be reduced and train fuel consumption can reduced. If any mischievous activity happens against the passengers, they can send information to nearest railway police station by pressing a button located at each compartment. By using GPS we can track the current location of the train

articleTitle: Sliding Mode Load Frequency Control for Two Area Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Power system involves utilities interconnected in it. Power is shared between the utilities using tie-lines. The interconnection speed of power system is measured in frequency. When generation and load mismatch the frequency deviates. Large frequency deviation leads to the overload and failure in power grid. Therefore the regulation goal is, balancing the load frequency error. Until now various concepts over the designing of the load frequency controller are applied. This paper presents the developed sliding mode load frequency controller. The proposed method is effective compared to other and can ensure the system stable. The proposed sliding mode load frequency controller can achieve good performance in reference to the results.

articleTitle: Single Ended Schmitt Trigger based 13T Static Random Access Memory using FinFETs
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Advancement in CMOS technology has made the Static Random Access Memory (SRAM) design to be very demanding. The designers face several challenges in increasing the performance by improving the read stability, write ability and leakage power. The inverter characteristic degrades the performance with low supply voltage. The proposed Memory cell uses Schmitt-trigger based inverters to develop SRAM that increases stability and decreases the leakage power. For any dual-bit scheme based SRAM, an amount of power is wasted in form of charging or discharging the bit-lines. The proposed design has 70.02% and 14.17% increased read stability and write ability and it also dissipates 44.45% less leakage power when compared to the first Schmitt trigger based SRAM at 1 V of supply voltage.

articleTitle: OMAP-L138 LCDK Development Kit
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Low cost and low power consumption processor play a vital role in the field of Digital Signal Processing (DSP). The OMAP-L138 development kit which is low cost, low power consumption, ease and speed, with a wide variety of applications includes Digital signal processing, Image processing and video processing. This paper represents the basic introduction to OMAP-L138 processor and quick procedural steps for real time and non-real time implementations with a set of programs. The real time experiments are based on audio in the applications of audio loopback, delay and echo. Whereas the non-real time experiments are generation of a sine wave, low pass and high pass filter.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Approaches for Online Algorithm Training Experience
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Online algorithm plays a vital role in many applications like pattern matching, graphing and others. Unlike traditional algorithm, online algorithm processes the request without the knowledge of the future input data. This presents the various influencing domains required for any researcher to start with online algorithm. Machine learning is one of the major domains where the importance of data and its significance in dynamic and unsupervised learning is concentrated. This paper also presents the analysis of various features of data and the basic analysis techniques for graph based online algorithm.

articleTitle: Disaster Management Using Vehicle Assist Resilient Network System
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: After any disasters, the area can be out of contact with the outer world because of the severe damages in the existing communication medium. Meanwhile, high demand for communication to the disaster affected area will arise to collect various information's related to the impact of disaster and losses and for providing various rescue and evacuation instructions. Using the disaster management system the people and rescuers can manage and share various types of information such as evacuation instruction, level of damage, damaged areas, location information, and supply or demand details etc. The system is established on a locally and quickly established Wi-Fi or WiMAX network environment. The system is completely an internet independent one.

articleTitle: Trust Evaluation Based on Reward Points for Alerts in VANET
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: VANET is an ad hoc network which is highly dynamic with rapidly changing network topology. Information related to safety or infotainment in form of packets are the basic type of message that is exchanged within the network. Managing the trust of the vehicles is an efficient way to instantly verify both the message and its sender. In this paper, we propose a trust evaluation scheme where the trust for each node is computed by a trusted authority and this trust information is used as a proof that the message or the sender can be trusted.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Localization Technique in Underwater Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Underwater Sensor Networks (UWSN) is emerging technology that enables timely and effective exploring and monitoring of world under the surface of the water. It enables a wide range of applications like environmental monitoring, ocean sampling networks, mine reconnaissance, disaster prevention and distributed tactile surveillance. The most important advantage of underwater sensor network is the underwater sensor nodes are small and less expensive which are capable of communicating with one another using acoustic signal. Underwater sensor network removes large and expensive equipment used in ocean monitoring. In UWSN, localization of sensor node is a major problem. Localization is mostly used for presentation of the collected data, tracking the location of underwater nodes, underwater target's location detection and a group of node's motion coordination. Localization generally requires object with known location or distance and angle measurement between these known nodes and the object to the unknown nodes. The position of sensor node is predicted by using the reference of the position of neighbour nodes which are having static or mobile behaviour. Accurate prediction of location and the localization technique is appropriate for UWSNs. This paper reviews various recent localization techniques used in underwater sensor network and compares them. Based on coverage and localization accuracy, the fault resilient localization technique performs better compared to other techniques.

articleTitle: A Compact Hept-band Slot Antenna for Wireless Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: A compact hept-band slot antenna for multiband wireless application is presented. The antenna consists of a flower-shaped slot in the radiating circular patch and a rectangular slot at the ground plane. The antenna has a dimension of 0.25λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">L</sub>× 0.25λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">L</sub>× 0.01λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">L</sub>at the lower band of 2.56 GHz. The proposed configuration operates at 2.56, 4.54, 5.41, 7.12, 7.75, 8.08 and 9.64 GHz with S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub><; -10dB bandwidth of about 70 MHz (2.53-2.60 GHz), 30 MHz (4.52-4.55 GHz), 40 MHz (5.39-5.43 GHz), 140 MHz (7.05-7.19 GHz), 530 MHz (7.59-8.22 GHz) and 170 MHz (9.55-9.72 GHz). The entire simulation of the antenna is carried out on HFSS v.13.0 simulator using FEM method.

articleTitle: The Multi Language Audio Compiler with Video Help
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Today's world looking for programmers who write programs without errors. But as we are human beings we may make mistakes. Students of computer science and engineering it is must to know the languages like C, C++, Java to get placements and challenging feature for student is to write error free code. Bachelor of Technology or Bachelor of Engineering programmes in India for undergraduate computer science and engineering students in their curriculum introduced C programming and Data structures, C++, Object Oriented Programming through Java as a compulsory subjects. Many students facing a problem while doing laboratory programs or laboratory exercises such that make many errors during programming. Here in this paper author proposing multi language audio with video help which will guide the students while doing the laboratory programmes. Multi language audio compiler will identify predefined statements of different languages like C, C++, and Java and inform the students by audio messages so that students can prevent errors occurring easily if students not able to understand audio messages then with video help of programming language constructs they can prevent errors occurring. Multi-language Compiler means which support programming languages like C, C++, Java,. Net. The author proposed a solution to prevent errors during programming with video help.

articleTitle: Single Image Super ResolutionUSingDeep Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The process of obtaining high resolution image from the low resolution image available is called Single Image Super Resolution (SISR). But the issue is that many regions in the obtained high resolution image are not as clearly visible as in the actual low resolution image. So our aim is to achieve high resolution image from available low resolution image with all details intact. There are few models which have been successful in achieving this; however, there is a trade-off between obtaining results with high values of standard measurement parameters (psnr, ssim etc) and results which appear clear and realistic. So we propose a model based on Deep Convolutional Neural Networks which is capable of achieving results which have good values of standard measurement parameters and are visually clear and realistic.

articleTitle: Static Low-Power 17T True Single Phase Clocking Flip-Flop Based on Logic Structure Optimization
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Flip flops (FFs) are the fundamental storage components abundantly used in digital system designs, which involves pipelining structures and modules built by FFs. The FFs contribute a major amount to total power consumption and significant amount to chip area of the digital system. So, there is a need for low power and low area FF designs. In this paper, a fully static very-low power 17- transistor True Single Phase Clocking (TSPC) flip-flop is proposed. The logic structure of Proposed TSPC FF is of master- slave type in which master stage is formed by static CMOS logic and slave is formed by a mixed combination of static CMOS logic and complementary pass transistor logic. The Proposed TSPC FF circuit is fully static because no internal nodes are in floating state during the operation which actually prevents leakage power dissipation. The proposed TSPC FF is designed by optimizing 19-transistor Logic Structure Reduction Flip Flop (LRFF) with respect to area and power consumption, but without compromising the functionality of the FF. The design of three FFs namely Transmission Gate Based Flip Flop (TGFF), LRFF and Proposed TSPC FF are implemented and simulated using gpdk45nm technology library with supply voltage V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">DD</sub> of 1V and clock frequency of 500MH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">z</sub> in cadence virtuoso tool. Pre-layout simulation results indicates that the proposed TSPC FF shows an improvement in power delay product (PDP) up to 67.32% and 21.58% compared to that of TGFF and LRFF respectively at 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> data switching activity. The number of transistors required to design proposed TSPC FF is reduced by seven and two compared to that of TGFF and LRFF respectively.

articleTitle: FPGA Detection of glaucoma eye disease in humans
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The Glaucoma disease is supposed to be one of the deadliest eye diseases in the world & if this is not treated properly might lead to permanent blindness. As the disease has not symptoms that externally, it is detected to loss of vison at sides. The slow progressive degeneration of ganglion cells in retina and axons, is categorized as Glaucoma, this results optic nerve head (ONH) having a distinct manifestation, usually called cupping. Here the area of the cup increases which causes the loss of side vision. This is diagnosed by experienced ophthalmologists, which is an exhaustive process. In this context, we are using watershed for automatic detection of eyes affected with glaucoma using image processing filtering & transformation techniques and implement the same on hardware using an FPGA.

articleTitle: Module design for monitoring the health of CT Machine's Rotating frame
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This paper demonstrates a module design which is capable to detecting all sorts of faults in the rotating frame of CT Machine. The The rotating frame is the heart of CT machine. The rotating frame is controlled by FPGA and drive's firmware. Continuous monitoring of the system is required for optimal operation. The system consists of entities like drive, motor and FPGA. These entities are communicating via CANopen protocol. Drive is an intelligent sub-system which controls the operation of motor. The firmware model is capable of finding faulty parts and unhealthy connections of rotating frame defective part is diagnosed by continuous parameter monitoring of following parameters like current in drive, peak current in drive, velocity of rotating frame, dc bus voltage, max motor current, heat sink temperature, ambient temperature, motor temperature. Signal interpretation of faulty connections given by FPGA and drive has been made. These interpretation of messages drives a state machine based on which meaning has been interpreted. Messages of faulty parts and connections have been displayed in the digital script which can be monitored in real-time by the team. The design makes the job of the service engineer easier and becomes less time consuming. It makes system user-friendly. The digital script about the issue has been sent to the server which gives fast troubleshooting with less number of replacement of the parts.

articleTitle: Common Data Model for Healthcare data
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: There is a huge volume of data made openly available to the masses on Government data sites such as the www.data.gov.in. However, it is very difficult to make sense between data from two different data sets or different domains. As a result a lot of time is spent in just collecting and linking this data from various sources before it can be put to use. A potential solution to this problem is using a Common Data Model. A Common Data Model is a data silo or warehouse which can accommodate any data from any source in one pre-designed format. In this paper we discuss an ETL process that allows users to remodel and store data, and a proposed schema for a Common Data Model which will house this transformed data under one roof. We also perform our own analysis on the proposed data model for a particular use-case; state-wise statistics of data related to pregnancy in India. Thus we prove that the common data model is able to integrate data from different sources and facilitate cross domain analysis and linking of data.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Signal Conditioning Card for Load Cell
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In industry environment the most commonly measured parameters are strain, force and pressure. The most commonly used sensing devices in order to measure above parameter are strain gauge load cell. There are different types of strain gauges are available resistive, capacitive, piezoelectric transducer type and semiconductor type strain gauges are there. Strain gauge sensor is a passive transducer that converts the mechanical elongation, displacement produced due to force or load acting on them into change in resistance, capacitance and inductance value. They are low impedance devices, they required exact excitation (input) value because there signal (output) will be in milli volt range, the typical load cell will be having four strain gauges which are all arranged in Wheatstone bridge manner with impedance of 270 ohms or 350 ohms. The load cell will be having six wires, two of them for “excitation” voltage, two of them is for giving “signal” and two of them are for “sens”, in order to maintain the excitation voltage as the output from load cell are in milli volt range they need to be conditioned for next stages with low cost, high precision, reliability, amplification and noise reduction capability. The low output signal after amplification is to be send to filtering, analog to digital conversion then the output is programmable controlled by microcontroller ATmega 168p then they again converted to analog signal using digital to analog converter (DAC) because the next level will be of analog component in industry that is programmable logic controller (PLC) in order to display the weight and to send the packed things to suitable place.

articleTitle: Dynamic Phasor-Based Modeling of a Single-Phase Photovoltaic System
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This paper develops an analytical model for single phase photovoltaic system. The model contains LCL filter and proportional resonance controller for inverter current control. The analytical model is based on dynamic phasor approach. In this technique the system quantities are described as fourier coefficients. These fourier coefficients are varying with time. The model built using dynamic phasor technique has ability to analysis the small signals. The model is built in MATLAB and it finds to be more accurate and allow large step size simulation resulting in less computational time.

articleTitle: Fractional Order Controller and their Application to Current Control Technique for SPV Grid Interconnection
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Linear and Non-Linear controller shows their best performance under different power quality conditions. However, under sub transient condition these controller shows sluggish performance. This paper introduces the application of Fractional order [FO] controller in real world power system phenomena. FO-controller based on proportional integral control action was used here for grid interconnection of inverter. Different power quality issues such as Real & Reactive Power exchange between renewable source and grid have been presented here. Matlab Simulink model was developed for a real-world grid connected model in order to check the robustness of the controller. A comparison between the PI controller and FO-PI controller was presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Automated Feedback Generation System using Facial Emotion Recognition
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Advertisements have come a long way from textual content to graphical content and finally video advertising, where an advertisement video is played before or while the user is viewing any content of his interest on the internet. Feedback for an advertisement or a service is essential for its improvement which is often taken from the user through forms. Instead of asking to fill up forms, here facial expression analysis can be used to generate the feedback without having the user intervention. For the purpose of emotion detection, a Support Vector Machine has been employed to detect six types of emotions namely - happy,sad,anger,surprise,disgust and neutral. First the face is detected and 68 facial landmarks co-ordinates are located on the face that correspond to eyes, mouth, nose and jaw. With this landmarks, a total of 15 real valued parameters are calculated taking into account the neutral face of the user. These real valued parameters are computed as ratios of different distant metrics corresponding to the actual face and neutral face. Experimental results show that an accuracy of 90.60 ± 1.65% has been achieved in recognizing the six emotions by using 20% of dataset for testing. An average accuracy of 88.06% is obtained in 10-fold cross validation testing. This information is used to generate a visual feedback to the advertiser. Apart from generating feedback for an advertisement, this can also be used to get opinions of people wherever communication or language becomes a hindrance either due to illiteracy or not knowing the language.

articleTitle: Analysis of Single-Stage Resonant Power Factor Corrector for LED Lighting Application
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: PFC are used in LED lighting applications for improving the power factor. S6-PFC converter is used as driver for supplying the light-emitting diodes. Unlike usual power supply, this strategy does not have any electrolytic capacitors. The converter has a bidirectional switch with soft switching conditions for turning ON and OFF. Along with the soft switching, the recycling of energy by making magnetizing inductance in the transformer as the resonant component, increases the overall efficiency of the driver. The buck-boost cell in the converter improves the power factor inherently. This paper discuss about the closed loop operation of this converter using PI controller. Variation in output and the switching operation of MOSFET with respect to change in input and load were analyzed. The closed loop S6-PFC converter is simulated using MATLAB/Simulink platform, for a prototype design of 21W/30V LED lighting system.

articleTitle: Design of battery charger with power path controller and fuel gauge for point of sale (POS) terminal
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: A POS system or Point of sale (POS) terminal is a combination of hardware and software. POS terminal is a replacement for cash register, it has ability to record and track customer orders and it is used to process credit, debit card payments and many other functions. POS system requires suitable input power for its operation. Battery charger with power path controller (BQ24171) helps to charge the battery efficiently and also select the appropriate power path to the system load. Fuel gauge (34Z100) IC has inbuilt coulomb counter, Which helps to measure the charge added to and removed from the battery. MAGIK II [Media Accelerated Graphics Innovation Kit], which is a low power compact module for multimedia applications and i.MX6 processor is embedded on it. i.MX6 processors are automotive and infotainment processors represent Freescale Semiconductor's latest achievement in integrated multimedia applications processors.

articleTitle: Handwriting Recognition through Novel Combinational Segmentation Technique and Iterative Blocks Features
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: We propose a novel technique for segmentation of the handwritten answers written in continuous writings by the candidates during theory based examinations. We estimate digital information from the handwritten words. The problem with cursive writings is that the neighboring characters may be overlapping or may be some times away from each other. Also all the characters are not of same size. A single length window cannot segment all the characters while an adaptive length window would either require multiple scans of the image or multiple windows might be needed, increasing the computational complexity. Here, we propose a novel combinational segmentation scheme where variable length cuts are of the word image are generated as tentative segments and the length of cuts depends upon the vertical pixel density threshold. These segments may have some segments with deficient characters or excess parts of neighboring characters. So recombination of these segments with nearest segments is done to generate final segments. The advantage of the method is that we can segment any handwriting. Then, we train the system to identify a character through the proposed iterative blocks scheme. The features extracted are density per block and number of junctions and end points per block. Text written by the same author is used for the testing. We have tested for 10 subjects with character recognition accuracy more than 90%.

articleTitle: Design and Power Analysis of 16×16 SRAM Array Employing 7T I-LSVL
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Static Random access memories are the significant building blocks in applications like Cache memories, Processors and Portable gadgets. Hence there is need for SRAM Memory. But the design of SRAM is involved at the rate of increased power consumption. So the challenge is requirement of Low Power & energy efficient Memory design. In this paper an effort is made to design and simulate a Low power 16×16 SRAM Memory Array employing 7T I-LSVL SRAM Cell. Peripheral components of entire 16×16 SRAM Array like Sense amplifier, Row decoder, Column decoder are designed. The Power Consumption of proposed 16×16 SRAM Memory Array is 18.3mW which is an improvement of 8.66%. The proposed design work is carried using Cadence Virtuoso tool employing standard library gpdk 180nm.

articleTitle: Real Time Recognition and Monitoring of Moving Targets in Video using Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The video surveillance system supports the classification of objects and the tracking of objects. The tracking of objects is considered as one of the utmost important tasks of the video surveillance system. Two key steps in these systems are: detection and frame-tracking of the object. Object detection involves identifying an object in the frame of a video stream. Each tracking technique needs a mechanism to detect moving objects. The Background subtraction methodology and Frame difference methodology are most commonly uses target detection algorithms. This paper proposes an adaptive filter approach to keep track of a moving object in real time video. Kalman filter can be applied to linear systems. The Kalman filter is a robust algorithm that can be used in state estimation issues, so this method is used to estimate and evaluate the location of a moving target. In this paper we use the Kalman Filter approach to track the moving target. Performance of Kalman Filter is evaluated using parameters Percentage Fit Error and Root Sum Square Position Error. A MATLAB code is developed and the simulated result shows good tracking performance of real time video.

articleTitle: Low Power Design and Implementation of Multi-Output Carry Look-Ahead Adder
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Adders are the most elementary and important blocks in Digital Electronics. Adder designs are constrained by time required for carry propagation. Sum generation takes place only after carry propagates from previous bit. This sequential relation increases delay. In this work, Carry Look-Ahead Adder (CLA) is implemented based on Domino logic. Domino logic has the advantages of realizing the circuit using lesser number of transistors compared to CMOS logic. Manchester Carry Chain (MCC) is one of the variants of domino logic to obtain multiple carry outputs simultaneously. This avoids the sequential carry generation dependence. MCC based CLA has capacity to generate 4 carry outputs simultaneously. In the proposed CLA, odd and carry outputs are evaluated using separate carry chains. 8 carry outputs are generated simultaneously. Thus the proposed CLA reduces delay by 47.23% compared to MCC CLA. Power dissipated by proposed CLA is 5.67% more compared to MCC CLA. Proposed CLA has disadvantage of higher power dissipation compared to MCC CLA. Solution for mitigating power in proposed CLA is realized by adding Header Switch based Sleep Transistor (HSST). HSST based proposed CLA consumes 23.02% less power compared to proposed CLA. Delay of the HSST based CLA with odd and even carry chain adder increased by 36.25% with respect to proposed CLA. Power-Delay-Product (PDP) of HSST based proposed CLA is 41.323% higher compared to MCC CLA and Proposed CLA has PDP improvement of 44.055% compared to MCC CLA.
