HSST based proposed CLA can be used as trade-off between power and delay between MCC CLA and proposed CLA.

articleTitle: Mines/ Vertical tunnels Fall Detection & Prevention System
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Mines / Vertical tunnel fall detection and prevention system presented in this paper is a proactive approach which is used to detect and prevent the occurrence of accidents at the abandoned mines or uncapped vertical tunnel which are left open. In the proposed work, a prototype model based on the communication using Infra-Red (IR) signal sensing is discussed. The IR sensor continuously transmits and receives the signal in the Line of Sight (LOS) path. When this LOS path of the signal from the sensors breaks due to the interference of any object or a person, the microcontroller sends an alert message via GSM and simultaneously warning is provided through alarm and red light. The metal plate kept at the mine hole closes the hole in order to prevent the victim from falling deeper into the hole using gear mechanism. The solution presented in this paper is very effective, easily scalable and highly reliable by the use of IR radiations.

articleTitle: Finding the Probability of Patient being Demented using Data Mining Approach called Confidence
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Nowadays large quantity of information is being generated in almost all the fields. One of the most important field which plays a major role in our day to day life is medical field. The data of patients along with the symptoms are getting generated in every corner of the world. Data Mining is the right technique which can be applied on these large amount of data to extract useful information in the field of medicine i.e., including from the stage of diagnosis of symptoms, observation of the patients and predicting the disease from which they are suffering. This paper provides the easy method for predicting the probability of patient being demented from a disease by applying the formula of association analysis technique called confidence, based on the symptoms of the patients and the data set available.

articleTitle: Radial Based Analysis of GRNN in Non-Textured Image Inpainting
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Image inpainting algorithms are used to restore some damaged or missing information region of an image based on the surrounding information. The method proposed in this paper applies the radial based analysis of image inpainting on GRNN. The damaged areas are first isolated from rest of the areas and then arranged by their size and then inpainted using GRNN. The training of the neural network is done using different radii to achieve a better outcome. A comparative analysis is done for different regression-based algorithms. The overall results are compared with the results achieved by the other algorithms as LS-SVM with reference to the PSNR value.

articleTitle: Wireless Oxygenator
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Oxygen is the basic fundamental of survival ashore and as well as water body. Life of sea going life forms depends on it. Due to increase in population and the waste produced by humans, which are disposed in to the water bodies, leading to unfavorable conditions, which results in drastic depletion of oxygen level in water. One of the best ways of increasing DO(Dissolved Oxygen) in water is by aeration, there are basically 2 types of aeration namely water into air and air into water, after a considerable literature survey it was found that water into air aeration was efficient which is nothing but sprinkling the water from the lower layers of water bodies into air and producing bubbles on the surface. This paper mainly focuses on designing a model which oxygenates water at different parts of a water body, whose movement can be controlled wirelessly, powering the whole system through solar. Air circulation utilizing sustainable power source for the procedure and making it portable would make it more effective and temperate using solar power to control the oxygenation and mechanical automation for the development of dependable and effective oxygenator.

articleTitle: Control of BLDC Machine drive for Flywheel Energy Storage in DC Micro-grid Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Energy storage is crucial in the current microgrid scenario. An Energy storage system is essential to store energy whenever the rate of energy generated not balanced with the demand. In this paper Flywheel Energy Storage System (FESS) which works on the principle of kinetic energy storage driven by BLDC machine is considered. A three phase bi-directional converter is used for regulating the stored energy of the reversible electro-mechanical system (motor/generator). Suitable control scheme for BLDC drive is discussed with the application in DC Microgrid with high fluctuations in generation and load thus improving its reliability.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of WDM-FSO PON using RZ OOK in presence of interchannel crosstalk
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: A hybrid wavelength division multiplexed (WDM) passive optical network (PON) incorporating high speed free space optical (FSO) communication i.e. WDM-FSO PON using OOK modulation, is analyzed for the impact of interchannel crosstalk affected by the atmospheric turbulence. The WDM channels are affected by crosstalk whereas the FSO performance is degraded by scintillation caused due to atmospheric turbulence. This work considers gamma-gamma probability distribution function (pdf) model for atmospheric turbulence. Different noises like thermal noise, shot noise and amplified spontaneous emission (ASE) noise are considered while analyzing the system. The demultiplexer adjacent channel rejection is also considered while including the crosstalk interferer to the system. In this paper, average bit error rate is used to evaluate the performance of this system using RZ OOK modulation format and in presence of single crosstalk interfere.

articleTitle: A Novel Algorithm to Reduce Computational Complexity in the Evaluation of Loop Currents for Very Large Electrical Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In this rapid development of world, electronics is one topic which is on the top of the list. The reason for development of electronics is the need of fast results, which is only possible by developing better performance circuits. As the need increases the performance of any electronics should increase, which makes the electrical circuits more large and complex. Hence to design such complex and large circuits, large amount of calculations need to be done. By using Cramer's rule, unique scalar values of loop current can be found. But, the time consumed for calculations gets higher and higher as the circuit gets larger. Therefore, to minimize the time consumed for calculation various mathematical methods are used. Mathematical concepts like LU Decomposition, Condensation Techniques and other concepts to decrease the calculations required to loop currents. By comparing these various methods will help us to find the loop currents in fewer steps.

articleTitle: On the performance of Turbo codes based on Consultative Committee for Space Data Systems Standard
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This paper analyzes the performance of turbo codes according to the specifications mentioned in Consultative Committee for Space Data Systems (CCSDS) standards. Turbo encoding using different interleavers and decoding algorithms namely, Log-MAP and Max-Log-MAP are implemented and compared. The comparison of CCSDS based pseudo random interleaver with block interleaver is presented, which revealed that the former offers 4dB more coding gain than the latter. The impact of quantization of soft values on the performance of decoding is presented and analyzed. The performance of the decoding algorithms (Log-MAP, Max-Log-MAP) is analyzed with the number of iterations, which revealed that the performance improves with increase in number of iterations.

articleTitle: Discovering Interesting Locations in a Geospatial Region using Association Rule Mining
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: With the help of GPS enabled devices, people can easily share their photos as well as checking in records on the social media. Most of the time users share their experiences and interact with friends through LBSNs through activities such as making online friends, sharing events, checking in, etc. Checking in is an online activity that tells your friends when and where are you and how are you feeling at that place through social media. The paper describes about mining interesting locations using the association rule mining. Here, the meaning of interesting locations is culturally important places, such as frequently visited public areas such as hotels and theatres, etc. With such information users can know about new locations surrounding them and would enable to choose among many different choices. As there is increase in users of social media where people are continuously uploading the data like geo locations, we aim to use this data which can be easily used for best recommendation. In this study, our main goal is to collect data from Foursquare and utilize them as a user reaction on location. Then to use the apriori algorithm for finding interesting locations with the help of user opinions.

articleTitle: Fingerprint Authentication by Image Processing using Hartley Discrete Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The Hartley transform is based on the small extraction method which is proposed for the usage of fingerprint analysis and matching of the finger prints. HT is applied on a very smaller region which is much closed to the core of the finger prints. We use Discrete wavelet transform (DWT) based method for the extraction and analysis of the finger prints The experimental results show that, the proposed method reduces the false acceptance rate (FAR) from 21.48% to 16.74 %. This can be enhanced by using a lot of algorithms and some other wavelet transforms.

articleTitle: Cost Based Importance Measures for Reliability Analysis of Wind Turbine System
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: There is an increase in the power generation from wind sector and hence it requires a reliable operation. An unscheduled outage and loss of generation occurs by the component failures of a wind turbine system. It has become a challenging task to improve the reliability of a wind turbine system. With the knowledge of Component importance measures component's priority in terms of reliability, availability, maintenance and risk is ascertained. There exists literature on number of importance measures. The most commonly used being Birnbaum measure, Fussell Vesely, Improvement potential, risk achievement worth, risk reduction worth etc. However a little attention has been paid on cost based importance measures considering the cost incurred by system maintenance, reliability improvement within a given period of time. Improvement in components is cost dependent. The importance measures of components of a system are likely to vary for different performance indices under cost consideration. In this paper improvement potential importance measure has been modified for reliability analysis of wind turbine system under cost consideration. It prioritizes the system components based on risk, criticality and maintenance. The criticality ranking of the components of the wind turbine system obtained from the proposed importance measure is practical and more realistic. The proposed new cost based improvement potential importance measure gives different prioritization to components as compared to improvement potential without cost (proposed earlier by us).

articleTitle: Random Connectedness in Vehicular ad-hoc Network by Managing Dynamic Spectrum in CRN
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In vehicular communication, the spectrum is utilized efficiently between the primary user (PU) and secondary user (SU). A dedicated channel is allocated for vehicular communication. To establish a communication between the vehicles, it has to be connected. The connectivity of vehicles is identified by applying the graph theory concepts. This paper, describes the dynamic connectivity between the vehicles. Since the vehicles are moving the topology of the network changes. These issues are addressed through the random graph. To establish the communication among the vehicles road side infrastructure should be available which is been enabled with the cognitive radio (CR) technology. This cognitive nature of network brings changes in adoptability when the topology becomes too dynamic in nature and has an impact in the connectivity between the vehicles. In this research work connectivity is studied using the analytical approach by applying the graph theory concepts.

articleTitle: Investigation of Different Gate Materials for Improved Device Performance in RC MOSFET
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This work examines the comparative study of various materials, i.e., Metal, Indium Tin Oxide (ITO), Black Phosphorous (BP), Zinc Oxide (ZnO) and Titanium Nitride (TiN) as a gate material in Recessed Channel (RC) MOSFET with an aim to examine the most desired gate material for sub-20nm MOS device. It is perceived from the results that the characteristics of RC MOSFET improves significantly in terms of transconductance (g<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sub>) (two times), switching ratio (I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">on</sub>/I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">off</sub>) (10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup>), subthreshold slope (SS) (47.69%), electron mobility (45.4%) and electric field (71.4%) when Black Phosphorus is amalgamated on to the RC MOSFET when compared to Al, ITO, ZnO and TiN gated RC MOSFET. Thus, this analysis demonstrates the potential of black phosphorus as a gate material which can further be used for the applications in Nanoelectronic devices and IC design.

articleTitle: A 2.4GHz Algorithmic Design of CMOS LNA in 180nm Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a highly linear single ended inductively degenerated Low Noise Amplifier is presented. The LNA is designed to enhance the Noise Figure and Gain. The single ended LNA has 13.67dB gain with noise figure 1.45 dB. The Input Reflection coefficient (S11) obtained is -10.34 dB, the Output Reflection coefficient (S22) of -19.43dB, the total power consumption of LNA is around 33.69 mW, the proposed LNA achieves the best input referred 1dB compression point with Third-Order Input Intercept Point (IIP3) of -10dBm and a PldB of -9.18dBm. The LNA is designed using 0.18μm CMOS Technology. Spectre from cadence is used to design and simulate the LNA, Virtuoso Layout Editor used to obtain LNA layout.

articleTitle: Dynamic Functional and Network Connectivity Changes of Functional MRI Data: Parkinson's Study
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Parkinson's disorder (PD) is a progressive, degenerative disease which mainly affects nerve cells in depth parts of the brain which are basal ganglia (thalamus) and sensory motor region. We investigated the functional raw data of the PD whole brain connectome consisting of many nodes using resting-state functional MRI with considered data as PD patients subjects and matched control subjects were analyzed using conn and with functional MRI's software library, here we are using compcor algorithm and sliding window method to reduce the noise in functional data and to increase the spatial resolution respectively. We focused mainly on information flow between default mode and sensory motor ROI's of brain regions by taking correlation coefficient as a measure. Our results suggest that PD patients showed reduced connectivity in thalamus and sensory motor nodes compared to controls, but increased connectivity in default mode network. However, there is an altered change in the functional modular organization of the PD brain connectome.

articleTitle: ANN Based Human Emotion Recognition Using Discriminative Facial Patches
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Face reflects the emotions in mind and hence by analyzing facial expressions one can read the emotions of others. Emotion recognition is a challenging task. Inspired by the sophisticated human nervous system, the Artificial Neural Network (ANN) is an efficient machine learning tool to handle this kind of difficult problems. Hence in this paper, an efficient ANN based human emotion recognition system using the features of discriminative facial patches is proposed. First of all, the facial landmark points are detected from the facial expression images and some active patches are considered. Then, dimensionality reduction is performed to obtain the discriminative facial patches and the features are extracted from these patches. Local Binary Pattern (LBP) and Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG) features are extracted as the feature vectors. The experiments on JAFEE datasets are made to recognize the six universal expressions (anger, fear, disgust, happiness, sadness and surprise). Finally, the extracted features are classified using both Support Vector Machine (SVM) and ANN classifiers. Results show that recognition of human expressions with ANN using HOG features has a better recognition rate compared to that using appearance features.

articleTitle: An Ultra wideband GaN Power Amplifier for T/R Module Application
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This paper presents Power Amplifier (PA) design for wideband transmit chain which can be utilized to fulfill the multipurpose or shared aperture technique in wireless communication and Radars. This PA design utilizes Gallium Nitride (GaN) on Silicon Carbide (SiC) based T2G6003028-FS transistor manufactured by Qorvo to get better efficiency and thermal stability. Achieved gain of PA is 10dB at center frequency 3.5GHz. The substrate used for the PA simulation is 10mil thick Rogers RT/Duroid-5880. The dimensions of PA layout are 65mm x 25mm. Simulation results show that the proposed PA is capable of peak power of 47dBm and 48 dBm at 1 dB and 3 dB compressions respectively at 3.5GHz. All simulation results of PA are presented.

articleTitle: Ocular Artifact Detection in EEG using Wavelet Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Electroencephalogram is a method used to sense electrical motion of brain. These signals are contaminated by signals other than brain source called artifacts. This research is focused on elimination of mostly occurred eye blink artifact based on new threshold algorithm with stationary wavelet transform. One of statistical approach called kurtosis identifies eye blink artifacts occurred in EEG. After identifying artifacts, new thresholding technique is applied on signal with different wavelets at different level of decomposition. Comparison of wavelets estimates the suitable wavelet for artifact removing and validated using power spectrum density and kurtosis value of EEG signal.

articleTitle: Aeroplane Shape Defected Ground Structure Microstrip Antenna For WLAN Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In the Digital world for communication purpose the basic requirement is Antenna which is small in size, better performance and easy to use Aeroplane Shape Defected Ground Structure Microstrip Antenna for WLAN Applications is presented in this paper. The substrate material used for this antenna is FR4 glass Epoxy having permittivity of 4.4 and height is 1.6mm. The antenna is designed, simulated and fabricated at 2.4GHz(WLAN Applications). The proposed antenna is simulated and fabricated with DGS. The Return Loss, VSWR, Gain, etc., are compared with simulated and fabricated results. Then it is followed by comparing with conventional DGS designs in antenna. The results, thus obtained offer reduction in size upto 60%.

articleTitle: A Comparison between Inset Feed and Proximity Feed Techniques for MSA
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Antenna is an important element in the wireless communication. In wired communication, transmitter and receiver are connected through the wires. But in a wireless communication, the antennas play the most important role by avoiding the physical communication between the transmitter and the receiver. Microstrip patch antennas are extensively used in variety applications, the reason is its huge advantages. In any antenna the necessary thing is to match an impedance of antenna with the transmission line. This paper deals with the comparison between inset feed and proximity feed techniques, which are the types of direct and indirect feeding respectively.

articleTitle: Simple Output Feedback based Control Strategy for Hyperchaotic Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel method for controlling specific hyperchaotic systems with use of output feedback control strategies. For this, a simple linear controller for hyperchaotic systems using output feedback scheme to achieve stabilization of the underlying system is proposed. To achieve this purpose, an appropriate Lyapunov function is selected and bounds on control parameters are designed explicitly. Finally, some numerical simulations are presented for hyperchaotic Lorenz system to verify and validate the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Design of controllers for bearing faults
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In plants the major worries of rotating machineries are unwavering quality, security, productivity and execution. The vital role of monitoring, analysis and fault diagnosis is a noteworthy for rotating machineries. For dependable diagnostics of rotating machinery faults a proficient and powerful component extraction systems are required. For various sorts of rotating machineries from the previous couple of decades there are different vibration include extraction strategy techniques are proposed. Vibration estimation is an imperative factor for examining the healthy state of machines. Be that as it may, there are still faults and dissatisfactions which for the most part happen in the system. Bearings are subjected to disasters on account of causes like mis alignment, vibration and stuns. In this paper WT include mining is utilized alongside RFA to analyze bearing faults. The wavelet features are extracted from the raw vibration signals. Co-efficients are chosen and were classified J48 decision Tree utilizing RFA. A complete experiment is conducted to guarantee that the optimal no. of attributes war utilized and the feature was repeated with the goal that most extreme accuracy classification is established. The classification accuracy is developed in 3 stages to be specific, FE (Feature Extraction), FS (Feature Selection) and FC (Feature Classification). From gaining the DT the maximum essential features were chosen to get best classification accuracy with least number of attributes to diminish designs in existent stage application. The amount of attributes and profundity of information is repeated to acquire the best classification accuracy. From this exploration RFA is tried for bearing fault diagnosis and best classification accuracy is achieved. The outcomes can be additionally utilized for fault analysis in plants for any bearing associated issues. A widespread study is done by a RFA which delivered preferable anticipating over other algorithms. In light of the general analysis, RFA establishes the most favored classifying algorithm that accomplished the maximum classification of 94.07% which is bigger to alternative algorithms.

articleTitle: Study of Aerosol Distribution in the Vertical Air Column of Atmosphere during Uttarakhand Forest Fires 2016
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Every year a large amount of smoke is released into the air from forest fire incidents across the Indian state of Uttarakhand thereby affecting the air quality in and around the area. Detection of smoke aerosols along the vertical air column has been carried out by using data from Cloud-Aerosol Lidar and Infrared Pathfinder Satellite Observation (CALIPSO) Vertical Feature Mask(VFM), while CALIPSO Profile Data has been used for studying the vertical properties of the aerosols released in the air at the source area for the extended time frame.

articleTitle: Sectoral Side-lobe Suppression using Parks-McClellan Algorithm in a Planar Array
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Side-lobe level control is an essential part of the array pattern synthesis. In case of a linear array that consists of N elements, N-2 side-lobes can be controlled individually. This deterministic relationship does not carry over to the planar array case. One of the existing solutions to overcome this problem is the collapsed distribution. In this paper, an efficient alternative method to control the side-lobe level in a planar array over a particular sector is proposed. This method utilizes an extension of Parks-McClellan algorithm to calculate the gain and phase distributions from a synthesized planar array radiation pattern. The technique combines the advantage provided by Parks-McClellan method and the principle of pattern multiplication in order to obtain control over a sector of side-lobes to the desired level. Results have been simulated for a rectangular planar array. The desired side-lobe level is obtained over a particular sector of interest.

articleTitle: A Compact low Profile Rectangular Shaped Octa-band Planar Antenna for Wireless Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: A planar low profile rectangular patch antenna having a dimension of (0.34λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>×0.34λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>× 0.01λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>) and operating at eight different resonant frequency is presented. The antenna constitute of rectangular patch as the radiator with full ground plane. It has a resonant frequency of 2.6 (lower WiMAX), 3.75 (middle WiMAX), 4.7 (C-band), 5.1 (WLAN), 6.6, 7.8 (satellite TV), 8.05 and 8.95 GHz (X - band), with S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub><; -10 dB bandwidth of 3.8% (2.86 - 2.66 GHz), 1.61 % (3.70 - 3.75 GHz), 2.13% (4.63 - 4.73GHz), 3.7% (5.0 - 5.19 GHz), 1.51% (6.55 -6.65 GHz), 9.2% (7.2 - 7.9 GHz), 2.7% (7.9 - 8.12 GHz), 10.4% (8.2 - 9.1GHz). The positioning of the rectangular radiator plays a very important role in achieving the octa-band operations. Obtained radiation characteristics make the antenna a popular candidate for the aforementioned applications.

articleTitle: Application of Distributed Control System for Monitoring and Control of Three Tank Level Control
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In this paper describes our experiences designing controller to control the three tank level control system. The controller used is Distributed Control System(DCS) using CentumVP software. We performed experiment measuring the Proportional Integral Derivative (PID) values. We found that our Distributed control system controller outperformed stable.

articleTitle: System for Cooperative Query Answer Authentication in Cloud over Anonymous Data
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In data publishing model, owner of data outsource the data to a third party publisher which are Cloud Service Providers (CSP) who satisfies the data requirement of the end user on behalf of actual data owner. But the cloud service provider may be untrustworthy or system may lack in security. So there need to be a way for user to check the answers received from cloud whether it is same as data owner would have send. In this paper we proposed a system for authenticating query answers send from cloud service providers. This system is based on three concepts ring signature, Merkel Hash Tree (MHT) and non-repudiable service protocol using online trusted authority (TA). These techniques work in cooperation with each other to provide user correct answer for his submitted query. The nonrepudiation protocol protects user and CSP from each other's malicious trading behavior.

articleTitle: Mixed Method Application in Order Reduction of Discrete System
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In this manuscript model order reduction of the higher order discrete time state space model is done. The mode selection method and Continued Fraction Cauer second form is being used. The numerator part is derived by mode selection method and denominator part is calculated by Continued Fraction Cauer Second Form. The method is applied in a fourth order discrete time transfer function. The obtained lower order is compared with the original discrete time higher order system and second order reduced transfer function available in literature. The comparison of characteristics plot of the original transfer function with second order proposed and reduced order available in literature is done by the step response and pole zero mapping.

articleTitle: Mathematical Principle Of Index of Co-Incidence And Rook Polynomial To Identify Frequent Item-set Distribution In Super Market
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The objective of the study is to identify possible item-set distribution in super market. By the concept of index of co-incidence the best solution is identified and with the rook polynomial the positioning of item-set with the best distribution solution is done. Index of Co-incidence used to form groups of datasets from all given data and identify that the chosen item-set belongs to which group of item-sets. The groups formed can predict the possible purchase of the other products that are connected to the purchased product in transactions. The rook polynomial identifies the possible solutions of placing the best chosen item-set groups in the super market. Hundred transactions was considered to identify a group using Index of Co-Incidence. Test cases showed expected results. Using this outcome a proposal was made to place the products listed in the group according to rook polynomial which is expected to improve the business transaction.

articleTitle: Demand side Management of Agriculture pumping sector through Star rated Energy Efficient Pump sets
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The Power sector in India provides major opportunities for reducing energy consumption by creating awareness on existing Energy inefficiencies of practical, operational and financial nature. Substitution of more inductive Energy inefficient pump sets in agriculture has been identified as one of the key strategy initiatives, which is up to date, has been limited to a few pilot projects. The objective is to replace Energy inefficient pumpsets with the (Bureau of energy efficiency) BEE 5 star rated Energy efficient pumpsets. This paper gives detailed energy audit of the total pump sets existing in the study area. The study includes measuring the present operating efficiency of 973 agricultural pump sets which were identified in the thirty one feeders of Sampathnagaram section, East Godavari District, AP and The practical efficiency analysis has been demonstrated by replacing the existing pump sets with the BEE 5 star rated energy efficient pumpsets.The efficiency analysis reveals that the energy consumption drastically reduced, which leads to energy saving on the feeders at consumer end. Also a future insight into the Demand side management and promoting the BEE energy efficient Pump sets on rural area. This involvement can lead to lower energy supply on the feeder, and for this reason lower subsidized energy sale by utilities and the subsidy to be paid by the State Government will be reduced.

articleTitle: Energy Prediction for Smart Solar Remote Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The solar energy is a clean and renewable energy. Solar Photovoltaic renewable sources proving to be most beneficial with low-cost, so that number of PV plants is significantly growing. Today's solar plants are highly localized and unstructured. Around 14% of solar system face major fault every year therefore the management of photovoltaic systems is important for increase their efficiency. The system is implemented in two phases first one is monitoring followed by prediction which helps to reduce the energy loss. The solar monitoring phase collects and analyzes several constraints being evaluated by using sensors to calculate its panel level performance. Smart Monitoring system maintains track of electricity generation contents and regional temperature. The experimental results forecast the mistake finding as well as the panel's dead state with time parameters. Phase two deals with analyzing time-series of solar energy data for prediction using Hidden Markov Model (HMM). The model decides a prediction considering probabilistic relationship of the first value to next value in series. The predicted output is then compared with real-time output to increase accuracy of prediction.

articleTitle: HSEPM: Home Security and Efficient Power Management
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: With the beginning of rising refined technology were almost everybody's life revolves around it and given the massive spike in people using the technology to automate both trivial and non-trivial task, its highly unrealistic to contract a personnel to secure people's home and assets because if an intruder is detected in the home the security personnel needs to raise an alarm manually and notify the owner about the same. Another problem that everyone commonly faces is the inefficient consumption of power leading to high spikes in electricity bill due to inefficient utilization of power i.e. leaving the lights turned on when not in use. The proposed method offers a low cost single solution to these two problem by providing a system which combines both these functionalities i.e. raising an alarm upon detection of an intruder and notifying the owner about the same via email, pushover notification also the system automatically turns on and turns off the lights based on the user's motion. The proposed system allows remote controlling capabilities by providing a web application to enable and disable the security and turn on or turn off the light appliances from anywhere across the world. The proposed system makes use of Raspberry PI, PIR motion sensors, LCD display and keypad matrix to achieve the same.

articleTitle: Linearity and Distortion Assessment of Black Phosphorus-Based Junctionless RC MOSFET
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In this paper, Black Phosphorus-Junctionless-Recessed Channel (BP-JL-RC) MOSFET, a low power device has been designed. The device performance at low power has been evaluated by linearity (g<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sub>, VIP2, VIP3 and IIP3) and harmonic distortion (g<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m2</sub>, g<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m3</sub>, HD2, HD3 and IMD3) FOMs. Proposed device has been explored at 45nm technology node (Gate length=20nm). It is found that device leads to higher drain current (0.3mA) and thereby enhances the analog performance which is evaluated by transconductance, channel resistance (decreases by 50.51%). Moreover, linearity parameters VIP2, VIP3, and IIP3 are improved by 81%, 41.6%, and 200% respectively in BP-JL-RC MOSFET as compared to Conventional Recessed Channel (CRC) MOSFET due to reduction in harmonic distortion parameters g<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m2</sub>(two times), g<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m3</sub>(1.5 times), HD2 (three times), HD3 (two times), and IMD3 (seven times). Thus, the proposed device is suitable for low power high linearity applications.

articleTitle: Blinkom: A Smart Solution for the MND Patients
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: the progression of technology in the field of medicine has led to ameliorate difficulties of patients to a massive extent. One of the major categories of physical disability leading to paralysis is the Motor Neuron Disease (MND). A patient suffering from MND is unable to talk, walk, express feelings and communicate due to the weakening of muscles. The patient has control only upon his eye blinks. This condition hinders the patient to liaise with the environment and commune his basic needs unlike a normal human being. They eventually feel emotionally detached with their peers and surrounding because of the uneasiness to convey they tend to suppress a crucial part of their emotion. In order to abate the problem to communicate, an appropriate combination of hardware and software must be integrated to come up with a feasible solution. In this paper, a portable solution to convert sequences of eye blinks to a speech output has been discussed. The operating system used is Raspbian and python coding is done using `Open CV' library to program Raspberry Pi 3. A camera captures the eye blinks and based on the EAR calculation, the code converts the sequence of the blinks to the corresponding speech output.

articleTitle: Design of an efficient vedic binary squaring circuit
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: High speed and less area have always been a major concern in VLSI design. With this as a constraint, in this paper a dedicated architecture which is exclusively used for squaring operation has been proposed. Squaring plays a vital role in many signal processing applications and probabilistic analysis in communication systems, where, quite often general multipliers are used although squaring has to be done. This unnecessarily increases the area of the design and also increases the computation time. The principles of Nikhilam Sutra have been leveraged and is extended for squaring binary bits. A comparative study of the projected architecture and the prevailing multipliers, on the premise of delay and space utilization is presented. The simulation outcome proves that the design projected employing Nikhilam sutra improves the performance significantly. The 8-bit architecture has been developed by Verilog HDL and the synthesis is completed using Xilinx ISE - 14.5 software.

articleTitle: 10-bit 47.57μW Power Efficient Successive Approximation Register ADC with High Speed
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: A 10-bit Successive Approximation Register (SAR) Analog to Digital Converter (ADC) prototype is presented in this work and simulations are performed using Cadence Spectre on 16 nm technology. This architecture consists of a bulk driven rail to rail comparator and split binary weighted capacitive Digital to Analog Converter (DAC). Both comparator and DAC are significant part of Analog to Digital Converter (ADC) which helps to achieve high speed with less power consumption and improved linearity. The power consumption is 47.57 μW. The Spurious Free Dynamic Range (SFDR) and Signal to Noise plus Distortion Ratio (SNDR) are 68 dB and 63 dB, respectively. The proposed design operates with 100 MSps speed while the comparator and Successive Approximation Register (SAR) control logic operates at 1GHz.

articleTitle: Microservices: A perfect SOA based solution for Enterprise Applications compared to Web Services
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The Software Engineering community has defined different types of architectures to build applications. One among them is Service Oriented Architecture(SOA) which has created significant impact the way software applications are built. There are many implementations of SOA like Web Services, REST services etc. But Web Services and REST services do not fully follow all the principles of SOA. Microservices as an architectural style recently emerged from SOA by which we can develop business requirements with loosely coupled, self deploying and scalable services. Microservices have gained more popularity in application development as they are easy to understand, scale and deploy. In this paper we discuss principles of SOA, major drawbacks of web services and benefits of Microservices over SOA based web services. We have highlighted the importance of Microservices in software development. This paper gives information for architects as to why choose Microservices architecture over web services. We have also discussed metrics used for calculating Coupling between services and we evaluated by considering a smart payment application for ecommerce which is built using both the styles. We observed that Microservices architectural style has less coupling between services compared to Web Service style based on the metric values of the application.

articleTitle: Transient Stability Enhancement of a Hybrid Wind-PV Farm incorporating a STATCOM
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The transient stability enhancement of IEEE-14 bus system integrated with the hybrid wind-PV farm incorporating a static synchronous compensator (STATCOM) has been scrutinized critically in the present work. The hybrid wind-solar PV farm consists of wind farm employing variable speed doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG), and a solar farm based on variable irradiation. Steady-state analysis corresponding to different operating conditions are performed to find the best combination of variable wind speed and solar irradiation for stable operation. Symmetrical and unsymmetrical faults are created at different locations of the integrated power system to examine voltage profile, active and reactive power, with and without the STATCOM at the point of common coupling (PCC). The main factor responsible for the instability of the power system has been found to be an imbalance of reactive power. Simulation has been done on Power systems computer-aided design (PSCAD)/EMTDC, and the outcomes demonstrate that STATCOM improves the transient stability by reactive power compensation, reducing post-fault settling time. A remarkable improvement in the voltage profile of the hybrid power system has been found in the presence of flexible alternating current transmission System (FACTS) device.

articleTitle: Autonomous Agricultural Farming Robot in Closed Field
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Present research strives to implement the agricultural farming robot which can move instinctively, instinctively, involuntarily for ploughing, seeding and irrigation in closed field. This research also contributes to enhance functionality of Agri-Bot in the field for spying. The agri robot is equipped with a camera and sends the data to pc through Wi-Fi network. The robot has ploughing blades and servo motor for distributing the seeds and irrigation into the field. It works with ultrasonic sensor and IR sensor. Ultrasonic sensor is for avoiding obstacles in the field, IR sensor is for sensing felid boundary. Arduino controller acts as heart and brain of the system, it makes fast, accurate, autonomous movement. Video acquisition and transmitting camera mounted on it is 360° rotatable. This Research features a Agri-Bot that uses Wi-Fi 802.11G along with TCP/IP protocol. IP address and Video is received in laptop for further processing. This research intends to reduce human efforts and provide an intelligent aid to the farmers.

articleTitle: Feature Reduction in Flow Based Intrusion Detection System
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Intrusion Detection System (IDS) is a component which monitors the traffic and analyzes it. It helps in detection of malicious traffic and intrusions and security attacks. Developing IDS to get better accuracy with reduced false positive rate is the important factor. Moreover, the amount of data to be analyzed is beyond the ability of commonly used computer hardware and software tools. And it takes lots of time for processing of such huge network traffic. So, one must find an efficient way to reduce the size of data from dataset without losing important and relevant information. In this paper we proposed a feature selection for effective Intrusion Detection System. The proposed system performs feature selection. In this paper, we proposed a performance based feature selection process with machine learning for most relevant features selection. We used JRip rule based classification algorithm for performance evaluation using 10-fold cross validation. This study is performed using a new labeled flow based CICIDS2017 data set. There are total 85 features in CICIDS2017 data set. In this paper we focused on relevant feature selection for DDoS LOIC (Low Orbit Ion Cannon) attack. Out of total 86 features we find 18 most relevant features subset for DDoS LOIC attack which gave more accuracy and reduced processing time. The proposed system along with only most relevant features set helps in developing IDS accuracy and reducing computation time.

articleTitle: Fingerprint Liveness Detection with Feature Level Fusion Techniques using SVM and Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Fingerprint liveness detection has become a common technique in fingerprint authentication systems for security purposes. Although several hardware and software based approaches have been introduced so far to distinguish between live and fake fingerprints, finding effective features for detecting the fingerprint liveness still remain unsolved. In this paper, a liveness detection method is proposed, which combines discriminative features obtained from Speeded-Up Robust Features (SURF), Pyramid Histogram of Oriented Gradients (PHOG) and texture features from Gabor wavelets. Apart from using these feature extraction methods individually, this paper mainly focus on feature level fusion of suggested methods. Experiment is done with Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Deep Neural Network (DNN) classifiers over LivDet 2013 database. It is found that the classification accuracy of the proposed detection technique is higher for DNN as compared to SVM classifier for different feature level fusion techniques.

articleTitle: Aerospace Compliant Test Bench to Verify Critical Aerospace Functionalities
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Contemporary aerospace systems are becoming complex to as they deliver complex functionalities. In the complex systems the software is also becoming complex and the hardware size is shrinking by usage of Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA's), and Programmable Logic Device (PLD's). IP core play a critical role in today's hardware and the certification of these is a challenge. For Aerospace, the IP core is to be complaint to the DO-254 standard. This paper provides the approach, design, and implementation of Aerospace Compliant Test Bench to verify the aerospace IP Cores. The efficacy of the Test Bench is demonstrated with A429 IP core as a case study.

articleTitle: Voltage Regulation Comparison of Novel Photo Voltaic Multilevel Inverter Topology during Nonlinear PV Generation
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In this manuscript, the voltage regulation of large-scale grid connected photovoltaic power plant (GCPPP) operating during nonlinear PV generation has been discussed. This manuscript proposes the comparative voltage regulation of a novel multilevel inverter with fuzzy and adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) control topologies for regulating the voltage of three phase grid-tied photovoltaic system under any nonlinear operating condition. An ANFIS based control scheme actively controls the PV inverter, which determines the power that must be generated to satisfy the grid demand. Due to the interruptible PV generation and at worst case scenarios the proposed control scheme is useful to satisfy the load demand by grid integration. The novelty in this research with novel inverter and ANFIS improves the dynamic performance, reduces the total harmonic distortion (THD) and efficiency is improved. The fuzzy and proposed ANFIS based control schemes are developed and simulated in MATLAB/Simulink environment and are compared at worst case solar generation and grid faults.

articleTitle: Trends of FPGA use in Automotive Engineering
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) devices have some very unique characteristics which make them adaptable and highly usable in various applications. Owing to those virtues, FPGA devices have become increasingly accepted and integrated into automotive engineering over the past decade. This paper is a study on the trends observed in the use of FPGA devices in automotive engineering, from 2004 to 2017.

articleTitle: SCADA Security in Various Industrial Sectors
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) system provides process automation, controls and monitors utility networks in various sectors. SCADA systems reflect the rapid growth and changes in the technological and networking industries. Increase in the network usage has exposed the system to security challenges. The control systems using the internet technologies are automated and modernized, cause of which they are exposed to security threats. The systems are vulnerable which, when leveraged, can cause severe damage to hardware, loss of production and threat to life. This paper explore application of SCADA technology in power, water and manufactural sectors of industry, the security methods adopted, different threats faced and recommendations to overcome them.

articleTitle: Modem ASIC Design with minimal power consumption for the IDU of a SATCOM terminal: RTL to GDS II
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The design & development of a Modem ASIC with reduced power consumption; forming a key part of the Indoor Unit (IDU) of a SATCOM terminal is presented in this paper. The inspiration behind developing a Low Power Modem ASIC is to reduce weight, volume, power, manufacturing effort and cost of the SATCOM Terminals intended for mobile applications. The ASIC is provided with programming interfaces (SPI & UART) to allow requisite registers to be loaded for enabling a specific application post-production. The reported modem ASIC can support various modulation schemes, FEC and data rates ranging from 2400bps to 40 Mbps; thus enabling a variety of multimedia applications. The paper also details the various types of power consumed in an ASIC along with the approaches to reduce them. Through an optimum mix of these mitigation techniques, chiefly memory gating; more than 50% reduction in power consumption / dissipation is achieved in the reported memory-intensive ASIC design. The final ASIC comprising nearly 2.7M logic gates is accommodated into a highly compact die size of 169mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> using 180 nm CMOS technology. Actual test results on realized prototypes show validation of all functional requirements and only 1.9 watts (@100 MHz System clock) of power consumption which is further reduced when compared to 3.65 watts obtained by power analysis tool (which considers certain margins.)

articleTitle: Towards Cognitive State Detection using Facial Expression and Hand-over-Face Gesture
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Facial expression recognition has gained attention from researchers in computer science, psychology, medicine and related fields and has grown spontaneously in recent years. However, most research focuses on posed expressions, near frontal recordings and they ignore eye gaze, head pose and considers hand occlusions as noise. Especially, in E-Learning environments, people often hold their hands near their face which occludes the face and limits the accuracy of facial expression recognition. There is empirical evidence that some of the hand-over-face gestures can be used for detection of cognitive states. In this paper, we propose to use hand-over-face gesture as novel cues and integrate facial expressions with hand-over-face gestures for recognition of cognitive states like interested, bored, unsure, happy and thinking. The proposed system is robust to variations in facial expressions, hand shapes, occlusions and performs an average recognition rate of 90.51% with 15.8 fps.

articleTitle: Spectrum sensing for Cognitive Radio using USRP and GNU Radio test bed environment
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The fast growing innovations in the wireless communication domain has led to increase in the number of users using the platform to carry out their respective tasks. Moreover it has led to demand on the frequency spectrum. The band allocation organization like FCC (Federal Communication Commission) has taken many steps in the band allocation policies. The demand on frequency spectrum is a key factor which has to be governed properly and suitable steps are to be implemented on the frequency spectrum monitoring. The Cognitive Radio is one such novel solution for spectrum management. The spectrum sensing is one of the main steps involved in the Cognitive radio. There are various methods of spectrum sensing and it will depend according to the type of signals which has to be scanned. To develop the cognitive radio approach the GNU platform is considered and its features are been described. The performance evaluation for various methods of spectrum sensing has been described in this paper. The IQ plot analysis of received FM signal, AIR PROBE GSM is a particular file (flow graph) which when executed allows the user to analyze the cell operator point information and also the GSM band which is already in use and the band utilization at different instances of time is analyzed. In the similar manner the cognitive radio approach can be applied to find whitespaces (unused band in Spectrum) in a given radio environment.

articleTitle: Behaviour Comprehension and Prediction Using Time Series Analysis of Data for Code Offloading in Mobile Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Mobile Cloud Computing involves leveraging the power of cloud environments by offloading mobile application code, so as to improve battery life and/or execution speed of mobile devices. In this paper, we propose a dynamic algorithm that selects the code to be offloaded based on expected values of CPU usage and data transfer of code units, calculated using a time-series analysis of app usage behaviour. We provide a framework for Android applications with facilities for demarcating code that can be offloaded and measuring CPU usage and data transfer during method calls at the class level. Data so collected are stored in the cloud. Time-series decomposition of the data is performed in R with dominant frequencies obtained from periodograms, Box-Cox Transformation and Auto-regressive models and forecasts made about CPU usage and data transfer. The time-series model in turn projects the actual behaviour patterns of app usage and thus helps in performing behaviour prediction. The app's classes are then partitioned using the predicted values, targeting minimization of battery usage. Our approach has a reduced impact on device battery as all decision making is carried out in the cloud and only public methods are profiled. For results, we use a custom app that implements our framework. We demonstrate behaviour understanding from the collected data and improvements to battery life of about 3.5%, with the framework introducing only a small latency of 0.12%. The merit over static decision-making schemes is seen in the ability to make more accurate battery gain predictions using dynamic factors.

articleTitle: A Smart Parking System using Internet of Things with Automated Payment System for Smart Cities
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: As the world is urbanizing, the usage of vehicles is exponentially increasing day by day and the availability of parking is becoming more difficult. The insufficient space for parking is resulting in traffic problems and chaos in public areas. The common method of finding a space for parking is manual system where driver would go around in search of vacant space for parking the vehicle. This takes time and effort and failing in finding a parking in the worst case. To overcome the problems caused by manual parking this paper proposes a system based on Internet of Things (IoT) technology which lessens the effort of the people in finding the parking by identifying the free slots in parking area and keeping the record of vehicles parked. The smart parking system allows user to book a parking lot prior to the parking and the notification about the slot booked is sent to the user and the system has an automated payment system where the bill amount is directly deducted from the user's account.

articleTitle: A Force Couple Approach for Cooperative Object Pushing of Rod Object with Multiple Robots
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Robots have been developed and used for addressing the intricate tasks present in the society. A single robot is not adequate when problem scenarios become complex. In such situations, a better solution could be achieved by efficiently employing multiple robots. The efficiency is achieved through the appropriate interactions of these robots. Cooperative object transportation with multiple robots is a miniature version of a real-world problem that a multi-robot system (MRS) should accomplish. A number of solutions have been proposed for this particular research problem from the early emergence of the MRS domain. But most of the solutions are focused on the transportation of box type object and hence the results could not be applicable to other object types. In cooperative object transportation problem, the transportation of a narrow rod type object with multiple robots has got very limited attention. In this work, a force-couple approach is proposed for the effective transportation of rod type objects with multiple robots and the effectiveness of the proposed solution is validated with the help of a 2D dynamic multi-robot simulator.

articleTitle: An Interactive Voice Controlled Humanoid Smart Home Prototype Using Concepts of Natural Language Processing and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Currently available interactive technologies and infrastructure such as open source hardware, increased processing power, artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), Natural Language processing (NLP) and connectivity through the internet, have led to a new definition of human living. Smart homes, smart streets, smart cities and eventually a smarter planet, is what humans are progressing towards. The boon in things being smart is that it involves automation and interactive technologies, something that we as humans prefer over introvert and monotonous characteristic of machines. However, most present systems have a physical entity like a remote or a personal device assistant (PDA) which is used to control our homes. When the access to these physical devices is lost, you can no longer control them. This paper addresses this very issue and proposes a solution which eliminates the need for any physical device. It proposes a multi- functional `Smart Home Automation System' (SHAS) controlled using an interactive and humanoid central processing unit which is powered by features of AI and NLP. Voice-commands to control the devices of the house such as fans, lights, doors, etc. can be given by the residents. The system is also intelligent enough to search things which it doesn't quite understand using the internet. The system has a camera integrated for continuously monitoring the home and also uses image processing techniques to identify the people trying to access the house. The system also has an automated mailing system which e-mails photos captured by the camera based on valid/invalid users. The system is aimed at being easy, cost-effective and non-physical.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Soft Pneumatic Actuator Powered Fin for Manta-ray Bot
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The main aim of the project is to build an intelligent manta-ray robot actuated by soft pneumatic actuators and is controlled by beagle bone blue running ROS. This project is divided into different modules such as structural, material, fin mechanisms, electronics and ROS-Robot operating system. In this paper, the work will involve evaluation of different soft actuator, CAD modeling and ABAQUS simulation of different fin mechanism driven by the selected soft actuators.

articleTitle: Implementation of dynamic slotted ALOHA protocol for RFID readers using Simple probability and Bayesian probability
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: RFID(Radio Frequency IDentification) is an emerging technique which uses radio waves for identification. One of the main application of RFID is equipment tracking in big logistics. But this is a major concern due to several disadvantages. Collision is one such issue which reduces the efficiency of RFID technique. Anti-collision protocols helps in reducing collision, but cannot eliminate it completely since readers are manufactured so as to read the most powerful tag that comes in its range. ALOHA (Abrahmson's Logic Of Hiring Access) based protocols are the commonly used anti-collision protocol in RFID network. This paper proposes two modifications of slotted ALOHA protocol that helps in efficient tracking. One is general probability based slot allocation method which can reduce the rate of tag missing and hence improve efficiency. Other method is a Bayesian probability based approach where the slot allocation is based on calculated posterior probability. Both approaches are used to increase the read operations of the mostly accessed reader thereby reducing the rate of tag missing.

articleTitle: LabVIEW based HP memristor simulator with hardware connectivity for real time circuit operation
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Memristor has emerged as fourth fundamental element in electronics. However, all the characteristics and functionalities of a memristor are yet to be understood. Main restriction behind wide spread research on this is lack of availability of a physical memristor. This paper presents an easy way to implement memristor simulator using LabVIEW, a powerful virtual instrumentation platform. Here ideal HP memristor model is implemented. Input signal is taken from a physical function generator. It is interfaced with the LabVIEW using an analog to digital converter (ADC) module. Mathematical model of the memristor is implemented virtually in LabView. Output is shown in Digital Storage Oscilloscope (DSO) which is interfaced with LabVIEW using a Digital to Analog converter (DAC) module. Using this setup, a pinched hysteresis loop in Voltage - Current (V - I) characteristics curve which is the signature of a memristor is observed. Shrinkage of loop area with the increment of input frequency is also been observed which concludes success full implementation of the model. Other Input-output parameters are plotted using waveform graph block in software interface. LabViewgraphical coding is used for all the necessary programmes to implement the model. Although, here ideal HP memristor model is implemented, it can be easily extended to any other memristor models.

articleTitle: 2D Based Indoor Slam and Autonomous Navigation Using a Terrain Robot
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: SLAM is the process of building the map of an unknown environment and simultaneously achieving localization when the map is being built. This paper presents a method to achieve this goal using a terrain robot and the method of approach is a probabilistic SLAM model, which requires finding an appropriate representation for both observation model and motion model. This method primarily involves utilizing the concept of grid maps to model the world and it does not rely on feature detection and purely depends on probability of occupancy of a cell in a particular grid and the depth image of the real time environment derived from the Kinect Sensor to build a map. To achieve localization scan matching is utilized which tries to align successive scans and tries to maximize the current position of the robot with respect to previous position using these scans. To achieve autonomous navigation, the map obtained from the above method is used, where we set the initial position estimate of the robot within the map and set navigation goal. To reach the goal it utilizes Dijkstras algorithm to optimise the path. The method also allows dynamic obstacle detection and avoidance, to reach the goal by recalculating the path around the obstacle. This Approach uses a KINECT which is a cheaper version of a LIDAR as a sensor. An on board mini laptop is used to do the minimum processing for SLAM which communicates wirelessly with a powerful remote Computer which can be used to view the map building and autonomous navigation process. It is successful in achieving both mapping and autonomous navigation with dynamic obstacle avoidance using just one IR sensor inbuilt within the KINECT.

articleTitle: Proposed Biometric Iris Recognition System Implementation Using Matlab
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In this paper, the software implementation of the automatic biometric iris recognition system using the proposed methodologies under unconstrained environments is being presented with the proposed block-diagrams developed in the Matlab environment. 6 different contributions are presented here in this paper, which is a part of the research work undertaken by the research scholar under the Ph.D. programme of the VTU. It also describes the various steps that are used in the proposed methodologies & all the basic blocks involved in the design process of each contributions. In order to achieve the better accuracy, performance and error rate than the existing methods done by earlier researchers, 6 different iris recognition system techniques under unconstrained environments have been proposed which involves different feature extraction techniques and matching or classification algorithms & some of them being compared with the earlier works done by other researchers, thus establishing the supremacy of the work done by us. Matlab tool is used for the software implementation purposes due to its add-on features and support provided. Codes are developed in the Matlab environment as. m files. The developed. m files are run, the simulation results are observed and the discussion on the simulation results are presented for each contributions. Finally, the overall conclusions are drawn on the observation of all the 6 contributory works. A number of algorithms for iris recognition has been designed as a part of the Ph.D. research work which is being presented in a abstracted manner in this research paper.

articleTitle: The Rapid Phrase Search Technique for Encrypted Document Present in the Cloud
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In recent years many researchers have been smitten by the benefits of cloud computing. However, in spite of countless advantages of cloud technologies, researchers have also been worried about its security and privacy concerns. Notably, it's about the storage and security of the confidential documents as well as maintaining privacy in datasets while preparing adequate retrieval and also other searching techniques have been recognized as one of the major issues in this particular area. To tackle the issues many researchers have proposed techniques and strategies which mostly deal with the conjunctive keyword search rather than a phrase search scheme. This leads to difficulty in identifying the phrases and some of the existing phrase search algorithms demand more storage cost than other conjunctive keyword techniques. We come up with a solution by introducing a novel approach in the field of encrypted searching that allows the rapid phrase exploring system to work easier. Our proposed work makes use of the incredible Bloom filter technology. To aid the functionality we have chosen n-grams. The technique emphasis on the response time by yielding the requested document to the user within no time. This scheme is adaptable to defending against inclusion-relation attack.

articleTitle: A Novel Biometric Based Remote User Authentication Scheme Using Smart Card with Session Key Agreement
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Remote user authentication process using smart card provides a simplest and efficient technique for communicating in a secure manner over an insecure network. A novel remote user authentication scheme using smart card is proposed in this current paper. This one is a single server authentication mechanism where user bio-metric is used. Here user and server mutually authenticate each other by message passing. A session key is generated at user side after mutual authentication. Security analysis performed over the scheme shows its resistance against most of the attacks.

articleTitle: Comprehensive study on the signaling schemes in on chip interconnects
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The continuous demand from the market for devices with more functionality per unit area may be met with aggressive improvement in scaling but have adverse effect on global interconnects thus having influence on delay as well as reducing system performance. The interconnect line drivers can be used to compensate the delay problem but its high dynamic power consumption to be taken care. One solution for this is to reduce Vdd but this can deteriorate the performance of the global interconnects line drivers unless low swing techniques are implemented. The low swing techniques suffer from increase in circuit complexity and large area usage. Also these techniques require additional circuitry like voltage generators and low-Vth devices. In an attempt to address these drawbacks, a new driver scheme has been designed, that has given improvement in terms of delay and power consumption, as well as noise immunity and leakage current. This paper gives a comparative study between the designed device and other drivers available.

articleTitle: Wind Energy Provision Monitoring in Karnataka Region
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This research paper is an attempt to collect information about the wind turbines performance in Karnataka using multi sensors system to collect the data about how much voltage and current is produced and to calculate the speed of the turbines, how it varies throughout the year and also to see the health condition of wind turbines. Mainly, should overcome the vibrations produced by the rotation of the wind turbines, because it damages the wind turbines i.e. reduces the life of turbines. Need to calculate the rotational speed and pitch angle, here pitch angle matters the speed of the rotation of the turbines, by this performance and efficiency of the turbines can be determined. Introducing the multi sensors in the wind turbines of Karnataka, to improve the data collection and efficiency of the wind turbines production. In Karnataka, wind turbines sites do not use the multi sensors system monitoring. It has to be installed to get know the correlation between the wind turbines working conditions and both electrical and vibration signals. No multi sensors system is used. Only the speed of the wind and turbines are calculated. At these monthly and hourly recordings are done, but those data may not help. Here at these this sites multi sensors system should be placed to calculate the speed of the wind, directions of the wind flowing(NEWS), rotational speed of the turbines, current and voltages produced, and all these data are continuously updated to the system. The overall efficiency can be calculated and proper action can be taken to produce good efficiency and increase the life duration the wind turbines. Instead of collecting data once in few months or years, receiving data daily based on the sensors used on the wind turbines to database system at a far distance from it.

articleTitle: Design of a fibre optic linked distributed control and monitor system for the ion source and its subsystems of a low energy 400kV accelerator
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: A fibre optic linked distributed control cum monitor system and various field interface circuits have been designed and developed in-house to facilitate control and monitoring an RF ion source and its subsystems of a low energy 400kV accelerator.
