The 400kV accelerator has been established indigenously at Materials Science Group, Indira Gandhi Centre for Atomic Research (IGCAR), Kalpakkam, Tamilnadu, India as part of a state of art dual ion irradiation facility. This dual ion irradiation facility has been set up to simulate synergistic effects of displacement damage and gaseous helium/hydrogen which is important in the context of development of radiation resistance materials for fast fission, fusion nuclear reactors and accelerator driven subcritical systems. A device interface node through its I/O boards is interfaced to the accelerator systems at the high voltage dome and is linked to a Loop Controller at the control computer located about 25 metres away from the accelerator using a pair of fibre optic cables. Graphical programming language LabVIEW based virtual instruments are used to create user-friendly and interactive panels for the control system. All the control and monitoring information are transmitted over the fibre optic loop up to 1.152 Mbaud rate, continually refreshing control outputs and scanning status inputs at a typical rate of 125Hz. The performance of the control system is found to be very good and the accelerator is regularly operated producing various gaseous ion beams like He<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>, He<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">++</sup>, H<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>, Ar<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>with a typical yield of 10uA.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of DPLL for FPGA Based Carrier Recovery Loop: PSK Receiver for Digital Satellite Communication
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In this paper, we present the digital phase locked loop (DPLL) model for FPGA based carrier recovery loop in Phase Shift Keying (PSK) receiver. The main design goal is to transform S- domain Analog PLL to the Z-domain of DPLL without redesigning model. Additionally, this paper present design, analysis, mathematical modelling, mathematical analysis of algorithms which are Impulse-Invariance Algorithm (IIA), Zero-Order Hold Algorithm (ZOHA), Bilinear Transform Algorithm (BLTA) and Matched Pole-Zero Algorithm (MPZA). Design of DPLL which is based on all discretization algorithms are presented and simulated using MATLAB 13a and Xilinx ISE 14.7 system generator. We present the comparative analysis of simulation from which it is found that BLTA is the most celebrated algorithm. Moreover, The BLTA based structure of DPLL adapts the response to allow the DPLL to lock faster than other discretized DPLL. Analysis and steps of the discretization algorithms is discussed and results of MATLAB and Xilinx ISE 14.7 system generator are presented for FPGAs and ASICs based platform.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Churn Rate Using Modified Random Forest Technique in Telecom Industry
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In recent years, the competition between telecom industries has widely enhanced. Therefore, to remain strong in this fierce market of telecom industries, the understanding of subscriber's need is become an essential factor, especially those subscribers which are trying to switch their telecom partner. Thus, to retain those customers, the customer churn estimation is become a mandatory requirement which can be achieved using Big Data Analytics and Data Mining techniques. Therefore, we have introduced a modified random forest algorithm to estimate customer churn rate in telecom industry using data mining techniques. This technique provides an extra layer to enhance accuracy using random variables and avoid over fitting. This technique helps to avoid regression problems often occurs while predicting churn rate. The performance of our proposed random forest technique is tested on Orange dataset. Experimental results verifies superiority of our proposed modified random forest algorithm in contrast to conventional churn estimation algorithms in terms of accuracy, error rates and area under curve (AVe). So that it can predict churn rate in a much better way which helps telecom industries to retain their customers.

articleTitle: A Secure Telemedicine framework based on Paillier Cryptosystem
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Nowadays, Telemedicine and medical imaging has been refined on a large scale in the eHealth electronic process. Telemedicine provides the clinical health care from a distance by using information technology and telecommunication. In rural areas, the access-able of improved medical services cannot be available and the distance barriers can be overcome by the telemedicine. The Medical Images (MI) are affected by the transmission bandwidth while sending and there are no memory spaces for storing the data. To solve these issues faced by the telemedicine, compression of image was introduced. In the proposed paper, the Online Region based-Active Contour Model (OR-ACM) is applied to segment the images and finally the images are compressed by applying the Quantized Discrete Wavelet Transform (Q-DWT) algorithm for reducing the storage. The encryption of the images can be processed by Paillier Cryptosystem (PC) and these encrypted data are saved in the Cloud Storage Providers (CSP). Various tests were organized on the approach, and these results provided the framework provided better performance at the point of recall (sensitivity), precision (specificity) and accuracy compared to the existing methods.

articleTitle: Area Optimization for Radiation Hardened Combinational Circuits Using Logical Masking
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: With the continuously shrinking feature sizes and associated low-operating voltages, combinational logic is becoming more vulnerable to soft errors and hard errors generated by the radiation environment. Hard errors generated by radiation produce permanent damage to the microelectronic devices while soft errors produce temporary transient erroneous output. In this work only soft error generated by the radiation is considered and various mechanisms influencing it are presented. There are various radiation hardening by design (RHBD) methods to overcome and remove the soft errors generated by the radiation environments in the microelectronic devices. In this work there is a basic emphasis on utilization of logical masking to identify the gates in the circuit to be hardened to get a desired accuracy at the output towards SET. By which gates can be selectively hardened in a circuit to reduce area. All analysis and calculation is done with the CMOS 0.18 μm technology.

articleTitle: Preface
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Developments in the connected fields of Information, Communication, Networking, Control Systems and Signal Processing, has a profound effect on the emergence of modern technologies and their influence on our lives. articleTitle: Retraction Notice: Identification of Efficient Features for Detection of diabetes through Iris patterns
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Iridodiagnosis is one of the diagnostic strategies in Naturopathy that relies upon changes in Iris for diagnosing disease conditions it's an alternative diagnostic technique using which several diseases are detected through the Iris patterns, colors, and other characteristics. More than 62 million individuals in India are currently diagnosed with_Type 2Diabetes Mellitus [1]. We have developed a non-invasive tool which apart from detecting diabetes can also identify pre-diabetes and objectively ascertain subjective I risk to develop diabetes in the recent future._This project aims to develop a quantitative non-invasive tool for detection of diabetes. Early diagnosis of diabetes might facilitate taking appropriate life- style interventions in preventing diabetes_Images of Iris from diabetic and non-diabetic individuals were obtained using Iris scope and areas in the iris representing liver area_were isolated through segmentation,_extraction of spatial features from GLCM and the features such as contrast, correlation, homogeneity, dissimilarity, difference variance and entropy were identified as the most efficient for classification.

publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Iris picture examination for clinical analysis is a standout amongst the most productive non-obtrusive finding techniques for deciding wellbeing organ's status. articleTitle: Design of LVDT for Aeronautical Jet Engines
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Modern aircraft systems mainly uses electronic instruments which plays a crucial role to know the position of different control surfaces. Generally, transducers and sensors are used for this purpose, Linear Variable Displacement Transducer (LVDT) transducers are mainly used. The most important characteristic of an aircraft is its ability to control the angular velocity this is called thrust vectoring also known as gas-dynamic steering. Thrust vectoring makes the aircraft highly maneuverable at low speeds and capable of near-zero airspeed at high angles of attack without stalling. The key requirement for this is knowing the position of the control surfaces on the engine nozzle, the device for this is a LVDT. One more the most challenging is sensing the position of the thrust nozzles for thrust vectoring due to high temperature variation during flight. This paper describes the design of the LVDT for the thrust vectoring application and provides the concept to making the LVDT temperature invariant.

articleTitle: Eye Controlled Wheel Chair
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Surveys states that there are 40 persons per millions that effects with quadriplegia disease per annum. Scientists like Stephen Hawking had suffered from this disability. Independent mobility cannot be achieved under the presence of caretakers. It is difficult for the disabled people to move outside on their own due to their physical disability or unable to move like normal people. The objective of this paper is to develop a wheel chair which operates depending on the eye movements. People having quadriplegia can move their pupils, eye brows and can tilt their head. These limited movements can be used as an opportunity for controlling the movement of wheel chair in this paper. The developed model has two parts, firstly detecting the pupil's direction and, next controlling the motors that are attached to the wheel chair. The first task stated above is performed by a web camera and those images are processed by raspberry pi. The output from the raspberry pi is given to wheelchair motors. An ultra sonic sensor is attached to the wheel chair to An ultrasonic sensor is used to identify any objects in front of it and halt the moving wheel chair for a while.

articleTitle: Design of 3-bit Current Mode Flash ADC
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Analog to digital converters (ADC) consists of various components namely, resistor ladder, comparator array, thermometer-to-binary encoder, etc. An error free and highspeed comparator is an important component in ADCs with high resolution and good speed. The choice of comparator as well as thermometer-to-binary encoder has a significant impact on ADC operation. There are various popular architectures of high speed comparators; dynamic latch being the most commonly used. This paper provides a comprehensive study about various dynamic latched comparator circuits, by comparing their performance, power dissipation characteristics and delay profile. The comparator circuits that are analyzed in this paper are: Preamplifier Latch Comparator, Dynamic latch with inverter buffer and Differential pair dynamic latch comparator. Their design is simulated using 180nm technology in CADENCE VIRTUOSO platform. Simulation results are tabulated, and analysis has been done with graphical representation. Based on comparison between the three simulated comparators, a 3- bit flash ADC with optimum comparator characteristics has been simulated using the same platform. Further, its design is analyzed, and results are tabulated.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Integrated ADC & DAC with PLL for future communication systems
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The main constraints in the current communication scenario is the requirement of high speed Analog to Digital Converter's & Digital to Analog Converter's with the low power, area & cost implementation with acceptable performance measures. The current trends of transceivers are designed based on the stand alone ADC & DAC with the clock given externally. In this paper, the comparison between the stand alone ADC & DAC with the integrated ADC & DAC with Phase Locked Loop is carried out. The hardware implementation is made with the IC's interfaced to FPGA. The characterization is carried out with respect to the utilization of integrated ADC & DAC in the Small cells for Long Term Evolution communication. The LTE Time Division Duplex bands are generated & captured using standalone ADC & DAC and integrated ADC & DAC with PLL. The results show that the integrated ADC performance over LTE TDD bands is degraded in terms of SNR by 12.61%, Spurious Free Dynamic Range by 13.40% and integrated DAC performance is degraded in terms of SNR by 11.97%, SFDR by 12.96%. From the results, it is evident that the performance variation is less than 15%, which will be the trade-off when using integrated ADC & DAC with PLL for low power, cost & area implementations.

articleTitle: Electro-Hydraulic Actuation System Modeling using Bond Graph Technique
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Electro Hydraulic Actuation Systems (EHAS) are used in various applications where in high magnitude of forces are exerted. These systems are interdisciplinary comprising components from Mechanical, Electrical and Hydraulic domains. Multi domain simulation environment is required to model these systems. We used the Bond graph theory to model the EHAS systems. Using Bond graph theory, models we can directly generate the differential equations pertaining to multi domain system components. Further, system's state space models have been described. This paper, describes in detail, the methodology and application of bond graph theory, in generating differential equations and converting them to state space models and simulation of closed loop dynamic response of EHAS in MATLAB/Simulink environment.

articleTitle: Mitigation of power quality issues in EAF using UPQC
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: At present Power quality deterioration is a burning issue in distribution system due to rapid usage of non-linear loads. Electric arc furnace is one of the nonlinear load which is stochastic in nature and quite complex to design. Electric arc furnace has been modeled based on V-I characteristics. In this study two different models were developed. The performance of these models were compared and the best modeled has been selected and used for harmonic analysis. A UPQC device has been incorporated for mitigating the power quality problem. Modelling and Simulation of work is presented using MATLAB/SIMULINK Software.

articleTitle: Implementation of DVB Standards using Software-Defined Radio
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The budding of novel technologies enables any process to happen more efficiently and rapidly. One such technology is Software-Defined Radio (SDR), which plays a very important role in telecommunications, military sectors, etc. SDR being a flexible transceiver comprises the hardware part- Universal Software Radio Peripheral (USRP, here USRP B210) and the software part-GNU Radio. Also, video transmission/ broadcasting plays a vital role in the field of communications. Stereotypical digital video broadcasting systems used fixed modulation schemes that had to provide reliable communication even in unfavorable channel environments. This paper aims at designing Digital Video Broadcasting- Terrestrial/Satellite (DVB-T/T2/S/S2) transmitter and receiver with a suitable modulation technique. The video is thus transmitted in real-time using USRP and GNU Radio. The transmitted video is simulated and tested with different code rates, modulation schemes and modes of transmission.

articleTitle: Ultrasonic Frequency MEMS Disk Resonator For Energy Harvesting Application
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: MEMS resonator is a micro-vibrating mechanical structure which is capable of vibrating at its resonant frequency. The resonator is usually excited at its fundamental resonance mode called as natural mode of vibration. However, excitations at its higher-order modes are also possible. The novel techniques to fabricate the micro-resonating structure on the flexible substrate are also discussed in this paper. MEMS resonators have been widely used in various applications. The micro-vibrating structure with their high quality factors, small size, low power consumption, and low cost batch fabrication, makes it promising way for wide application. The comparative analysis of the two emerging materials i.e ZnO and AIN are done among which the most suited has been suggested for the energy harvesting application. This paper presents the analysis and modeling of out of plane MEMS disk resonator. The main parameters that describe the operation of the disk are the natural frequency, material choice, mode of vibration.

articleTitle: Boat Navigation and Safeguard of Passenger's Over Flood Disaster
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The advancement of effective surge flood disaster framework turned out to be additionally testing from most recent couple of years. Many accidents caution made people's life in danger when it comes to flood accidents which is natural disaster, cannot be stopped but can able to make possible for the protection of people's life. The main aim is to develop a versatile and automatic system for detecting the obstacle by using ultrasonic sensor and controls the boat directions by using Bluetooth module. By using water level sensor, detects flood disaster and provides protection by enclosing the boat within the fraction of seconds. Once it get enclosed, Oxygen module are used to provide oxygen to survive the passenger's life and awakes them through a buzzer and sends the information through a Global System for Mobile Communication (GSM) via SMS By utilizing IP web camera, takes the live gushing video of the encompassing things that can be viewed as a recorded/live video on the PC. This system will help to drive the boat in the required direction to avoid the obstacle or the opposite boat collision. And it concludes that there is a possibility to rescue the affected people at the time of flood.

articleTitle: Current Mode Full Wave Rectifier Topology for Integration
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: A current mode full wave rectifier is presented. Circuit is made up of only six cmos transistors. This assembly of cmos is simulated on using Cadence Virtuoso simulation software with its gpdk180 model., i.e. 0.18μm technology. Layout of the design is also presented for integration of the circuit. Rectifier is accurate and precision for low current signals., and for currents with high value its W/L ratio can be adjusted to get the desired output. Rectifier works properly upto 20MHz frequency.

articleTitle: Image Fusion Using Wavelet Transform and GLCM Based Texture Analysis for Detection of Brain Tumor
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Brain tumor is a cancerous growth of abnormal cells in the brain which is either caused by uncontrolled growth of cells in a specific organ or due to lesions caused by radiation exposure. It is one of main leading causes of death among children and adults. The objective of this paper is to implement associate innovative methodology for detection of brain tumors here during this paper wavelet-based image fusion algorithm is applied to CT (CT) and resonance (MRI) images to extract the redundant and complementary data so as to enhance the detected tumor within the consolidated image. Moreover, to produce better spatial resolution wiener filtering and contrast limited adaptive histogram equalization (CLAHE) is performed to obtain a high contrast fused output image. Gray level co-occurrence matrix is applied for texture analysis.

articleTitle: Intelligent Ground Vehicle for Landmine Detection and Removal
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Robot application for defense and security is an important topic for research. Proper detection of a weapon and its removal can prevent loss of innocent lives. With such a purpose in mind, this paper proposes an intelligent ground vehicle which has been designed for detecting such landmines and a model of a robotic arm is suggested for its removal and detonation using cost effective methods. Various sensors are implemented for the detection part and a simple servo motor run prototype of a robotic arm is used for removal. The key highlight of this vehicle is that it is driverless and has obstacle detection Moving from point A to point B can be done by the vehicle in which the human interface is only required to give points A and B and also to carefully operate the robotic arm.

articleTitle: Generalized Synchronization of Uncertain Chaotic Strict-Feedback Form of Systems via Adaptive Control Method
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Lyapunov's stability-based back-stepping approach is commonly used to design controller for systems which are in strict-feedback form. The Strict feedback form refers to the fact that non-linear terms in the system equation depend only on states returning to the system. The above approach is used for non-linear systems which are in recursive form. This paper proposes an adaptive control law and parameter updation laws to design a generalized form of adaptive controller to synchronize the strict feedback class of nonlinear systems with the help of back-stepping approach. Here, drive and response system's parameters are considered to be completely unknown and uncertain. Designed adaptive controller is applied to strict-feedback class of non-linear systems viz. Rossler system and Genesio system separately to validate and visualize the result of the proposed work using MATLAB.

articleTitle: A Fuzzy based Approach to Cluster Formation in Wireless Sensor Networks to Enhance the Lifetime of the Network
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Energy efficient routing of information from sensing node to sink is achieved using clustering of nodes, thereby reducing the number of hops and rotating the role of the cluster head among the sensor nodes periodically. The life time of the network is further enhanced by reducing the number of control packets (overhead) in the network. The process of cluster formation is as follows. (1) The fuzzy c-means (FCM) algorithm is used by the sink to find cluster centers and their associated member nodes with a high membership grade. At the beginning of the network operation, the sink selects a node randomly from the associated members of each cluster center and broadcasts them as cluster heads. (2) Cluster heads broadcast (with highest transmission power) the advertisement of their selection as cluster head for the next round. The nodes in the network choose the nearest cluster head to form the clusters. Thus the cluster formation is adaptive and distributed. (3) At the end of each round, the nodes transmit their fitness to become the next cluster head to their respective current cluster head that in turn is forwarded to the sink. We assume that each node in the network compute its fitness to become the next cluster head using some network parameters. (4) The sink selects a node with highest fitness value from each cluster center associated member nodes as cluster head for the next round and broadcasts. Hence the selection of the cluster heads by the sink is centralized using FCM which helps to disperse the cluster heads throughout the network. (5) Above steps are repeated from step 2 till the death of the last sensor node in the network. The lifetime of the network is measured in terms of number of rounds, first node death (FND), half node alive (HNA) and last node death (LND) in the network.

articleTitle: A 2.4GHz LNA with Active Inductor in RF Transceiver for WBAN
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Emanation of wireless body area network (WBAN) augmented the high secured data transmission from human body to the outside world. The importance of efficient RF transceivers plays an relevant role, which consist of low noise amplifier(LNA), band pass filter, ADC for the receiver side. This paper mainly deals with LNA which is the very essential part of LNA. The topology used here to design LNA is source degeneration with cascaded structure. LNA consist of spiral inductor which consumes more area and lack in quality factor, this spiral inductor is replaced by an active inductor. Active inductor used LNA gives a gain of 70.61dB, noise figure of 12.673dB and high SNR of 57.942dB. The frequency range used to design LNA is at 2.4GHz of ISM band, this frequency range is out of radiation hazards. The LNA is designed at 180nm technology using CADENCE VIRTUOSO.

articleTitle: A Miniaturized Dual band Antenna loaded with L and G-shaped slots for WiMAX/WLAN Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: A miniaturized patch antenna operating at 3.2(WiMAX) and 5.1 GHz (WLAN) band is presented. The slotted ground approach is used to accomplish miniaturization and multiband operation in the proposed structure. The achieved miniaturization corresponding to lower resonance in patch area and volume is approximately 86% and 79.7%, respectively. The antenna has an impedance bandwidth ranging from 3.15-3.28GHz centered at 3.2GHz and 4.93-5.3GHz centered at 5.1GHz. The antenna shows good impedance match, stable polar pattern and radiation efficiency greater than 70% at the targeted frequency.

articleTitle: Image Encryption using SCAN Patterns & Hill Cipher
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Encryption can be done in many ways for transport of image, data, video and audio over wireless networks. A new technique for image encryption is proposed in this paper. The method uses a combination of SCAN patterns, carrier image and Hill-cipher technique. This ensures more security for the image. The SCAN is a language based spatial accessing methodology generating a wide range of scanning paths. The carrier image is created with the help of an ASCII string. The obtained carrier image together with the payload is encrypted with SCAN patterns and XOR operation is performed between them. Then Hill-cipher technique is applied for the resultant image to obtain the final encrypted image. Applying reverse operation to the encryption process, the decrypted images are retrieved.

articleTitle: Analysis of asymmetrical damper for improving ride comfort of passenger cars
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In this paper, semi-active suspension employing asymmetrical dampers is studied for purpose of improving the ride comfort. The variation of asymmetrical ratio and its effect on ride comfort is analyzed. The performance of the system with asymmetrical dampers is compared with symmetrical damper and the analysis is validated by simulation on MATLAB/Simulink for variety of road profile such as rounded step, bump and trough and ISO class C.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of Micro-ring Resonator for Bio-sensing Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a micro-ring resonator for bio-sensing application is designed. The micro-ring resonator is designed with a single ring waveguide and two bus waveguides. The light traverse through the drop port of bus waveguide and couples to the ring waveguide is observed for various refractive indices. The analysis of the design with various refractive indices is performed by varying the covering medium on the top surface of the waveguide structure. The resonance parameters like free spectral range, transmission spectrum and resonance shifts are observed in the modeling of the micro-ring resonator.

articleTitle: Smart Phone Wireless Ad-Hoc Mesh Network
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In this paper, we evaluate the Wi-Fi mesh network that provides mesh networking for sharing the data between two or more nodes using Wi-Fi without the internet connection, to solve the problems related to infrastructure-based networks. We use 802.11 MAC and Optimized Link State Routing (OLSR) routing protocol to realize the MANET prototype and to establish multi-hop connections between android devices radius. We realize this prototype using Android based mobiles and using Expected Transmission Count (ETX) routing metric as the congestion information. We have also used Hop count as congestion information for the comparison purpose. The paper evaluates the effectiveness of ETX and Hop count using two scenarios namely varying number of hops and varying node mobility with respect to end-to-end delay. The results reveal that ETX based OLSR protocol and 802.11 MAC protocol can be used to realize the MANET for efficient data dissemination and decision making.

articleTitle: Coordinates Based Clustering Technique in Device to Device Communication
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: To increase the energy and spectral efficiency in the field of communication, a new technique named Device to Device Communication (D2D) is proposed. This is very essential as there has been a massive growth in the number of connected devices now a days. D2D takes advantage of the physical proximity of communication devices and enables direct communications between them (i.e.) devices communicate with each other without the intermediate nodes. This proximity of devices helps in achieving extremely high bit rates, low delays, and low power consumption. Although there are many benefits of D2D, the implementation of it is very strenuous. There are a number of challenges need to be addressed before establishing a successful D2D connection. One among those is the clustering of devices. Clustering is the grouping of devices based on a particular criteria. In this paper, we first created nodes, found which devices are capable of forming a D2D link, divided them into clusters and then found the cluster head (CH) for each cluster. Finally we plotted graphs for throughput versus the threshold SNR and the distance between the links.

articleTitle: Performance analysis and survey on security of password managers and various schemes of p2p models
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: A password is a string of characters which is used to check the authenticity of a user. Nowadays, with the growth of number of application every user uses, it becomes practically impossible to remember so many complex passwords and it is not secure to reuse passwords on different applications. This is where a password manager comes into the picture. A password manager is an application which provides a convenient way of storing credentials of different applications in a single place. The encryption scheme being used have serious concerns over data confidentiality. To keep the user's credentials secure from attacks, we require a stronger encryption scheme coupled with an efficient network design. To provide Security and Access control over a specific network, there are various encryption schemes. In this paper, we analyze and explore the different techniques of encryption as well as the structure of various p2p network models.

articleTitle: Reliability Analysis of Flight Control System under Perfect and Imperfect Fault Coverage
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Systems such as aircraft control need very high levels of reliability, so redundancy is adopted for acquiring the same. The reliability of the system gets affected due to the coverage. When a component in a system fails, the detection and isolation of the system are less than perfect. This is called as coverage. Fault Coverage Model is of two types, Perfect Fault Coverage Mode (PFCM) and Imperfect Fault Coverage Mode (IFCM). In PFCM, coverage is perfect i.e. its value is unity while in IFCM, coverage is not perfect i.e. it can take any value other than unity. Flight Control System (FCS) also falls under this category. FCS consists of sensor, computer, actuator and two communication channel. In this paper, three different configurations of FCS are considered in terms of Redundancy Corporation. For all the three systems, reliability indices for both PFCM and IFCM have been calculated by considering communication channel as perfect and imperfect. It has been observed that IFCM reliability is less than PFCM, hence IFCM depicts true system. Then, some comparisons have been done among the reliability of three systems under perfect/imperfect fault coverage by taking communication system as perfect and imperfect. Hence, out of these three systems best one is pointed out.

articleTitle: Evidence Based Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference System for ASD Detection
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is an intricate neuro disorder. It affects people's brain development and social behavior. Numerous researches have been evolved based on the etiology of the disorder. However, the transcriptomic study of blood-based gene expression can provide complete insight into autism and eventually it can be used as a diagnostic biomarker. Depth knowledge associated with the gene expression can be utilized in the prediction of the genes that causes autism namely the candidate genes. Most of the statistical approaches and regression analysis are employed for autism candidate gene detection, which in turn involves complexity in processing highly dense data. The classification of the candidate gene is not yet performed efficiently. In this paper, a novel framework that has been proposed comprises of the Adaptive neuro-fuzzy system (ANFIS) to classify the mutants that can cause autism. The evidence database incorporates identified autism genes from various databases. The gene expression omnibus database GSE26415 is utilized for implementation of the proposed work.

articleTitle: Fast and Multiplierless Integer DCT for HEVC
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Demand of high quality image and video increases day by day. Quality is directly proportional to data size so there is need of compression. Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) very popular in Latest Video codec standards because of its energy compaction and decorrelation properties. High Efficiency Video Codec (HEVC) is latest video codec technique which uses 4×4 to 32×32 basis vector for transformation. We implemented Input Adder Unit (IAU), Shift and Add Unit (SAU) and Output Adder Unit (OAU) of 1D and 2 D DCT of 4×4 and 8×8. This paper proposes SAU which has less Area Delay Product (ADP). Implementation is performed on Xilinx Spartan-3E FPGA, The proposed Hardware SAU takes 110 (4×4), 321(8×8) LUTs and 70(4×4), 212(8×8) slice registers with 494.56(4×4), 1143.216(8×8) ADP. By implementing our SAU into 1D as well as 2D DCT it takes 321 LUTs, 212 slice registers, 1410.4 ADP for 4×4 1D DCT architecture 1477 LUTs, 922 slice registers, 6489.9 ADP for 8×8 1D DCT architecture, 1284 LUTs, 847 slice registers, 5641.8 ADP for 4×4 2D DCT architecture 86 LUTs, 58 slice registers, 368.3 ADP for 8×8 2D DCT architecture. We also proposed Flexible Architecture from which User can switch between 4×4 and 8×8 Architecture according to application.

articleTitle: Generating Timing and Control Signals for C-Band T/R Module using FPGA
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The main objective of this paper is to design FPGA based controller for C-band T/R Module. The T/R Module is the basic building block of phase array polarimetric weather radar. Phase array polarimetric radar have the different mode of operations and beam produces by the antenna can be steered electronically as compared to single target radars, conventionally used in defense and other applications. The various parameters like phase angle, attenuation, PRF and pulse width can be varied in accordance with the operational mode is implemented in Xilinx XC6SLX16-CSG324 Spartan 6 FPGA SP601.

articleTitle: Development and enhancement of CFR estimate in WLAN and testing in Vector Signal Transceiver
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Use of Wireless Local Area Networks (WLAN) has dominantly supported the field the wireless communication in achieving high data rates and security. Instead of sending a single copy of data from transmitter to receiver, it is preferable to send copies of the same data to maintain the integrity of the information. This includes preamble or pilot symbols prior to data. Modern OFDM receivers complying to 802.11n / ac / ax WLAN standards use legacy equalizer training sequence (L-LTF) to equalize SIG symbols, which carry details pertaining to the Data being transmitted. However, Data itself is equalized using HT / VHT / HE- LTFs. The aim of this project is to leverage the legacy CFR, in conjunction with the actual one, to compute a better response to equalize Data. This helps in characterizing the transmitter more accurately to provide the best possible Error Vector Magnitude (EVM) result to the customer. A novel Channel Frequency Response (CFR) combining technique for equalizer training of data is presented in this paper. The results include a comparison of EVM values for both with and without equalizer training in LabView.It also includes the test results of the same in NI PXIe Vector Signal Transceiver (VST) hardware.

articleTitle: Predictive Risk Analysis For Loan Repayment of Credit Card Clients
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Defaults on credit card loans lead to a lot of consumer debt and other major problems for banks and financial institutions. This paper compares five different data mining techniques to differentiate between those credit card customers who default on their credit card payments and those who don't. Some techniques use classifiers to identify whether a customer will default on his or her payment such as multi-layer perceptron classifier, while other techniques calculate the probability of defaulting such as logistic regression. Among the classifier techniques used, MLP classifier gives us the best accuracy of identifying the defaulters and Logistic Regression helps us identify some significant factors which have a direct impact on predicting whether a customer will be able to make his or her payment.

articleTitle: Cost Effective Overload and Theft Detection for Power Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In today's era, electricity is the essential commodity for the daily routine of mankind. Among the certain issues with the generation and distribution of electricity, the issue of additional economical burden due to power theft taking place is discussed in this paper. The different techniques used for power theft are presented. A prototype model is developed for overload and theft detection. The system is prepaid type where GSM and IOT based communication is used to send the alarms to the control station. The system has been tested under variable load conditions and optimum results are obtained.

articleTitle: Digital Image Watermarking using Tenth Root of Exponential Function
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In this paper, digital image watermarking using tenth root of exponential transformation has been introduced in the frequency domain. In the proposed technique, the secrete image is first encrypted and compressed using exponential function and then embedded into the host image. The resultant images obtained from the proposed algorithm is subjected for various security attacks and the results are compared with the other existing algorithms. The results obtained are better compared to the existing techniques.

articleTitle: Power Conditioning System for a Vortex Turbine based Micro Hydro Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Harnessing energy from flowing rivers is now an emergent micro-hydro power scheme being adopted all around the world. The fact that it requires less infrastructure and that it is environment friendly makes it even more cost effective and reliable than the conventional micro-hydro schemes involving the construction of dams. This paper presents the analysis and simulation of an electrical power conversion system for a grid-connected variable speed micro-hydro turbine (MHT) power plant. Different from traditional hydro power systems, the MHT runs at variable speeds due to the change in rate of flow of the river and the vibrations at the turbine blades. The output of the system is highly dependent on the rainfall rate. A fuzzy logic controlled boost converter, using P&O algorithm to extract maximum power out of the system, is used to maintain a constant dc link voltage for the inverter. This enables the converter to be dynamically efficient and track the maximum power during variation in output voltage of the generator. A current controlled three leg grid connected inverter working in synchronous dq reference frame is used for the grid connection.

articleTitle: Data Hiding in Speech Signal Using Steganography and Encryption
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Data privacy and data security are always on highest priority in the world. We need a reliable method to encrypt the data so that it reaches the destination safely. Encryption is a simple yet effective way to protect our data while transmitting it to a destination. The proposed method has state of art technology of steganography and encryption. This paper puts forward a different approach for data hiding in speech signals. A ten-digit number within speech signal using audio steganography and encrypting it with a unique key for better security. At the receiver end the same unique key is used to decrypt the received signal and then hidden numbers are extracted. The proposed approach performance can be evaluated by PSNR, MSE, SSIM and bit-error rate. The simulation results give better performance compared to existing approach.

articleTitle: Skeleton Bone Age Assessment Using Optimized Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: BAA helps to detect the growth disorders and forecast the height of patients with short height. Bone Age Assessment is a strategy often performed in pediatric radiology. In view of radiological examination of skeletal improvement of a left-hand wrist, the bone age is surveyed and after that contrasted and the sequential age. An error between these two values shows variations in skeletal advancement. BAA is used to evaluate the skeleton maturity of children. Evaluating the bone age assessment is a significant way of the management way in children with several of growth ad endocrine disorder. In this assessment techniques are famous to estimate the growth rate of children. To find the hormone issues like diabetes, thyroid and obesity and genes disorder i.e., chromosome abnormalities and genes delete. The BAA systems are widely used in the medical field for estimating the growth rate of a child and finding the growth disorders, endocrine disorders and hormone problems. Many computer-based classification systems that employ machine learning approaches (e.g. Neural Networks, Fuzzy Classifiers, Hidden Markov Models, etc.) one of the main limitations is the lack of methods to model bone shapes effectively and dynamically. In this research work, Implement the OANN (Optimized Artificial Neural Network)/ Hybrid algorithm to enhance the accurate rate and complexity reduce the detection of the age based on bone. In base paper, they implemented the OANN for classification and detection rate achieve the system performance more than 95%. It can found the result in Bone age assessment with the enhancement of the mean square error rate, false acceptance rate, false rejection rate and standard deviation and compared with existing parameter.

articleTitle: Safe Drive: An Automatic Engine Locking System to Prevent Drunken Driving
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Internet of Things or IoT is a system of connected computing devices, mechanical devices and electronic sensors which communicate and collaborate with each other perform tasks as one unit without any human interaction. A” Thing” in an IoT system can be a person, a device or an object which is monitored by one or more sensors. The data collected by these sensors are transferred over a network to be processed and the result is then used to perform some useful task. In Internet of Things devices embedded in various systems are connected to the internet. These devices/objects represent themselves digitally and hence we can communicate and control them remotely. This sort of connectivity helps us capture more data from places and conditions which was previously not possible, this ensures more efficiency in all of our regular day today activities and improves safety and security. IoT is an emerging technology which has the potential to solve many social problems which the society is facing today, one such problem is Driving under Influence or Drunken Driving. Every year thousands of people are losing their lives due to road accidents and driving under the influence is one of the main reasons for these road accidents. IoT can help reduce the rate of accidents due to DUI by preventing reckless drivers from operating a motor vehicle under the influence of the alcohol, by embedding sensors into the vehicle we can monitor the driver and determine whether if he is drunk or not even before the driver starts the car.

articleTitle: Automatic Image Enhancement Using Evolutionary Optimization Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This paper presents a novel method of improving image quality using meta-heuristic algorithms such as Bat Algorithm, Cuckoo Search Algorithm and Interior Search Algorithm by contrast enhancement method. The performance of these algorithms are compared based on their ability to enhance the contrast, detail and sharpness of the gray scale image. These algorithms are used to generate optimal parameters to reach the global best of a fitness function which is then used to judge the enhancement achieved for the given image.

articleTitle: Compact Modeling based performance analysis of Trapezoidal Trigate SOI MOSFET
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In order to achieve high current drive and minimal Short Channel Effects (SCEs) in nanometer MOSFET, Intel introduced Trigate FET devices. The Trigate architecture enhances the electrostatic gate control of the channel and about 37% increase in carrier conduction over the bulk device has been reported. In this paper, a compact analytical model describing the potential distribution profile of trapezoidal Trigate Silicon-on Insulator MOSFET is proposed. The potential model is derived by solving three dimensional (3D) Poisson's equation using parabolic approximation and suitable boundary conditions. The model is verified by the uniformity among the results obtained from analytical model and TCAD simulations. The superiority of trapezoidal Trigate structure is demonstrated by contrasting the results with the rectangular structure of trigate Silicon-on Insulator MOSFET.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Photonic Crystal Fiber Using Different Structures
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In this paper a comparison is performed among different types of solid core photonic crystal fibers (PCFs) whose structural shape is hexagonal, octagonal and decagonal having five rings of air holes for each structure. Various key characteristics of PCF chosen for an efficient analysis are confinement loss, effective area, chromatic dispersion and nonlinear coefficient. Finite element method (FEM) is used for simulating PCFs structure by Comsol Multiphysics 5.0 software tools. For each structure background material is silica, ratio of diameter of the air hole (d<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">h</sub>) and pitch constant (Λ) is d<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">h</sub>/Λ=0.5. According to numerically simulated results, it is revealed that at 1.55 μm wavelength, hexagonal PCF has low dispersion value which is -37.4 ps/(km.nm). Decagonal PCF offers low value of confinement loss as well as effective area which are 3.21×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-10</sup> dB/m and 3.126 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> respectively at 1.55 μm wavelength. Nonlinear coefficient of decagonal PCF is low compared to decagonal. Optical properties of octagonal PCF are intermediate between hexagonal and decagonal PCF. Hexagonal PCF is appropriate for applications like dispersion compensation fiber and decagonal PCF is suitable for supercontinuum generation.

articleTitle: A Controller for Hybrid Microgridwith Battery Storage in Utility Connected and Isolated Mode of Operation
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This paper deals with the analysis of a control strategy for hybrid microgrid with utility connected and isolated mode of operation. The controller achieves continuous and reliable supply to the loads during both utility connected and isolated mode of operation. Energy storage system helps to mitigate the variation in power of renewable energy sources. A DC-DC boost converter with maximum power point tracking is used to extract peak power from the PV source. A bidirectional buck boost converter with current control is used for charging and discharging the battery. A three phase voltage source converter transfers power from DC subgrid to AC subgrid. Control techniques used are Vf control for isolated mode of operation and PQ control for utility connected mode of operation. During isolated mode Vf control maintains the voltage and frequency constant. During utility connected mode PQ control controls power transferred by the microgrid. Smooth transition from utility connected to isolated mode of operation and vice versa is obtained using self-synchronisation control.

articleTitle: Waveform generator for RADAR using FPGA
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This paper presents a design of waveform generator, in which Radio Detection and Ranging (RADAR) waveforms are generated using Direct Digital Frequency Synthesizer (DDFS) technology and implemented on Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA). DDFS is designed using Coordinate Rotational Digital Computer (CORDIC) algorithm whose output amplitude has accuracy up to 5 decimal places. It has good resolution and better utilization of resources in a device which reduces overall system hardware size and cost. Proposed waveform generator has maximum output up to 2 MHz from reference clock frequency 27MHz.

articleTitle: A robust drum level control for boiler: A sliding mode approach
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The drum level is one of the essential parameter for stable, economic and safe operation of boiler plant. In this paper, a sliding mode based drum level control is presented. The proposed control is developed for eliminating the reaching phase using integral sliding mode control under model uncertainties. The performance analysis is carried out using step and ramp input to validate steady state characteristics by simulations using MATLAB-Simulink platform. The results are compared with conventional PID control. The optimal reduction in feedwater presents an improved performance over PID control. The reduction in feedwater supplied to boiler drum and chattering in control output are the advantages of the proposed control.

articleTitle: Hardware Implementation of Modular Multiplication
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Modular multiplication is initial operation for modular exponention to generate public key cryptography schemes. The modular exponentiation can be defined by repeated operation of modular multiplication. The performance of any public key cryptography system like RSA, ECC, is determined by the efficient implementation of the modular multiplication. Encryption/Decryption processes are time consuming so it is necessary to reduce time requirement and Area-Delay Product (ADP) of modular multiplications operation. To speed up the computation, Montgomery modular multiplication algorithm is used; this algorithm does all the process without using a trial division. Precomputation of the quotient is used to reduce the ADP (Area Delay Product). We proposed an algorithm which reduces ADP and speed up all operation. This algorithm supports up to 512-bits. Our proposed algorithm reduces ADP (area delay product) 28.18% and 42.94% compared to normal and fast Montgomery algorithm respectively.

articleTitle: Diabetes Data Prediction Using Spark and Analysis in Hue Over Big Data
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This paper deals in diabetes prediction by applying relevant data mining technique. The goal of data mining is knowledge extraction from the information that is stored in the dataset and also analyzing patterns. In the civilization there are number of health problems facing by the people and are not aware of the symptoms about why the sickness occurs. One of the health problems is the Diabetic Mellitus. The majority of the population is in front of with Diabetes. Now a day's people at younger age are also suffering with this problem. In this paper, we have used predictive analysis in HUE to foresee the diseases compose persistent and particulars related with it and the sort of behavior to be given. The dataset is collected from the Pima Indian database. This framework along with SVM Classification gives an effective method to count the number of persons who are suffering with diabetes.

articleTitle: Optical Fiber Communication Between Intra-Satellite Subsystems
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Optical fibers are widely used in fiber-optic communications, which permits transmission over longer distances and at higher bandwidths (data rates) than other forms of communications. Fibers are used instead of metal wires because signals travel along them with less loss, and they are also immune to electromagnetic interference. These advantages make it a viable system to be used in various high data rate systems including data communication in intra satellite systems. An optical transceiver converts digital signal to optical data which will be transmitted over the optical fibre and vice versa. To send data as light, it makes use of a light source (LASER or LED) and to receive light pulses, it makes use of a photodiode semiconductor. A PCB consisting of optical transceivers, FPGA, LVDS transmitter, receiver and buffers is designed to establish and characterize optical fiber communication between different subsystems in satellite. The proposed demonstration plan for data transmission and reception using Avionics Full Duplex (AFDX) Ethernet protocol for deterministic communication is discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: Rescheduling and Rerouting of Railways by Applying Petri Nets and Heuristic Search
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Rail transport is a means of getting moved from one position to another of passengers and goods on wheeled vehicles running on rails also expressed as track. The primary purpose of this paper is to highlight recent optimization prototypes for most frequently studied and researched difficulties in rail transportation. This paper analyzes mainly routing and scheduling problems as these essentially focus for planning activities executed by railways. Here Petri Net concept is used in railway system, here places represent rail resources and arcs represent movement of train up and down the way. A conflict resolution algorithm is a Petri Net based algorithm and has been amended from the well-known A* algorithm. It is intended to examine an optimal path or the quicker path.

articleTitle: Design of optimized FIR filter using Radix-2r
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Finite Impulse Response (FIR) filters are mainly used in the Digital Signal Processing (DSP) applications. The main reason behind implementing FIR filters is because of its high speed and low power requirements. The main complexity of designing FIR filter lies in the multiplier block. There are many techniques by using add and shift operations exclusively through which we can actually design the multiplier block thus reducing the complex structure of multiplier and these type of designs are called multiplier-less. A New Multiple Constant Multiplication algorithm (MCM) called Radix-2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</sup>has merit over existing algorithms for being fully predictable, sub linear, high speed and low power solutions. This paper presents the designing of an FIR filter using radix-2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</sup>recoding technique with `r=5' and a unique Lookup Table for it and also being implemented further. The proposed design gives the better results compared to normal design in terms of adder-cost, adder depth & resource utilization and corresponding trade-off occurs between delay & resource utilization.

articleTitle: Competitor Mining and Identification from Large Unstructured Datasets
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In the competitive world, We need to make our item more interesting, so customer get attracted and it will help us in competition. Here to take part in competition competitor should know about rivals and to know about competitors. Here we are using reviews of products. Most of the time customer share their experiences about purchasing things or products, So according to their experiences other customer learn and took their decisions. Reviews tells us about product quality and many more things. The main purpose of this paper is to find top-k competitors. For calculating competitors firstly we used four different algorithms. Out of these C-miner++ algorithm is better than naive, G-miner and C-miner. In case of C-miner++ algorithm computing time for calculating top-k competitor is less than rest three. So C-miner++ algorithm is the best algorithm for finding competitors. Our main aim is to show computing time for calculating top-k competitors using DE is less as compare to C-Miner and finding competitors more efficiently, so we used differential evaluation algorithm. We get a less computing time for calculating top- k competitors as compare to C-miner algorithm.

articleTitle: Implementation of Lee's algorithm for different routing constraints
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Lee's algorithm is a path finding algorithm and one of the possible solution for maze routing which is often used in Computer aided design. It is used to route wires on a printed circuit boards [1]-[2]. This paper proposes the implementation of Lee's algorithm for different routing constraints. It finds the shortest path between source and destination for symmetric and asymmetric as obstacle. The area, power analysis and delay is found for different FPGA families.

articleTitle: Tracking and Analysis of GAGAN and GPS Satellites in Flight Indian Region
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The Indian satellite based augmentation systems (SBAS) developed jointly by Indian Space Research Organization (ISRO) and Airport Authority of India (AAI) have placed Geo Augmented Navigation Satellites (GAGAN) Geo - 8, Geo -10 and Geo - 15. These satellites are available in space which provides the services like position integrity and accuracy of flight landing. This paper deals with the visibility and availability of GAGAN and GPS satellites across Indian flight coverage region which are mapped with the help of Satellite Tool Kit (STK). The GAGAN satellites and hybrid satellites will provide high accuracy and integrity services in flight navigation for all Indian civilians and defense use in all whether condition.

articleTitle: Optimization of Test Register Access Time for Next Generation SoCs
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In the recent years, there has been a rapid evolution in the designs of System-on-Chip (SoC) that now include system management blocks and multiple identical cores which collectively achieve several goals. The conventional processors along with the gaming and graphics processors have increasingly been a part of this trend. There has been increased integration of several components on a chip due to technology scaling where more IP (intellectual property) cores are placed on the chip. This makes testing an increasingly challenging task. Thus, the cores present on the SoC are subjected to modular testing which is recognized as a very effective way of tackling the problem of testing SoCs. The three standards, IEEE 1149.1, IEEE 1687, IEEE 1500 modularize the testing mechanism at different levels in the SoC. Thus, the testing can be performed in a systematic manner for the registers present at various points in the chip. In this paper, the test access mechanism in an SoC is optimized using broadcast, open network and event queuing methods. These methods exploit the modular nature of the SoC test wrappers to provide scalable and flexible capabilities to program the given register. We observe that the amount of time taken for testing the registers reduces by about 42.59% using open network method and by 55.54% using event queuing method.

articleTitle: MR Image Restoration using Non-Linear Filtering
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: A method for noise estimation of a Rician distributed MR image at image level is implemented. It is observed that the method gives optimum estimates at low noise (0.15 ≤ a ≤ 0.2). For image restoration purposes, Wiener and Median filters were implemented. Median filter is known to be more efficient in filtering out Rician noise. However, upon observation of residual image, it was found that Weiner filter is competent in edge preservation. On the other hand, it is also observed that (SSIM) of low noise image is more converged towards unity than that of the filtered image. The proposed algorithm was implemented on synthetic images from BrainWeb data base using MATLAB 2015a. Additionally, the study of low noise estimation is extended for higher even order moments and it was noticed that `Q' in noise estimation deviates from unity as order of moment is increased.

articleTitle: Integration of hybrid solar-wind energy sources with utility grid for improving power quality
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Most of the utilities are suffering to provide continues and clean power at the end users due to grid current distortion in the distribution system because of non-linear low power electronics loads. In addition to this, freely available inherent hybrid solar-wind energy sources are leads to cause some more grid current distortion. Adverting to the above major issue over long decade, this paper presents an efficient controller for 3-phase 4-leg interfacing voltage source inverter to perform not only current harmonic reduction but also optimal real power transfer, neutral current compensation and power factor correction simultaneously. These multiple functions can be achieved efficiently by using i<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">d</sub>- i<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">q</sub> control based shunt active power filter. The hysteresis comparator control is used to compare the obtained reference currents from i<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">d</sub>- i<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">q</sub> control with actual sensed actual currents to generate the error signal. This error signal decides the working of the inverter switches. The simulation is carried out by using MATLAB/SIMULINK tool under different grid and load conditions and the corresponding simulated results are encouraged.

articleTitle: Resonant Slots as Defected Ground Structure for Suppression of Cross-Polarized Radiations in a Microstrip Patch Antenna
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In this communication the rectangular microstrip antenna with resonant slots etched ground plane is proposed for the suppression of cross-polarized (XP) radiations. There is need of high isolation between co-pol to cross-polarized radiations for high quality sensors used in satellite or any wireless sensor network. The conventional MPA with any type of feed normally gives the isolation between co-pol to cross-polarized radiations of about 26dB. Here in this work it shown that it can be enhanced more than 52dB. The technique is simple, innovative, easy to implement for practical applications. The XP suppression of about -30dBi below ±70° and 16dBi above ±70° is achieved with good co-to cross-pol isolation of -60dBi below ±70° and 36dBi above ±70° is obtained. This configuration shows a co-pol peak gain of 6 dB and is good for wireless sensor applications. A prototype has been fabricated using commercially available low-loss dielectric material FR4 (glass epoxy) with dielectric constant (ε<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</sub>) = 4.4. The experimental validation of the simulated predictions is under progress.

articleTitle: A Reduced SteadyState Oscillation P&O Algorithm for MPP Tracking of PV cell
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: A new reduced SteadyState Oscillation P&O algorithm is proposed in this paper for enhancing the convergence speed, continuous tracking of maximum power from the photovoltaic (PV) cell and reduces the oscillation in SteadyState. The proposed algorithm uses variable step size unlike the fixed step size in conventional P&O algorithm. DC-DC boost converter is acting as an interfacing device between PV cell and load. The proposed algorithm is validated with the help of MATLAB Simulation of PV module for constant as well as changing irradiance condition and compared with the conventional P&O at different perturbation size.

articleTitle: Optimized Microcode BIST Architecture for Multiple Memory Cores in SoCs
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The ongoing advancements in IC technology results in increasing the capacity and density of memories in SoC's. The testing time, area overhead and cost of the test plays an important role during testing of memories. Built-in self-test (BIST) is a self testing mechanism that allows testing of multiple memory cores of different sizes. The parallel testing approach reduce the test time of memories. The area overhead reduces at a reasonable limit by using a single response analyzer instead of using individual modules for each memories. By changing the instructions in the Microcode controller storage unit, new march algorithms can be implemented without redesign the circuitry. This paper proposes an efficient method for testing multiple Memory cores of different sizes in parallel form without much increase in area of SoCs. The proposed Microcode BIST utilizes less area overhead and the time utilization compared with existing parallel architecture. Xilinx ISE 14.2 is used to implement the architecture.

Author Keywords: Configurable Complete Linear Feedback Shift Register (CCLFSR)

articleTitle: Application of Superconducting Fault Current Limiter (SFCL) for HVDC system with Mechanical Circuit Breaker
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Use of HVDC circuit breaker in HVDC system shown successful results. But imposing DC fault current during DC fault have not achieved yet. To overcome this problem, there is one alternative solution to use of superconducting fault current limiter (SFCL). This paper deals with application of resistive SFCL (R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">SFCL</sub>) for high voltage direct current (HVDC) system with direct current circuit breaker (DCCB) by using current breaking topology to estimate the effects of fault current limiter. Point to point HVDC system test bed model designed with SFCL and DC breaker. It is implemented in MATLAB/SIMULINK software. The Direct current (DC) fault current interruption characteristic of Mechanical CB is verified when SFCL was applied. Transient fault simulation is performed by using pole to pole fault created on receiving end.

articleTitle: Arduino Based Automated Sericulture System
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Sericulture is a science which deals with rearing of silk worms and production of silk. In India, most of the rural livelihood is sericulture and is the base for financial, social, political and intellectual advancements and up liftment since. Silk is called the queen of textiles due to its glittering luster, softness, elegance, durability, and tensile properties. Although there are several commercial species of silkworms, bombyx mori is the most widely used. Silkworm is one of the important domesticated insect, which produces rich silk thread in the form of cocoon by consuming mulberry leaves during larva period. But during the transformation from Larva to Silk, the silk worm has to pass many phases. In each phase the silkworm monitoring is a greatest challenge for the farmer. Therefore, in this paper we proposed a method for automation in sericulture system using arduino board. It deals with the regulating of climatic conditions such as temperature and humidity in the farm.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of a Three-Phase Induction Motor Drive Using Miniature Full Spectrum Simulator and MATLAB Simulink
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In this paper analysis of various speed control techniques of a three-phase Induction Motor (IM) is performed. Open-loop and closed-loop scalar control techniques are implemented using real-time full spectrum simulator(FSS) and MATLAB Simulink. FSS is an advanced easily configurable controller that enable us to perform off-line as well as real-time simulation. It is also having Hardware in loop facility to test new power electronic equipment. It aids in faster development of system with reduced testing time. The objective of study is to identify advantages and disadvantages of both these techniques using two different simulation tools under various operating condition. Dynamic performance of these techniques is analyzed under various operating conditions.

articleTitle: Low-cost Brain Controlled Orthotic Exoskeleton Arm for Monoplegic Paralyzed Individuals
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: On the lines of dramatic growth of victims of paralysis worldwide, the grievances, societal negligence and the difficulties in performing everyday basic tasks they face leading to prominent dependence on family and friends, this paper proposes an intelligent brain controlled orthotic exoskeleton arm (ARMOID) for individuals affected by arm monoplegia (single-arm) paralysis. The device would provide shoulder, elbow, wrist and finger grasping motions to be controlled by neural data obtained using an EEG headset and guided by thoughts and facial expressions of the individual.

articleTitle: Solar Photovoltaic Powered Smart Garbage Monitoring System Using GSM/GPS
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The expansion in the population has resulted in enormous reduction in the quality of cleanliness concerning waste administration. In numerous spots, the dustbins are spilled over everywhere throughout the places and they are not cleaned at the appropriate time. Because of which the results are extreme. It incorporates flood of waste which brings about land contamination, the spread of sicknesses, likewise, it makes unhygienic conditions for individuals and makes the place odd. To avoid all such situations and keep up open tidiness and wellbeing, the proposed work has been planned for a `Smart Garbage Monitoring' which shows that the dustbin is filled to a specific level by the trash and cleaning or disposing them involves quick concern. Distinctive LED's are allotted to demonstrate the levels of the dustbin.
