At the point when the garbage has completely filled the compaction module actuates and compresses the waste which is powered by solar. The GSM module sends the message to concerned authorities to clean the bin and with the help of GPS the exact location of the bin will be known. Proposed venture incorporates a compaction module, Arduino AT mega 2560, GSM Module and a Solar Panel.

articleTitle: Implementation of Levenberg-Marquadrt Algorithm for Control of Induction Motor Drive
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This paper presents the implementation of an Artificial Neural Network (ANN) based algorithm for the control of an indirect vector-controlled induction motor (IVCIM) drive for different modes of operation. Backpropagation algorithm is used for the training of ANN and performance of the drive is analysed through simulation studies and through real time implementation using DS-1104, on a 3HP induction motor (IM) drive. The operation of the drive under forward motoring, speed reversal and breaking modes are demonstrated through simulation and experimental studies. A comparative study of ANN and conventional PI controller under different operating conditions, based on simulation results and experimental outcomes is carried out and the dynamic behaviour of the IVCIM is analysed.

articleTitle: Channel and Rate Selection strategy in Cognitive Radio Network using Multi-arm bandits (MAB)
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Nowadays with the tremendous growth of wireless technology, spectrum resources become more and more scare. For. For improving the capacity of the network and, QoS (quality of service) it is necessary that available spectrum is utilized effectively. Cognitive radio is one of the solutions to meet this requirement by Spectrum reuse (Dynamic spectrum access). There are three distinct phase in cognitive radio networks (CRNs) that is spectrum sensing, channel selection, and data transmission. Channel selection is a most important issue in CRNs. In CRN the major task is which channels should be selected first and how many resources are used. Channel selection is basic mechanisms that control interference in a wireless network. As soon as licensed user came back, it vacant the band and hence improve spectrum efficiency. In this paper, channel and corresponding rate selection techniques are discussed. The goal is to find an average throughput for a different strategy which described in section IV. Also, find the successful transmission probability for selected channel and rate pair. For this optimization based MAB (Multi-arm bandit) approach is used.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of MySQL, Apache Spark on CPU and GPU
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: However, with the huge amount of data that is getting generated every day from various fields, need for the advanced methods for managing and analyzing the big data is very much obvious. One of such platforms, which were developed exclusively for Big Data Analytics, is Apache Spark. Though MySQL is preferred for small amount of Data and Spark is meant for big data(in terms of volume), many of the functionalities are found similar in both and they can be considered for a comparative study. This paper implements execution of Big data on Apache Spark based on the parameters considered and comparing the same work with MySQL on CPU and GPU. The parameters that considered here are Loading Time and Response Time of the queries execution. The execution of queries directly on GPU dramatically reduces the effort required to achieve GPU acceleration by avoiding the need for database programmers to use new programming languages such as CUDA or modify their programs to use non-SQL libraries. This paper focus on accelerating the queries. The obtained results are analyzed with appropriate conclusion. The execution of the data on GPU is faster than the MySQL and Apache Spark. Results on an NVIDIA gtx 650 achieve speedups of 20-70X depending upon the size of the data.

articleTitle: An Efficient Hybrid Approach For Performance Analysis of Transformer Protected
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Power Transformer is a static device and measured one of the most important components in power system network. Owing to both the significance and necessarily of power transformers for the Power System Operation, Stability, security and due to world wide variety of abnormal situations and faults or errors which can cause dissimilar levels of damage, avoiding damage of abnormal harm to power transformer is important. Disappointments are few failures and almost always result in irreversible inner storage. It is a very necessary to nearly monitor their on-line behaviour. In this research work, problem identify the power transformer protection and high loading scenarios inrush current, transformer saturation, faults in internal and external transformers plays a significant role in decreasing efficiency of the transformers which decreases the specificity, sensitivity and accuracy of the transformer. The unwanted and high current and high levels of saturations are the environments which are puzzling and difficult when it arises to the precision of the transformer protection. Since the scaling of the attracting inrush current converts ten times of the occupied load current, this leads to heavy currents and loads on differential relay systems. In research work, implemented to filter and optimized using hybrid approach to optimize the losses. MATLAB simulation tool used to design research work. To enhance the performance parameters like Inrush Current, Saturation Current, Sensitivity, Specificity and accuracy and compared with the existing algorithm.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of OFDM based Radio-over-Fiber Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: A design of Radio over Fiber system incorporating hybrid modulation techniques and Wavelength Division Multiple access(WDMA)/Optical Code Division Multiple Access(OCDMA) is proposed in this paper. WDMA is a multiple access method using specific wavelengths allotted to each user. Each user is allotted a wavelength for both upstream and downstream direction. WDMA is a suitable approach for satisfying future high bandwidth RoF systems with more number of users. OCDMA is a technique which allows multiple users to transmit and receive data simultaneously using the same optical fiber channel. The BER performance of the system is evaluated using Optisystem. The bit error rate (BER) of 0.25 is obtained at 10 Gbps and 60 km for WDMA-RoF whereas 0.48 in case of OCDMA-RoF for same parameters. Merging optical and wireless communication, RoF transmission promises future high capacity and high-speed network communication systems.

articleTitle: Simulation of Low Area and High Speed Nine Port Network-on-Chip Router Architecture
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In present technological world, life demands very high speed gadgets which are requisite components of modern human existence to reduce accomplishment of habitual works. Accordingly, such devices should be capable for operating at expeditious. Conventionally multi-core processing architecture is been used to increase this operational speed. In such instant, the total task should be divided into sub-smaller tasks and those particular smaller tasks has to be executed parallel by each processing cores respectively. In order to calculate approximate value of complete performed tasks has to be shared among individual processor. There-upon, bi-directional communication is peremptory between all these processing elements, which are been present in multi-core system. Normal bus architecture could not support this class of communication resulting many issues, hence Network-On-Chip (NoC) router acceptable. In these present work, 3X3 router arrangement considering mesh topology which is area efficient router architecture for NoC is designed using FPGA.

articleTitle: Optimized H-LEACH algorithm for clustering to improve lifetime of WSN
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Wireless sensor network (WSN) is one of the most standard selected services for the use of technical field, industrial applications, or in the market. WSN consists basically independent sensors that sense topographical area of implementation. In WSN, the independent nodes sense observe the area which is enclosing us such as observing, sensing of sound, vibration, temperature etc. WSN can transpose the information to the Base Station (BS) and perform different types of processing like data collection, data sensing, data processing and also used for find the best route between nodes and BS to transmit the data. These days, WSNs is being used in many areas like border security, battle field surveillance, motion tracking etc. The main issue associated with a WSN is to enhance its lifetime. Clustering is an approach to increase the network lifetime. H-LEACH is basically a hybrid clustering hierarchy for wireless sensor network. The nodes in H-LEACH get associated with CH in their respective zone. For the long distance CH guild with CH node. In this paper we use extended H-LEACH approach for clustering. In this approach the CH or zones are increased for reducing the distance between one CH to next CH or BS. The CH are selected one in every zone in rotatory using probability same as H-LEACH. When the re-clustering is done the result show minimum energy by normal node during before the transmission of information.

articleTitle: IoT Based Smart Vehicle Parking Manager
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In today's scenario, India is thickly populated with vehicles which includes cars, bikes, etc. As in today's situation is that as the members of family are increasing, the count of number of vehicles are continuously increasing in per house. So increase in vehicle count leads to deficiency in parking spaces which leads to traffic congestions, creates problem for public to walk on road and increases insecurity of the vehicles and helps to increase the accident ratio on the road. The objective of the proposed design is to provide a solution to overcome the parking problems which leads the scenario to the traffic congestion during week days near malls, commercial areas. To achieve this solution we implemented the concept of Internet Of Things (IoT) with the android mobile application where the customer can check the availability of the parking slots, book the slots, can allocate time according to its requirements. The features of the proposed design will generate the QR code at the time of booking to each customer through the mobile application. The proposed system in future helps to overcome the problem of vehicle security, ease of maintaining the data, avoid manual maintenances, helps in creating and allocating of proper parking spaces to the user.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Converter Based Topology For Solar Powered Shipboard Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: International trading mainly depends upon shipping industry which uses fossil fuels as the major source of fuel for transportation. Excessive use of fossil fuels often leads to environmental pollution. It also has adverse effect on the marine eco system. Hence the fossil fuels can be replaced with renewable sources of energy such as solar energy, wind energy etc. In the conventional methods of connecting a solar panel to a grid or an isolated system, a boost converter and a voltage source inverter are generally used to power simultaneous AC and DC loads. Since the power conversion stages are more for this topology, it has reduced power processing capability. A hybrid converter topology consists of a single converter which is capable of powering both AC as well as DC loads concurrently. A hybrid converter is derived from a boost converter with a voltage source inverter bridge network. This paper presents simulation analysis of hybrid converter for shipboard systems. Simulation is done in MATLAB platform. From the analysis it is found that instead of using two separate power converters in a shipboard power system, a hybrid converter can be used which has higher AC gain, reduced losses, and reduced number of switches. Compactness of the system and higher reliability makes them best suited for shipboard power system.

articleTitle: Hand Gesture Based Quadcopter Control Using Image Processing And Adaptive Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Accurately recognizing gesture in real time is a complex problem to solve. It can be addressed to some extent using colored gloves and markers, but models so built do not generalize well. Another option is to utilize boundary based gesture recognition, but these are more complex to build and prediction is time consuming. Through this work we try to resolve both these issues by construction of a straightforward machine learning architecture which accurately implements gesture recognition in real time and can also be utilized to build a generalized model. The solution we have developed is based on the premise that an architecture which can contextually recognize gestures and can also adaptively identify variations to the same can be used for solving problems ranging from body language detection, translating sign language to devising an intuitive method for controlling UAVs (Unmanned Aerial Vehicles).

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of Matched Filter, Wavelet Denoising and Wiener Filter Technique in Communication Receivers
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: There have been several methods for de-noising and each has its own merits and demerits. This paper deals with the comparison of noise reduction ability of Matched filter, Wavelet analysis and Wiener filter which are tested on continuous wave radar and pulsed radar signals. Matched filtering is a demodulation technique with linear time invariant filters to maximize SNR. Wavelet transform performs a correlation analysis; therefore maximum output is expected when the input signal most resembles the mother wavelet. Two signals contaminated with Additive White Gaussian Noise are used for performance evaluation of these three filters and simulations results are provided.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Satellite Image Encryption by Using ECC
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Security of the data is the principle issue in arrange correspondences these days. There is no calculation which guarantees the 100% unwavering quality of the transmissions. there is an extraordinary interest for safeguarding the safe stockpiling and transmission of satellite image over internet and shared framework condition. This brings new difficulties to shield delicate and basic satellite image from unapproved get to and unlawful use. Promotion innovation is additionally utilized by interlopers to rupture the security of the frameworks. Thus, every time cryptosystems created in light of complex Science. ECC is one of the method in such sort of cryptosystems. Security of the elliptic curve lies in hardness of taking care of the discrete logarithms issues. The implementation of this paper has been done in MATLAB -2017a on an ECC for Satellite image encryption/decryption, primarily the ECDH used for key exchange. It presents the basics of Elliptic Curve over the whole numbers modulo p, where p is prime integers. At that point the hypothetical underpinnings of the ECDH framework are secured, review of satellite image which it will encryption and decryption in this paper, including a concise take a gander at how this framework is function by take whole pixels of satellite image and encryption/decryption using ECC.

articleTitle: IoT Based Smart Embedded System for Environmental Pollution Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Continuous monitoring of pollution is required especially in agricultural field for the better cultivation. Proposed pollution monitoring device senses the pollution levels in the surrounding environment by using suitable sensors. Quality of the sources like soil, water, air can be identify and thereby know the polluted level. By Internet of Things (IoT), data is uploaded to server. User can monitor real-time data of pollution level through this. As farmers are following smart farming, these data can be used for better cultivation.

articleTitle: Automotive Electronic safety for Intelligent Transportation System
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The use of tracking a vehicle become critical in many applications including personal vehicle security, public transportation systems, passengers safety, fleet management and others. Also, it is expected to rapid increase of vehicles on road globally. Therefore, the development of vehicle tracking system as per Automotive Industry Standard (AIS-140) using the Global Positioning System (GPS), Indian Regional Navigation Satellite System (IRNSS) and Global System for Mobile Communications/General Packet Radio Services (GSM/GPRS) modem is undertaken with the aim of enabling users and government bodies to locate the vehicles to monitor and control in an ease and efficient manner. The user also can track, monitor and control their vehicle remotely through mobile network. This paper is intended for the development of the vehicle tracking system's hardware prototype as per AIS-140. Specifically, this paper proposes the architecture for protection of power input against the automotive electrical transients as per ISO 7637-2 (2004). It includes under voltage cut off and pi filter to make the system electromagnetic compatible with vehicle electronics sub system.

articleTitle: Test bed Development and Verification for Smart Antenna MUSIC Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Smart antenna system uses adaptive system for array of antenna elements to maximize system capacity, widen radio coverage and enhance quality of service. Smart antenna system design is the combination of antenna array design, hardware for signal processing and software. The aim of this paper is to develop low cost stable test bed for testing smart antenna algorithms and compare its results with the one standard model, designed using MATLAB simulink. The DOA estimation algorithms can be tested by using this platform. The results of this platform are verified and validitated by comparing them with the results of a similar standard platform simulated in MATLAB simulink. The testbed can also be used to check enhancement in the performance of DOA detection and beamforming algorithms for smart antenna. In this paper MUSIC algorithm is put to test on this platform & the results are verified for DOA estimation.

articleTitle: Barium Nano Ferrite material for suppression of electromagnetic noise generated from Mobile Phones
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In this proposed work the shielding of the noise generated from the mobile phones by using nano material with composition of barium ferrite, graphite, PVA(Poly vinyl alcohol) and graphene oxide. The Barium ferrites are mixed with PVA polymer by mechanical mixing and its effect on the EMI(Electromagnetic Interference) shielding results was reported in the radio frequency range from 500MHz-4GHz. This range is suitable for shielding noise in mobiles since the operating range of the mobile is 450MHz to 2.1GHz. XRD(X-ray powder diffraction) and SEM(scanning electron microscope) images have been recorded for all the investigated samples. The nature and particle size of the samples are determined by XRD analysis, while the surface morphology was studied by SEM images. The SE(shielding effectiveness) measurements have been carried out using circular guide connected to a network analyser. Also Shielding effectiveness due to reflection(SE<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">R</sub>), absorption/SE<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">A</sub>), Permitivitty(εr) and Permeability (μr) are analysed. The shielding effectiveness was maximum in the range of O.8GHz to 3GHz and the shielding effectiveness was observed to be 31dB at 2.1GHz

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Mammogram Classification
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: One of main reason for increase in mortality rate of woman is breast cancer. Accurate early detection of abnormalities in breast tissues seems to be the only solution for diagnosis. These detected abnormalities need to be classified for further investigation. In breast cancer research various classification techniques have been proposed to reduce the diagnostic test false positives because of the subtle appearance of the breast cancer tissues. Accurate early classification of mammogram is essential to reduce diagnostic test false positives. Hence, an attempt is made to presents an automated classification technique for mammogram. This work is divided into four steps: Pre-processing, Feature Extraction, Feature Selection and classification. In this approach cropping and resizing is used as a preprocessing technique. In next step Texture, wavelet and PCA features are extracted form mammogram, cuckoo search algorithm is enhanced to select optimal feature split points. Finally, classification is achieved using association rule agreement-based classifier model. It classifies mammogram as normal or cancerous using association rules generated from selected features. The experiments are carried out on Mammographic Image Analysis Society (MIAS) database and performance of proposed method is validated over existing work using accuracy, sensitivity and specificity measures. The proposed technique has achieved accuracy 0.8289, sensitivity 0.9333 and specificity 0.7273. Results indicate the usefulness of proposed method in classification task.

articleTitle: FPGA based Optimized LMS Adaptive Filter using Distributed Arithmetic
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In this paper an efficient VLSI architecture for LMS adaptive filter using distributed arithmetic is presented. DA is serial bit computation. Here, two separate look up tables are used to store possible filter partial product of input sample and filter coefficients, this is followed by access and summation of entries, with the idea of the proposed design. Offset binary coding technique is used to reduce the area complexity. The multiplexed LUTs are used to access the contents to improve the performance. Using LMS algorithm all the content of memory locations of LUT are recalculated based on samples and the contents of LUTs are updated based on proposed strategy. The design is simulated in Xilinx ISE and synthesized with Spartan-6 FPGA, XC6SLX45-2CSG324.

Author Keywords: multiply and accumulation (MAC) and offset binary coding (OBC)

articleTitle: Improving Privacy and Security with Fine Grained Access Control Policy using Two Stage Encryption with Partial Shuffling in Cloud
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In a computer world, to identify anyone by doing a job or to authenticate by checking their identification and give access to computer. Access Control model comes in to picture when require to grant the permissions to individual and complete the duties. The access control models cannot give complete security when dealing with cloud computing area, where access control model failed to handle the attributes which are requisite to inhibit access based on time and location. When the data outsourced in the cloud, the information holders expect the security and confidentiality for their outsourced data. The data will be encrypted before outsourcing on cloud, still they want control on data in cloud server, where simple encryption is not a complete solution. To irradiate these issues, unlike access control models proposed Attribute Based Encryption standards (ABE). In ABE schemes there are different types like Key Policy-ABE (KP-ABE), Cipher Text-ABE (CP-ABE) and so on. The proposed method applied the access control policy of CP-ABE with Advanced Encryption Standard and used elliptic curve for key generation by using multi stage encryption which divides the users into two domains, public and private domains and shuffling the data base records to protect from inference attacks.

articleTitle: An Efficient FPGA based Background Subtraction Algorithm for Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Object Detection is an integral part of security system where tracking accuracy and time plays a vital role. This makes moving object detection becomes one of the challenging tasks in current world scenario like video surveillance, traffic monitoring etc. In this paper, an efficient FPGA based Background Subtraction Algorithm for Object Detection is proposed. The process involves three stages of Pre-processing using median filter, Detection with background subtraction and Post-processing using Threshold technique. To achieve the optimum results of the total module, optimization is done at the architecture level of each block without affecting the accuracy of the processed data. The entire architecture is designed using VHDL language and implemented on Virtex-5 FPGA board. The comparison results prove that the proposed technique is more efficient than existing in terms of both hardware utilization and detection accuracy.

articleTitle: Design of a Dual-Substrate H-Type Patch Antenna for UHF RFID Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This paper discusses the modelling and simulation research work carried out in analyzing performance of a dual substrate patch antenna for Ultra High Frequency (UHF) Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) applications. Numerous research work has been carried out in analysis and development of single substrate patch antennae for various wireless applications. The proposed work explores possibilities of use of multiple substrates to improve the overall performance with regards to dimension, gain, directivity, reflection coefficient and other critical antenna related parameters. A dual substrate (FR4 + RT/Duroid 5880) material has been used for laying of an H-type patch antenna for operation in the UHF band which complies with the ISO/IEC 7810 ID-1 format for physical dimensions. As the antenna dimension is smaller compared to the theoretically calculated values, slots/slits have been cut out on the patch for obtaining the resonance at the desired frequency band. The antenna has been designed for operation in the 865–867 MHz band. Ansys HFSS V13.0 has been used for carrying out the simulation of the designed antenna. Results of the simulation have been analyzed and a comparative performance of the designed antenna with a single substrate patch antenna has also been studied in this paper.

articleTitle: A Presumptuous Encephalon Electronic Brain Computing in Gaming Gadgets
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: ENCEPHALON ELECTRONIC BRAIN COMPUTING(EEBC) is a solution for a newer approach of establishing communication with the system and invasively controls devices by the user with his/her capabilities. BCI is a framework that does not stress physical activity, In fact develops a regulation by corroborating contact with human cerebrum waves and takes these waves as commands to perform operations in system by using the method EEG (electroencephalogram) cap. Moreover, BCI terminology is suitable for substantiate involutions in hospital field, gaming field and fields capable in usage of brain waves. Physically disabled people with loss of functioning in muscular activity exhibit to use BCI technology to perform commands in gaming origins and evince in other basis of respective fields.

articleTitle: Automatic Parking Gateway using Character Recognition
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This article describes about the novel research on automatic parking gateway system by character recognition technique which is used to identify the number plate of the vehicle for parking management systems (PMSs) which can replace the traditional methods. The entire system is subdivided into two, control centre and parking gateway centre. The camera in control centre captures image of vehicle number plate at the parking gate for character segmentation and recognition which is done by using image processing in MATLAB. The recognized number plate is compared with the number plates in the database of MATLAB and corresponding control signal is sent to parking gateway via bluetooth. The parking gateway centre is an embedded hardware system which communicates between two centres and controls the parking gate. In case of emergency the security person has permission to grant parking access by pressing the emergency push button which adds to the novelty of proposed system.

articleTitle: Cluster-Based Scheduling Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This paper brings a new algorithm for the tasks available for scheduling. The concept mentioned in the paper is certainly the newly introduced enlightenment in this field. The tasks are divided into bunches according to their weightages and given both priorities on group and priority individually. By taking both priorities into account the tasks are scheduled based on the algorithm explained in the paper. This algorithm gives a result of higher response and performance improvement than other scheduling algorithms available.

articleTitle: Power Flow Control and Seamless transfer of Single-Phase Grid Interactive Inverter Between Off-grid and Utility-Connected Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: A strategy for control of active and reactive power flow for a single-phase grid-interactive inverter is presented. For utility-connected configuration, the power flow is controlled by employing hysteresis current control whereas hysteresis voltage control is implemented for off-grid configuration. Seamless transition between off-grid and utility-connected operations is achieved by switching between voltage and current control algorithms accordingly. The control algorithms are simulated in SIMULINK/MATLAB environment and the results obtained are presented and discussed.

articleTitle: Design of Resistorless Bandgap Reference
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The voltage and the current references are important blocks in analog VLSI circuits. The temperature fluctuations, operating voltage and load currents are remains constant by using the voltage reference circuits. The bipolar transistors and resistors are used in traditional bandgap reference circuits, these are consuming more area and power hence to buried this drawback, we build a resistorless bandgap reference using MOSFETs and generating a negative temperature coefficient MOSFETs are operating in sub threshold region and the inversion technique is used to received the gain. This circuit works on voltage of 1.2v and -10°c to 120°c is temperature range with temperature coefficient 4.5ppm/c. This bandgap reference circuit is implemented by cadence tool CMOS 180nm (UMCI80) technology. The silicon area is 0.027mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Fabrication and Qualification of Aluminum-Silicon Carrier Plates for Space Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Alloys of Aluminum and Silicon [AlSi aka Controlled Expansion (CE) alloys] are engineered to suit co-efficient of thermal expansion (CTE) of advanced materials used in various industries. CTE of CE alloys can be tuned between 7.5 and 20 ppm/°C by varying proportions of major constituents viz. Aluminum and Silicon. One such composition is CE9F with CTE of 9 ppm/°C, making it suitable as carrier plate in Microwave Integrated Circuits (MIC) for Space applications. Compared to Kovar alloys being used at present as MIC carrier plates, CE alloys offer advantages of lower weight and higher thermal conductivity. However, their machining and plating is relatively difficult. In this paper, we report machining of CE9F alloy plates by using Electrostatic Discharge machining (EDM) method, gold plating on the machined plates of CE9F alloys, and attachment of alumina substrates on the alloys. As certain difficulties were faced during these phases, machined carrier plates were procured and qualification samples were realized. The samples are subjected to various tests to evaluate its performance. After successful completion of all these tests, the material (CE9F alloy) is qualified for its applications in ISRO's Space programmes.

articleTitle: IOT Based Patient Monitoring System utilizing Raspberry Pi and Web-Page
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Real time observing system are helpful because of the likelihood of convenient and proficient human healthcare requirements. These frameworks depend on cutting edge remote and wearable sensor innovations. The quick development in innovation has amazingly upgraded the extent of remote patient tracking device. In this paper, an ongoing body temperature, heart rate and systolic blood pressure framework is created thinking about the cost, simplicity of utilization, exactness, and information security. The framework is conceptualized to give an interface between the specialist and the patients for two-way correspondence. In this paper, these physiological parameters are checked utilizing Raspberry Pi showed on a 16*2 LCD. Subsequent to associating Internet to the Raspberry Pi board from a GSM module, it functions as a server. At that point the server consequently sends information to the web-server page and these parameters are screened utilizing a user id and secured responsive site page anyplace on the planet utilizing mobile, tab or PCs. Moreover, the created framework is prepared to produce cautioning messages and email to the specialist and patients near ones under critical conditions for preventionary measures.

articleTitle: A Cumulant Based Subspace Method for Signal Parameter Estimation
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The objective of this work is to estimate the Directions of Arrival (DOAs) of signals from multiple non-Gaussian sources corrupted by additive Gaussian noise impinging on a Uniform Linear Array (ULA) comprising of N sensors. This is achieved by virtue of construction of a fourth order Cumulant matrix followed by Eigen decomposition to segregate the noise and signal subspaces. Then the MUSIC algorithm is employed in order to estimate the DOAs of multiple sources. The use of higher order Statistics over its second order counterpart is found to increase the accuracy of the source localization process especially when the non-gaussian signals are corrupted by additive Gaussian noise. This approach is substantiated by means of various simulation results such as comparison of RMSE with respect to number of array elements, number of snapshots and SNR. A comparison between the second order Statistics based MUSIC and the fourth order Statistics based MUSIC algorithm is also presented in a juxtaposed manner.

articleTitle: Signal Processing of High Resolution Ultra-Wide Band Radar
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: UWB is a radio technology which makes use of very low energy, very short pulses, good immunity against multi path interference and large bandwidth which supports exceptionally fine time resolution. Finite time resolution gives assistance to accurate positioning. This work concentrates on developing signal processing algorithm for UWB radar. Field programming gate array (FPGA) is utilized for this purpose which supports faster and parallel processing of the signal. Multi-channel ADC and delay method is used for achieving high resolution. Time delay algorithm is designed for limiting high speed ADC. UWB radar is low complexity technology allows the fine measurement of the target range.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Improved Data Replication Using HDFS
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: HDFS (Hadoop Distributed File System) is intended to store huge dataset values with accurate file location with high reliability and data streaming to the application is done at high bandwidth. HDFS deals with high fault tolerance with the use of replication of data. Many researches have been done on fitting the data in the exact location. The problem occurred in Hadoop distributed file system is difficulty with information space for storage. It is the most complicated problem which reduce the performance of the file system. To overcome this issue the proposed system aims to have the better data replication which depends upon the access count estimation in Hadoop framework. The proposed system creates the better replicas and to solve the data locality problem with improved arrangement of data replicas and to assign the task for efficient workers to complete the Map Reduce task to obtain the better results. By comparison with the existing system, the proposed system performs the better replication and solves the data locality problem. An experiment has been performed for evaluating the proposed technique with default technique and previously used replication techniques using a benchmark. With respect to the results obtained the proposed method obtained a better throughput when compared to the previous techniques.

articleTitle: Knowledge based Question and Answering system using user feedback
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The knowledge database consists of facts about specific domain. Knowledge about specific domain is spread across in web. There is a need for some mechanism to represent the knowledge in a database for effective information retrieval through user query. In this paper we have implemented Knowledge Retrieval System (KRS) with user feedback to retrieve the most relevant answer. Knowledge is gathered for Ionic framework via web crawler from various sources and KRS is stored in a database after being analyzed, modeled and indexed. The indexed knowledge base is optimized by training it using a learning engine which incorporates user feedback. The ranking of the content, changes, based on user preference. The system is designed to be agnostic of the data that it works on and hence can be ported for various knowledge base domains. The system is capable to work on any type of knowledge information just by changing the retrieval data set. The result shows that user feedback improves the indexer mechanism and results in better retrieval.

articleTitle: FPGA Based Interface Interlock Unit for Radar Power Sequencing
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This research paper mainly focus on study of an Interface Interlock Unit (IIU) used in radar sub system for timely switching of power sequencing operations. Here mainly the IIU uses Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) as an integrated circuit and FPGA based IIU for radar power sequencer uses XilinxArtix7. IIU is an internal unit of Antenna Power Distribution unit (APDU) system which gives power to the antenna. Whenever the radar is used it is necessary to supply the power to the load. Therefore, this IIU card unit is realized on Xilinx based high end FPGA (Artix-7) for sequencing of proper ON and OFF operations to supply the required power. This system can protect from rush currents i.e whenever there will be presence of many loads to which the power to be supplied, by sequencing the system, it will be protected. IIU also helps in replacement of a particular load in case of damage occurrence.

articleTitle: Performance Improvement of Distribution System Through PV Inverter
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In rural area's distribution system reliability is very poor due to frequent load shielding. In order to improve the system reliability, power electronics devices (converters) are used to connect renewable energy sources to obtain the maximum output from the grid-interfacing converter scheme presented in this paper. To inject power to grid from solar side, inverter is used and Filter is used for compensation of neutral load current and unbalance current. Verification of this system is done by using MATLAB/Simulink simulation and results are validated.

articleTitle: Memory Efficient ASIC Implementation of Line Hough Transform
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The innovations and applications in automation, robotics and computer vision are enhanced by the image processing techniques such as object detection, face recognition, image compression etc. This work uses line detection by line Hough transform (LHT). LHT is most efficient technique, which give clear output for a given edge detected image even when there is an appreciable noise present. Normally the LHT requires a large memory for rho and theta calculations. Therefore to reduce the memory requirements rho and theta calculations are implemented with CORDIC Algorithm based functional units. A MATLAB model of LHT with variable word length is developed. The number of bits used to represent the pixel values in edge detected image are varied from 1o Bits to 2o Bits; to trade off the quality of edge detection and time required. This simulation reveals that time for 1o bits is 18.1o29s, 15 bits is 18.2982s and for 2o bits is 19.22s. Here the minimum word length of 1o bits is considered and the same architecture is implemented in TSMC 9onm technology. This requires 4174 MB memory and 5ms as computation time compared to 8384 MB and 2ms. So from the CORDIC based LHT uses lesser memory and relatively longer computation time than the previous implementations.

articleTitle: An unceratinty model approach for detection of power quality disturbances
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Nowadays, the analysis and detection of various power quality disturbances are widely required due to increasing use of sensitive control in most of the devices at all consumer levels. The power quality disturbances that occur in distribution and transmission systems are voltage sag, voltage swell, harmonics, interruption, surges, spikes, notch etc. these disturbances can occur due to switching off large loads, use of solid state switching device, arc furnaces, transformer energization, capacitor switching, lightning strikes and use of electronically switched loads such as rectifiers or invertors. Poor power quality can cause malfunctioning of protective relays, can affect the accuracy of utility metering, loss of data and can result in equipment damage resulting in a loss of productivity. For improving power quality, these disturbances should be detected before attenuating them. In this paper we have created the power quality disturbances using uncertainty model approach in MATLAB/SIMULINK. Then the detection of disturbances is one using RMS method.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach Towards Identification of Alcohol and Drug Induced People
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The paper proposes a novel approach towards identification of alcohol and drug induced people, through the use of a wearable bracelet. As alcohol and drug induced human people are in an unconsciousstate of mind, they need external help from the surroundings. With proposed Bracelet system we can identify the alcohol and drug indused people and warning trigger message is sent to their care takers. There is a definite relationship between an individual's Blood Alcohol Content (BAC) and Pulse Rate to identify the alcohol or drug consumed person. This relationship of pulse rate with BAC is sensed by piezoelectric sensor and warning system is developed as a Bracelet device. The viability of the Bracelet is verified by Simulating a Database of 199 People's BAC and Pulse Rate Features and classification is done among the Alcohol Induced and Normal People. For classification,Ensemble Boosted Tree Algorithm is used which is having 81.9% accuracy in decision.

articleTitle: FPGA based embedded controller using soft core processor for Ion Source Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This paper discusses the implementation of an embedded controller in a Field programmable gate array (FPGA) for Scientific instrumentation like Ion source applications. Embedded controller has been successfully designed and implemented with Spartan-6 FPGA (XC6SLX9) development board using Xilinx 14.2 Embedded Development Kit (EDK) tool. The softcore Processor Micro-Blaze is configured inside the FPGA using the Xilinx Platform Studio (XPS) and software application developed using Software Development Kit (SDK) tool. Designed application tested and verified the functionality with onboard USB-UART port.

articleTitle: Smart Fire Safety System in a Building
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In this paper will be discussing about the Smart fire safety system in a building. By using this technique, we can save the life of the people present in the building which is on fire. As we all know that in this kind of situation the first thing which will be happening is that the sprinklers will be turned on, but when the current supply will be still on there is chance of short circuit and the fire will get more severe due to this reason. Here we have programed in such a way that the circuit in the building will be tripped and then the sprinklers will be turned on so that the fire in the building is controlled. And another danger is that in major cases people will die because to breathing problem due to the smoke which is formed in due to fire. That's why we will be using exhaust fans to remove the smoke from the building. By using this technique there is a chance of saving lot of people stuck in a building which is on fire. And another advantage is that this technique is not only for the new buildings but also easily implemented to the existing old building easily. So that you don't have to change the design of the buildings. And the implementation cost will also be less.

articleTitle: Low Power Single Bit-line Power-gated SRAM
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: A system-on-chip contains various components of which memory is one of the prominent block. As the technology is growing and portable devices are taking charge of all our digital activities, it becomes important that these devices consume less power and still give optimum performance. In this paper, a low power and low leakage power consuming single bit-line SRAM has been designed. It provides a high value of static noise margin during read function with good static as well as dynamic write and read performance. Multi-threshold sleep transistors are used to reduce leakage power in the designed SRAM. The usage of sleep transistors provides low leakage power in the SRAM circuit. Due to this, the leakage power reduces by 23.33% when compared with the 9T single bit-line circuit. In order to further reduce leakage power and circuit performance, power-gating method is applied to the SB9T circuit. It is observed that this method yields better access times and stability of the circuit. The hold and read SNM improve and the values are close to each other. The leakage power reduces by 63.9% due to this method. The performance parameters of SB9T, Sleepy SB9T and PG-SRAM are compared. It is found that the power-gated circuit performs most efficiently among the three designs. A 2×2 array for the SB9T and the PG-SRAM are designed in this paper and it's found that the leakage power consumed is 14.58% less in the power gated array compared to the normal SRAM.

articleTitle: A Novel 6LowPan-IPv6 based Header Compression Algorithm for enhancement of the QoS parameter
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Wireless sensor networks WSNs, are fastest growing ubiquitous networking used for monitoring and managing remote habitats. IEEE 802.15.4 standard was introduced for optimizing power consumption. For improving connectivity and enabling efficient data transfer with minimum modifications of the existing Internet stack, an adaptation layer, 6loWPAN, was introduced by IETF. This paper presents a novel header compression algorithm to combat with the reduction in the Maximum Transmission Unit of 6LoWPAN with respect to Internet. This improves the Quality of Service parameters such as throughput, delay and jitter variations. The size of fragmentation header is reduced by eliding the datagram_size field in in the in between fragments. the first and the last fragment and removing it This results in the reduction of fragment header size by 8 bytes, thereby yielding a reduction of 2.9ms in the transmission time for each IPv6 packet of nominal 1000 bytes payload. Contiki OS was used to record results to validate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: 2.3 −2.69 GHz Active Inductor Based Band-Pass Filter in RF Transceiver for WBAN
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Emergence of WBAN (Wireless Body Area Network) introduced a highly flexible and intelligent network around the world that provides a highly secured communication over the human body. The RF front end receiver circuit of transceiver system consist of LNA, bandpass filter and frequency to amplitude converter and ADC. Here mainly focusing on the bandpass filter. The frequency range used to design the bandpass filter is from 2.3GHz to 2.69GHz. This frequency range consist of both the topology TDD and FDD and this range consist of ISM band. The bandpass filter is designed for the order 4. The bandpass filter contains spiral inductors which consumes more chip area. To reduce the chip area spiral inductors are replaced by SGAI. When one spiral inductor is replaced by an active inductor (SGAI) the area is reduced to a percentage of 60.273% and the quality factor obtained is 2.973. When SGAI is placed selectivity, bandwidth and impedance of bandpass filter is increased. Also quality factor and inductance value can be tuned to the required level. The analysis and implementation is obtained by the software CADENCE VIRTUOSO at 180nm technology.

articleTitle: An adaptive approach to improve scalability in large scale mesh networks
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Wireless Mesh Networks provide promising approach to provide internet connectivity to the users at low cost. The scalability in mesh network is the major subject of research community currently, as the number of users are increasing to access internet for online gaming, video streaming, and security applications. The scalable features are very much necessary for any type of network (wired or wireless) to provide a quality service in case of large number of users and traffic loads by utilizing existing software and hardware resources. The packet level constraints such as; jitter effect, delay, Overhead, data loss and bandwidth are used to determine the scalability of system applications, but it is not much efficient as per the user perception. In this paper, the Relay Node based selection approach called an Adaptive Informant Factor (AIF) is considered in order to improve the maximal transmission of bitrate, reducing error rate, and hence increasing scalability. The AIF can be considered as the advanced objective metric and the performance comparison of our proposed algorithm is completed against the other existing solutions in terms of scalability and the optimized wireless network capacity.

articleTitle: A Compact Quad band Slot Antenna for WLAN/WiMAX/X-band Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: A slotted multiband planar antenna for WLAN/WiMAX/X-band is reported. The antenna consists of an annular slot in the radiating patch and E-shaped slot in the ground plane. Multiband operation at 2.4, 3.2, 5.84 and 9.96GHz is accomplished by utilizing E-shaped slot, while the impedance matching at the resonance is controlled by annular slot. The proposed structure has a compact dimension of 0.14λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">l</sub> × 0.14λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">l</sub> × 0.01λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">l</sub> at lower frequency of 2.4GHz. The antenna has S11<; -10dB bandwidth of 4.6%, 3.02%, 2.73% and 15.7% with frequency ranging from 2.3-2.4GHz, 3.18-3.2GHz, 5.6-6.01GHz and 8.8-10.41GHz, respectively.

articleTitle: Identification and Classification of Retinal Lesions for Early Detection of Diabetic Retinopathy using Fundal Image
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) is a human eye disease which may cause damage to retina of eye, it may lead to complete blindness. Currently diabetic retinopathy is detected using different types of lesions such as Microaneursyms (MAs), Exudates (EXs) and Hemorrhages (HAs). This paper focuses on the identification and classification of lesions for early detection of Diabetic retinopathy through hybrid morphological approach. In the proposed approach the detection of DR is performed through hybrid pre-post processing methods to enhance the lesion detection execution. In addition by using the area of boundaries scheme, the affected regions are identified as initial, middle and severe stage. Performance analysis of the proposed method is demonstrated using Matlab software. Simulation studies on available database prove that the hybrid approach has improved performance over classical approach.

articleTitle: Feeder Weeder for Autonomous Farming
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Agriculture is known as backbone of Indian economy. A large number of rural households depend upon agriculture as their primary source of livelihood. Recent advances in technology have made it possible to increase output as well as reduce dependence on manual labour. Fertilizing plants and removing weeds is very important in agriculture. Weeds are traditionally removed by manually plucking them. The solution we derived is to use grid system for sowing plants. This way it is easier to differentiate between plants and weeds. By using robot module we can fertilize only the required area around root cavity. (This avoids human error of spilling). Because of the grid system the positions of plants is known before so that any other plants can be considered as weeds and removed. In the proposed system Feeder-Weeder, we have considered a scenario where all of the work done on farms is automated by a group of autonomous robots working together in sync with each other. In this paper, concepts such as microcontroller programming, communication, path planning, sensor interfacing are used. An agricultural field with many crops growing in it is considered. Here some of these crops need to be fed with two different fertilizers. In addition to this, there are some weeds growing in the field which need to uprooted and disposed outside the field. In order to complete these tasks two Fertilizer Robots and a Weeding Robot are deployed in the field. To make this system work more efficiently, the robots communicate between each other to share information and coordinate with each other. The concept used in this paper is adopted from Swarm robotics where different robots communicate with each other using wireless Zigbee module and get the specified task done.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of the Harmonic Rejection Capability of a TCLC Shunt Compensator
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Harmonic elimination and reactive compensation have been a subject of interest for power engineers for the past many years. Traditional static var compensators like FC-TCR are able to do dynamic reactive power compensation but they generate low order harmonics during its operation, thus deteriorating the system performance. Active compensators with efficient controllers can effectively mitigate harmonics, but they are very costly compared to passive filters. This paper discusses the effectiveness of using a Thyristor Controlled LC (TCLC) compensator for harmonic current elimination in power system. Instantaneous Reactive Power Theory (IRPT) control algorithm is used for obtaining reference currents for the compensator. A three-phase TCLC compensator is simulated in MATLAB Simulink and the performance during dynamic load change is analysed. The results obtained prove that the compensator with IRPT controller is effective in rejecting the harmonics in a power distribution system.

articleTitle: High Efficiency Closed Loop Boost Inverter for Standalone Power Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Rapid developments in the field of renewable energy sources and decreasing cost per unit poses a good viable alternative to the traditional grid connected power which is hard to reach in remote areas. This paper presents a novel high efficiency boost inverter topology with a closed loop control system to be used for standalone power applications. The reported literature so far employs complicated algorithms to convert the energy stored to domestically usable AC power with high quality. In this design we have shown how a microcontroller can be used with minimal hardware to put together a high efficiency closed loop boost inverter and provide good quality of power under all load conditions leading to exceptional advantage over the conventional inverters today available. We have used here a voltage feedback mechanism which shall directly control the SPWM output. This helped us achieve voltage regulation and low Total Harmonic Distortion (THD).

articleTitle: MIMO-OFDM System Analysis over Distinct Fading Channels with Different Modulation Techniques
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: As the generations are being incremented, the wireless technology is being desperate for increased data rate transmission and high reliability. MIMO-OFDM would be a flawless provision as it could meet the demands of advanced wireless technology and could be an asset at its best. In aforementioned paper, execution is computed with reference to BER vs. SNR and we confer about implementation of BER of MIMO-OFDM system with respect to zero forcing equalizer (ZFE) for heterogeneous modulation-techniques such as BPSK, QPSK, 16QAM, 64QAM and 256QAM under distinct fading-channels (Rayleigh, Rician and AWGN). The multicarrier modulation is bought into existence as it has a beneficial merit of eradicating ISI, increasing data transmission, reliability and multipath fading problems. Finally, in the simulated graphs with ZFE, the BER has an optimum result with BPSK modulation and exceedingly we analyzed over different fading channels in contemplation with distinct modulation techniques with ZFE.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Blood Vessel Segmentation in Sclera Images
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Sclera is used for the authentication of biometric threats. Sclera is the opaque and white outer layer of the eyeball. This and only those part of eye has noticeable blood veins which are unsystematically disseminated and differs from one person to another, hence it is used for the recognition systems. The main focus of this paper is to develop algorithm of Sclera identification and segmentation with high accuracy and less time complexity. The system comprises of segmentation using active contours without edges method then enhancement, extraction and matching process. UBIRIS.v1 and UTIRIS databases are used so has to obtain high accuracy and less complexity.

articleTitle: Power Factor Regulation Using Landsman Converter Fed BLDC Motor Drive
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This paper imparts the regulation of power factor for a low-power applications with the help Landsman converter that drives BLDCM motor. The drive speed can be attained by regulating the DC voltage of VSI that feeds BLDCM. The converter is operated in DICM to control DC voltage and the VSI in low switching frequency, reduces the switching losses. The performance of the drive is evaluated for different loading conditions PSIM Tool.

articleTitle: Performance of FBMC for 5G Communication
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In this paper, performance of 5G Filter Bank Multi-Carrier (FBMC) system that reduces the problems in 4G (OFDM) system, which uses a banks of filter instead of using the Cyclic Prefix (CPs). FBMC is a form of multicarrier modulation technique that is highly used for high date rate cellular and wireless systems. The Prototype filter response called (Physical layer for Dynamic Spectrum Access and cognitive radio -PHYDYAS), used in 5G (FBMC) was implemented using the MATLAB and Python Simulation tools. The Performance of Bit Error Rate (BER) versus Signal to Noise Ratio (SNR) and Peak to Average Power Ratio (PAPR) is implemented in Filter Bank Multicarrier (FBMC) modulation technique. The comparison of sub channel Inter Carrier Interference (ICI) for OFDM and FBMC is also computed. ICI is reduced significantly for FBMC when compared to OFDM. This paper shows BER is reduced in FBMC. The PAPR is greatly reduced from the maximum power of Power Spectral Density (PSD) in FBMC compared to OFDM.

articleTitle: Study of Various Data Recovery and Data Back Up Techniques in Cloud Computing & Their Comparison
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Data Protection is an earnest action necessary for both government and corporate authority. The continuous revolution in regarding ritualized servers that joined with raising data security necessities has become troublesome for IT relationship to enhance. From the data being insured to testand approve the recover limit of the data; recovery point objectives (RPO) and recovery time objective (RTO) have made data security periodically safer. Cloud computing is quickly converting into the engaged data security elective for some of the IT affiliations. The cloud computing requires assured data security and its necessities are met while solving or alleviating the issues related with conventional data security methods. This paper analyzes these agonizing issues and how cloud reinforcement innovation overcomes them and furthermore gives a study on different reinforcement procedures used for Cloud figuring stage with respect to this stress and their execution evaluation. So in this paper we have presented a novel algorithm named seed block algorithm. The advantages of this algorithm are that first it helps user to collect information from any remote location without any problem and second it recovers the data also in case of delete or the cloud gets destroyed.

articleTitle: Development of embedded system for monitoring of real time harmonics
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Power quality has gained increased importance in power industry in the last two decades. The quality of power is getting affected due to use of power electronic converters and all types of dynamic and non-linear loads. Harmonic pollution increases plant downtimes and power losses. Harmonics of an electrical signal is the content of the signal whose frequency is an integer multiple of the fundamental system frequency. In power system, harmonic analysis is used to determine the impact of harmonic producing load on the power system. This technique is widely used for system planning, equipment design, troubleshooting etc. The effect of harmonics on a power system can be in the form of power efficiency reduction, overheating in conductors, ageing of electrical insulation, etc. There are several algorithms for harmonic analysis. The Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) is the most widely used computation algorithm. FFT is an efficient algorithm used to compute Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT). DFT uses a finite set of discrete-time samples of an analogue signal and produces a finite set of discrete-frequency magnitude spectrum values. The paper focuses on real time monitoring of harmonics using a low cost processor. The low cost of the system will allow utilities, industries to implement the system for monitoring harmonics and to take real time corrective actions.

articleTitle: Suppression of Four Wave Mixing effects using OPC Technique in 3×10 Gb/s OFDM-WDM system
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Four wave mixing (FWM) is one of the most significant cause of nonlinear crosstalk in multiple-channel optical fiber system. Therefore, significant efforts have been made on the development of different techniques to mitigate the effect of FWM. This paper puts efforts towards the suppression of FWM-based fiber impairments in a 3×10 Gb/s orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM)-based wavelength division multiplexing (WDM) system. In case of OFDM technique, FWM effect becomes most critical to handle with increasing number of subcarriers. The optical phase conjugation (OPC) technique is among the most appropriate techniques to mitigate the nonlinear effects in an optical link. Further, the performance of the OPC technique is also compared with the existing technique related to polarization of input signals. The results show an improvement in signal quality by 8 dBm suppression of FWM power product in case of 128 subcarriers in comparison to the polarization technique. Further, OPC technique also reduced the FWM power product by 1.5 dBm at higher dispersion rates (>5 ps/nm/km).

articleTitle: Analyzing Security Attack on Layer 2 and Comparing the Performance of Different Routing Protocols
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Companies nowadays are becoming more dependent on information technology. Non-stop access to emails, file servers and databases is no longer a competitive advantage rather has become a vital necessity. Constant network availability, which can be effected by both layer 2 and layer 3 devices, is one of the most important aspects one must consider while planning a network topology. For the layer 2 devices (mostly switches) security has become a major concern in most of the organization which can cause a major downtime. It has been observed that most of these attacks occur internally from the organization. In this paper, a security attack will be performed in the internal switch network by modifying the Spanning Tree Protocol BPDUs(Bridge Protocol Data Units) which will change the root bridge of the network and effective command to prevent that attack will be demonstrated. Layer 3 devices such as routers can also become a cause of a slight downtime depending upon the routing protocol used in the network. With the growing internet, IPv6 addressing scheme is used to satisfy the increasing complex requirements. So, there is a need of comparison of different routing protocols over IPv6 networks. In this study, the performance of three popular routing protocols RIPng, OSPFv3 and EIGRP with IPv6 addressing is done based on different parameters (Convergence time, Round Trip Time) that can cause a downtime.

articleTitle: Low flow corrosion resistant ultrasonic flow sensor
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This paper describes a novel ultrasonic technique which can be used to measure the volumetric flowrate of industrial gases like H2s, Hci, Nh3, NOx, SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, Cl<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> etc. which are highly corrosive in nature. This technique is specifically designed to measure very low flowrates of the above-mentioned gases in an industrial environment. Typical gas flowmeters are susceptible to corrosion in the presence of reactive materials and thus require frequent maintenance or even replacement at times. The measurement technique presented in this paper takes care of the corrosion aspect to a certain extent without affecting its own performance at low flow rates.

articleTitle: Visualization of the Veins of the Upper limb with the aid of a cost effective vein viewer for medical diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Presently doctors find it very difficult to inject medicine into the veins for any intravenous procedure. This procedure can be cumbersome, especially for subjects with thin veins or who are obese or for patients with damaged skin. Pediatric patients also belong to this class of people because their veins are extremely thin due to the desired vein in pediatric patients. As of now, vein detection is among the latest techniques being researched today to resolve this issue. The present work includes the development of a cost effective vein viewer using a raspberry Pi kit with the aid of infrared rays to illuminate a region which is then observed using an infrared camera. By using this device, the results achieved were quite encouraging besides indicating the huge market potential for the technology. The results obtained showed that the presently developed technology was quite helpful in detecting the veins. their infancy. In case of extreme emergencies involving the aforementioned patients, it becomes difficult to feed/detect specific veins for carrying out the IV procedure, and the delay in treatment may become life threatening. Clinical staff often finds it difficult to locate.

articleTitle: Efficient High Performance Successive Cancelation Decoder for Polar Code
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Polar code is an error correction technique developed by Arikan in information theory field. It has an advantage of low complexity in encoding and decoding process. Various methods are proposed by researchers, for efficient decoding of polar code. Successive Cancelation Decoding (SCD) is one of the popular method of decoding in polar code. It has high capacity achieving capabilities as well as carrying low complexity. However it is not efficient enough to use in low latency applications. In this paper an efficient improved polar code algorithm is developed for decoding process known as Modified Successive Cancelation Decoding (MSCD). It has significantly affected the polar code performance. The performance of the polar code is presented in the form of Bit Error Rate (BER) and Frame Error Rate (FER), which is superior compare to SCD.

articleTitle: QoS Aware Load Balancing in Cognitive Wireless Sensor Networks using Machine Learning Concepts
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: As energy is limited resource in Wireless Sensor Networks, it is required to utilize the resource carefully to maximize the life time of the network. The dramatic increase in data traffic leads to consume more energy in WSNs. Hence, to achieve an excellent Quality of Service (QoS), it is necessary to reduce the energy consumption and optimize the resource utilization efficiently to improve network performance. To attain this, WSNs often adapt Machine Learning techniques which provide practical solutions for many issues, maximize resource utilization, and prolong lifespan of the network. Cognition technique is adapted for efficient utilization of the spectrum. In this research article,we propose an algorithm that enhance end-to-end throughput in Cognitive Wireless Sensor Networks by exploiting available resources using machine learning techniques. With the increase in the throughput, the proposed algorithm proved there 62% improvement in the energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of on-chip ramp generator for power management IC's using cadence
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: DC-DC converters are widely used in many applications and are most popular in electronic industry. In this paper we have designed an on chip ramp generator for power management IC that could be used in DC-DC Buck converter for controlling the duty cycle oexf the pulse width modulated signal. The on-ramp generator is implemented using the current charging and discharging circuit and comparator. The DC-DC Buck converter circuit is designed for an output voltage of 1.2V at a switching frequency of 1 MHz for variable input voltage from 3V to 8V. The effects of input voltage variation, load variation are handled by the feedback network and On-chip ramp generator circuit. The Design Modeling and simulation of closed loop buck converter is carried out using cadence tool with 180nm technology.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Quantitative Data Analysis Methods in the Prediction of Angiographic Disease Status
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Data Analytics play a significant role in arriving at crucial conclusions by sifting large volumes of data. Predictive analytics in healthcare is taking a new paradigm shift with the advent of efficient data mining techniques to identify interesting patterns which otherwise go unnoticed. Ensemble methods boost this process by forming strong classification tree models which perform better than its component models. Mining health datasets require high degree of precision to arrive at valid conclusions and selecting the best classifier is a critical task for that. This present work evaluates the classification models namely Decision Tree, Naïve Bayes, k-Nearest Neighbour, Rule Induction and Random Forest to find the best performing models to predict the Angiographic Disease status that is important in diagnosing heart disease.
