Considering the ROC curve, optimal performance is shown by Naïve Bayes and Random Forest among the selected classifiers.

articleTitle: Deployment of Hybrid Neural Network to Detect Breast Cancer in Mammogram Images Using GLCM And K-Mean Clustering
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: An efficient technique to detect the severity of the tumor and to classify the breast cancer at its early stage. For radiologists, it is very essential to know the presence of cancer so the affected patient can take early prevention. The excess segregation of calcium content which may also defined as pectoral muscle causes breast cancer. In this paper source image from MIAS will be processed segmented and get compared with test images to analyze the affected tumor part. Histogram equalization is used for image enhancement, K-Mean clustering for segmentation, GLCM for feature extraction and Hybrid neural network for classification of stages.

articleTitle: Frequency estimation in Power Systems:A brief comparison of Phase locked loops and its derivatives
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Frequency estimation has been a key parameter for determining the working status of Power System. In this paper performance of phase locked loops and its advancements like enhanced phase locked loops and Pseudo Linear Enhanced phase locked loops are compared on basis of their accuracy, robustness, time computation. Various operating conditions such as harmonic content, noise are taken into account for analyzing the performance of these algorithms in MATLAB/SIMULINK environment.

articleTitle: Impact of Weighting Schemes on Network Selection in Heterogeneous Wireless Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Current wireless communication environment is purely heterogeneous, where multiple networks with diverse technologies coexist to provide ubiquitous coverage and multiple services to the user. In such an environment selection of an optimal network has been an important issue for smart terminal users and network providers for many years. This is because improper selection will produce adverse effects on the user and overall network performance. In this article, Preference Ranking Organization Method for Enrichment Evaluations (PROME THEE) an outranking method is applied to address the problem of optimal network selection. PROMETHEE selection mainly depends on the weights assigned to each of the decision criteria. Weights represent the importance assigned to each criterion for obtaining a predefined quality of service from each network In this paper the impact of various weight elicitation schemes on network selection is investigated.

articleTitle: Vibration Signal Analysis of Rotating Machines Using VoId-Kalman Filter & Phase Analysis Technique
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Rotating machine are the most common part of all types of industry. Phase analysis is very important to fully understand the force presents and how destructive the vibration truly is. There are several methods used to detect machinery faults such as time-frequency techniques like Wavelet Techniques (WT), Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD), Hilbert-Haung Transform (HHT). There are different order tracking techniques like Re-sampling, Gabor Expansion order tracking (GEOT), Computed Order Tracking (COT), Vold-kalman filter order tracking (VKFOT). Vold-Kalman Order Tracking Filter extract time-domain waveform of dominant orders. By using this time-domain order waveform we can find absolute phase of each order waveform very accurately. The proposed work shows a novel approach of absolute phase calculation based on Vold-Kalman order tracking algorithm. This method can be used for any fault identification process in vibration conditioning monitoring.

articleTitle: Designing a Speech Interface for Voice activated MAV Ground Control Station
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Flying Micro Aerial Vehicle (MAV) through speech command helps untrained professionals to conveniently control the flight. Such a control is achieved through Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) and Natural Language Processing (NLP) technologies. This paper describes the development of MAV Ground Control Station (GCS) with a speech interface to enable issuing of Voice Commands. The paper also presents the performance of the speech interface during a flight trial.

articleTitle: An Efficient Metamaterial Radio Wave Absorber for 2.4GHz ISM band
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This paper describes a metamaterial radio wave absorber working at 2.4GHz ISM band. The absorber is designed using circular split ring resonators and wire strips. It is modelled using Ansys HFSS 14 and is fabricated on CMET_LD 2.9 substrate with dielectric constant of 2.9 and loss tangent of 0.002. The selection of this ultra-low loss substrate with lower dielectric constant is to increase the efficiency of the absorber by trapping more electromagnetic energy in to it. The proposed structure is compact and exhibits 84.7% absorption at 2.4GHz band. A dual diode rectenna is employed to demonstrate the power absorbing capability of the proposed metamaterial array.

Author Keywords: Dual diode rectenna and Split ring resonator

articleTitle: ThSV based three dimension devise to optimize Low Energy and Reliable Timer Using MNM Technique
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The work focuses on less-energy and trustworthy system of timer plan with through-silicon via (ThSV) which depends on three dimension stacked Chips (three dimension ICs). This work also finds the effect of counting ThSV and the ThSV resistive and capacitive parasitic on utilization of timer control. Followed by the work on parameters that reflect changes the generally wire measurement size wise and timer energy in three dimension timer system model and lastly develop a 2 stair three dimension timer hierarchy fusion method based on three dimension technique [i.e. technique of Means and Medians] which determine the best possible count of ThSV to be utilized in the three dimension timer hierarchy. Hence the whole energy expenditure is reduced. A critical observation is the saturation trend of IR drops in 3-D PDNs with increased TSV size. It suggests the need for first finding the optimal TSV size given the on-chip grids in 3-D stacked layers such that the least amount of silicon penalty is incurred. The simulation outcomes are evaluated in H-SPICE.

Author Keywords: minimal-energy models of three dimensions CHIPS

articleTitle: Analysis of Supercapacitor based on Carbon-Graphite-Metal oxide composition
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Electricity has been one aspect of technology which has changed human history and the demand for it never ceases. The quantity of conventional energy sources is decreasing and in future the amount left would not be able to suffice all the needs of the ever-increasing human population. Energy storage is one of the undeniable problems which arise while using the nonconventional resources. Battery is most viable option. However, there is need to look beyond batteries. Supercapacitor is upcoming energy storage technology. Success of supercapacitor technology lies in the carbon based electrode material. Graphite has made good impact in recent past in energy sector. It is very cheap compared to many activated carbons. Use of graphite, activated carbon and metal oxide in correct proportion needs to be investigated as it is likely to reduce the cost of supercapacitor which is major hurdle in commercialization of this device. This paper presents trials of the supercapacitors made using different activated carbons, graphite and fixed proportion of metal oxide.

articleTitle: Design and Comparitive Analysis of Memristor and Magnetic Tunnel Junction (MTJ) based Non-Volatile SRAM Cell
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Static Random Access Memories (SRAMs) are widely used in building caches and buffers. Reducing the power consumed by the memory with high Static Noise Margin (SNM) is advantageous for its usage in portable devices. The conventional 6T SRAM has high speed but it is volatile. In this paper Non-Volatile (NV) Magnetic Tunnel Junction (MTJ) based 8T SRAM is proposed. Non-Volatile SRAM with Memristor is implemented and the comparative analysis is carried out between Memristor and MTJ based NVSRAM. The power consumption has been reduced and SNM is increased in the proposed model. The proposed NVSRAM with MTJ has 12.14% reduction in power and 36.84% increase in SNM when compared to NVSRAM with Memristor. Power consumption of Memristor is more due to its resistive component. A single bit NVSRAM cell is simulated using the Cadence 180 nm technology.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Geographic Routing Protocol for Wireless Ad-hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In a network, communication between nodes is implemented through packets being sent and received with rates as high as hundreds per second over a distance ranging from a few meters to thousands of kilometers. When dealing with such high values it becomes necessary to conduct cost-effective route selection while ensuring timely delivery of packets. The objective of the route selection includes less traffic congestion, route stability, efficient power consumption and lesser number of intermediate hops. This paper proposes “Multi-Objective Geographic Routing Protocol“(MGRP) wherein next forwarder node is selected based on a cost function taking into account not only the amount of forward progress that can be achieved and least energy spent by a node to forward a packet but also the congestion levels of the nodes and availability of potential forwarders in the range of the one-hop neighbors of the current packet holder so that unnecessary queuing delays, re-routing and delivery failure are avoided. Since the protocol also considers congestion levels at neighboring nodes queuing delays at congested nodes are avoided with improvement in energy-economic, end-to-end transmission delay and a high success packet delivery rate. The simulation of the proposed protocol is done in NS-3. The results of the propsed model's algorithm is generated and compared with that of Congestion-Aware-Forwarder-Selection-Protocol(Cafs).It is seen that the hop count for packet delivery in the same topology is lesser for MGRP than CAFS. It is also seen that the success rate for MGRP is higher than CAFS under same conditions and simulation topologies. Therefore, MGRP is superior to its predecessor CAFS in terms of success rate and hop count.

articleTitle: Local Operator Interface (LOI) Testing using Intelligent System
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel approach to automate the Local Operator Interface (LOI) of the devices, ranging from touch screen to keypad based devices, tablets to mobile phones etc. for improvement of the manufacturing and process system. In this, a deep learning algorithm has been developed that recognizes the local operator interface (LOI) device screen based on its visual information. To construct the weights between the neurons, a convolutional neural network (CNN), has been implemented to develop the entire structure of neural network. This network allows us in identifying the device screen, which is a challenging task due to dynamic nature of these screen images. Furthermore, detailed architecture of overall system for automation of local operator interface testing has also been described.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Heater Control Unit for Passenger car (HCU-PC)
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The vehicles are increasing day by day, due to which emission of nitrogen oxide gases are consequently increasing which is leading to the various adverse effects to the life of humankind. NOx gases will cause smog, acid rain and formation of fine particles (PM) which are hazardous to health. NOx gases produced from the reaction of nitrogen and oxygen gases during combustion, especially at high temperatures. In areas of high motor vehicle traffic, such as in large cities, the amount of nitrogen oxides emitted into the atmosphere as air pollution can be significant. The exhaust gas gets treatment before releasing into atmosphere before tail pipe with Adblue liquid (32.5% of urea in water). This liquid reacts with exhaust gas and converts nitrogen oxides into nitrogen and water but the problem is to maintain Adblue liquid to desired temperature mainly in European countries (cold regions). BOSCH has developed heater control unit for passenger cars using Freescale microcontroller, which have only two heater elements i.e. there is no flexibility in current design to add & drive extra heater element. Therefore, this project aims at developing a new RCV-PC, with flexibility on number of heater elements (maximum up to 4) along with more Flash Size for additional feature implementation, less power consumption and low cost compared to the existing RCV-PC. For development, IAR Embedded Workbench for Renesas RL78 (version 1.40.5) is used.

articleTitle: Human Action Analysis With SVM Approach
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Human action analysis in present days is a very common topic in computer based vision researches and other medical application. The main goal of human action analysis is to analysis of what events is going on from video data. In a video that is the input, local space time captures local events in terms of neighborhood points in video sequence and that can be changed accordingly in its size, velocity and the frequency of video patterns. A reliable system having feature of recognizing various human action has many applications in real time world. The few applications where action analysis is required include surveillance security systems, health-care monitoring, and many more systems that involve human computer interface devices. It fulfill our requirement as to how such variety of events can be utilize to analyze complex motion patterns also with various graph for various sequences of human action that can be captured from mobile. The video representation is constructed in terms of interest points and compared this representation with SVM classifier from given sets of data for recognition. The result shown for activity analysis shows the method of its advantage compared to other method for action recognition.

articleTitle: Randomized Visual Cryptography to Enhance Security
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In visual cryptography, a binary secret image is encoded to produce shares. To increase the security of secret image, it is encoded along with the cover images to obtain shares by random grids method. In this method there is no extra pixel expansion and codebook is not required. The probability parameter β is used to produce the basis matrix and β is varied to check the visual quality of the recovered image. PSNR is calculated for the recovered /decrypted image for different values of β. This scheme improves the quality of recovered image and provides more security.

articleTitle: Study of OAM mode purity by changing the orientation of antenna element
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Orbital angular momentum concept has discussed with the help of mathematical equations. An investigation of 8 elements uniform circular array (UCA) for different Orbital Angular Momentum (OAM) modes is carried out for three designs. The effect of array radius on OAM purity and the radial outward design to reduce phase complexity is discussed. Uniform circular antenna array for all possible combination has been simulated and its results are demonstrated for different physical and electrical characteristic.

articleTitle: Grid-based Multi-clustering Protocol for Wireless Sensor Network using Sugeno Fuzzy Inference System
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In wireless sensor network, clustering-based data gathering is an important approach for achieving energy efficiency. In the existing clustering algorithm, either cluster heads are selected in each round or after a fixed number of rounds of data collection. Selection of cluster head in each round causes more communication overhead in the network. However, selection of cluster head after a fixed number of rounds causes premature death of overloaded cluster head and unbalanced energy consumption among the nodes. In order to solve premature death of cluster head as well as unbalanced energy consumption, this paper proposes a Grid-based multi-clustering protocol using sugeno fuzzy inference system. Performance evaluation of the proposed protocol and its comparison with the three well-known clustering protocols are presented in detail.

articleTitle: Morphology Based Real Time Human Detection
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Detection of moving object is a challenging task. Object detection is an important technology in the field of computer vision, robotics, surveillance, security etc. The security attacks are increasing day to day. So the human detection's importance is also increased a lot. In these days we are using cameras for security purpose. In this paper trying to develop a algorithm for human detection by analyzing the camera output. Analyze the video and trying to detect the human presence. In order to analyze the video for human detection we are using a morphology based method. By using the edge morphology method detect the human presence.

articleTitle: Design of Clock and Data recovery circuit using current starved VCO working with less jitter
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In this paper a Clock and Data recovery (CDR) circuit is presented which is based on current starved VCO. The output frequency varies up to 2GHz at data rate of 0.5ns. It is working from to 200MHz to 2GHz. It is highly linear using Hogge phase detector that is based on GDI based XOR gate. It uses current starved VCO that is used in wireless communication and it is unaffected by supply variation and the VCO frequency varies with resistor value. The clock jitter at output is 436.056fs at 1.18GHz with less power dissipation at the output. The CDR is designed in cadence virtuoso 180nm technology.

articleTitle: High Performance GDI-ALU Using 10T Adder Cells
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Gate diffusion input (GDI)—is a latest inventive technique that has been significant in improving the digital logic performance while incorporated in CMOS VLSI circuit design. This paper concentrates on the design and execution of 4 bit CMOS (GDI) ALU suitable for low power and high speed processing. The ALU being a core block in microprocessors, its design to enhance the operating performance has attained greater importance in today's downscaled technology. Initially, a low power 10T Full adder has been designed with GDI technique using 22nm CMOS scaling. This is one of the building blocks for implementing the functions of a 4-bit GDI-ALU operation. The design has been benchmarked with the conventional CMOS ALU and CMOS pass transistor based ALUs for substantiating the performance statistics such as power, delay and Power Delay Product (PDP). The proposed design offers a robust performance with compact architecture, low power operation with reduced propagation delay.

articleTitle: Inconstant Threshold Keeper & Footer Mirror (ITKFM) Technique for Wide Fan-In Domino Logic Gates
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Scant power consumption, high-speed behavior of Domino logic has made it one of the most reliable circuit building logic among all the circuit building logics in VLSI. Though domino logic helps in reduction of power consumption and propagation delay to a certain extent, it fails to reduce both simultaneously. The reduction of either of them increases the other simultaneously. Thus, the paper proposes “Inconstant threshold keeper and footer mirror (ITKFM)” technique for Dominos logic gates which reduces the power consumption without violating the propagation delay of the circuits. Using ITKFM approach the inconstant threshold voltage to keeper transistor is provided by employing body bias generator which further reduces the contention current, the technique also provides a footer mirror transistor for reduction of sub-threshold leakage and prevention of possible short circuits. These two features of ITKFM technique helps in consumption power reduction without deteriorating propagation delay of the domino logic gate. Thus, using ITKFM technique power consumption of about 64% was reduced in comparison with conventional domino circuit. The simulation results were obtained for CMOS 22nm device scaling with a power supply of 1 Volt

articleTitle: Blow Fish and LSB Algorithm based Reversible data hiding in the encrypted image
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This paper gives an innovative proposed idea of data hiding in the reversible format through two different schemes. The image and the data have been encrypted using Least Bit Algorithm (LSB) and after the encryption of the original image by the sender side the sequence of bits will be selected and compressed by the data-hider to which some of the specified room should be selected for creating the cipher text. Through usage of the blowfish algorithm, selected cipher bits are to be encoded. At the receiver part, hidden bits could be obtained, and if in case the image receiver possess embedded key, while decrypting the image on the receiver side along with the data, the image can be extracted by the estimating algorithm using MATLAB. The proposed system will perform outstandingly when compared to the other existing methods used before.

articleTitle: A DC-DC Converter with High Gain Suitable for Crop Machinery
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In many industrial applications dc-dc converter with more gain plays a very important role in fuel cell based vehicles, hybrid electrical vehicles, photovoltaic energy generation system, e.t.c. to step up the low output voltage from sources. Many converters with more gain available but they have some disadvantages like high current ripple at input, large stress across switch, low efficiency. A dc-dc converter present here has more voltage gain, less ripple at input current, voltage stress of the switch is low with more efficiency. System uses solar is the source. P&O mppt controller is used here to obtain the maximum power from solar panel. High gain port of converter is connected to the bldc motor used in the crop machinery through inverter.

articleTitle: Real-time Water Quality Monitoring using WSN
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In recent times, Wireless sensor networks are becoming an efficient way to keep a watch on various vital parameters in nature. They can become governing network layers in applications which are used to monitor pollution. The application proposed thus uses the concept of WSN and IoT to monitor parameters via every node including pH, turbidity and temperature which are systematically stored and made available on the cloud. The client system consists of a mobile application which can fetch this data and integrate plots which can facilitate the users to understand the system better. The system runs on solar power cutting down on additional costs and has a long range as it runs on Wi-Fi, System also runs a Graphical User Interface (GUI) which is made available to the public.

articleTitle: Characterization system for Large Area Electronic Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Large area electronic systems use either an active or passive matrix sensory back plane as the major component in the system design. These backplanes are vulnerable to interconnection errors and poor device performances. Hence reliability studies pertaining to the systems of these order are relevant. In this paper we discuss the development of a sensor array characterization system which can not only detect interconnect faults, but also characterize the access switches in the array. Switched capacitor circuits based on n channel MOSFETs and RC networks are used for demonstrating the utility of the system in active addressing and passive addressing schemes respectively. In Switched capacitor circuit based backplane, an approximate transfer characteristics is obtained by measuring the time averaged current through the MOSFET in response to an applied gate voltage, while time constant estimation is done for characterizing the RC networks.

articleTitle: Machine learning models to predict the dropouts in Massive Open Online Courses
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Massive Open Online Courses have emerged as an alternative to the traditional educational system because of the flexibility in timings and also it overcomes the economic and geographical barriers for the users. MOOCs also help learners from diverse background to communicate and exchange knowledge in MOOCs forums. The number of learners enrolling for such courses is very high, despite the unrestricted accessibility the completion rate is very low. Various factors affect the completion of the course by the students such as interest in the subject, purpose of enrolling in the subject, whether the lecturer is able to convey his knowledge to the students or not. EDM (Educational Data Mining) and LA (Learning Analytics) are the fields in which data of students learning activity is analyzed to obtain certain vital information or can be used in prediction using EDM tools and techniques. Data analysis shows that there is a strong relationship between the number of events such as click event, video watched forum post and the successful learner's outcome. Machine Learning algorithms are applied and the result shows that Decision Tree gives an optimum result with the highest performance.

articleTitle: Analysis of Binary Sequences with better correlation performance compared to Gold code under different doppler conditions for GNSS applications
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Terrestrial applications of Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS) systems are widely known and are growing. Apart from the terrestrial applications of the GNSS Systems, these systems are also being used as space borne GNSS receivers towards orbit estimation. The relative Doppler experienced by the GNSS receiver differs based on the location where these GNSS receivers are being placed namely, terrestrial receivers, space borne receivers, Medium Earth Orbit (MEO) receivers and Geostationary Earth Orbit (GEO) receivers. It is of importance to evaluate the correlation performance of the binary sequences being used in GNSS system under different relative Doppler conditions. In this paper mathematical expressions are derived for computing odd correlation (auto correlation and cross correlation) property and even correlation (auto correlation and cross correlation) property in the presence of Doppler frequencies using basic correlation functions. Doppler performance of the Gold code based Global Positioning Systems(GPS) L1 Course/Acquisition(C/A) signal is presented for both odd correlation and even correlation properties, and is compared with the new binary sequence generated using the proposed method. It is observed that the correlation properties of the proposed binary sequences are comparable to the state of the art Gold code based GPS L1 C/A signal under different the Doppler conditions.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Integrate Cyber-Physical World Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The concept of Internet of Things (abbreviated IoT) was evolved a decade ago and put into practice by industrial researchers. It came into main stream public view in the recent past years. Internet of Things involves devices to sense and collect the data in its vicinity which is shared over the internet where it can be processed and relevant action shall be performed. IoT is an end to end process that connects sensors and actuators to the cloud. IoT can make the environment around smarter, intelligent and user friendly. This work focuses on the development of an IoT System setup using low cost commodity Hardware and free open source software which is compact, portable, cost-effective and energy efficient.

articleTitle: Development of GUI for Detection of Glaucoma using FCM and SVM
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Glaucoma is one of the second principal eye disease in the world, if not treated legitimately may prompt to permanent blindness. There are no particular symptoms for this disease; it is seen by loss of side vision. Glaucoma is a moderate dynamic decay of the cells and the related cells such as the ganglions often termed as RGC's bringing about a distinct appearance to the optic nerve head (ONH), frequently called cupping. Because of cupping, the cup area increments and causes loss of side vision. Generally uniquely prepared clinicians physically review the fundus pictures in a tedious way. In this unique circumstance, we are trying to develop some novel algorithm for automatic detection of eyes affected with glaucoma using image processing filtering & transformation technique. In our research work, clustering by means of fuzzy logic along with support-vector-machine algorithms are used in the work. The tool that is used to obtain the simulation results is Matlab. could be the software platform that is being used. The simulation results shows the effectiveness of the method proposed.

articleTitle: Secondary Voltage and Droop Control Strategy of Parallel Converters based Cell-Level Battery Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Cell-level power processing in battery packs can provide better efficiency, reliability and safety benefits. As part of a broader investigation of how dual-active bridges can be used for such processing, a secondary voltage control and droop control strategy have been examined for the distributed power processing based battery (DPPB) energy storage system. The control strategy is divided into primary cell-level control with high gain droop and secondary voltage control and stability analysis. The performance of proposed control strategy is validated under different loading conditions by MATLAB<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">®</sup>, SIMULINK<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">®</sup>. The control strategy improves the power sharing of each cell in a DPPB, and voltage regulation of DPPB output.

articleTitle: Dual Band Metamaterial Absorber Using Concentric Split-Ring Structure For WLAN/WiMAX Application
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: A dual band metamaterial absorber using concentric split-ring geometry on a metal-backed dielectric substrate is presented in this article. The design exhibits dual band absorption peaks at frequencies 3.5 GHz and 5.8 GHz respectively, having absorptivity more than 96%, making the design suitable for application over the WLAN and WiMAX bands of operation. The structure utilizes concentric split-ring geometry for the unit cell of the absorber that is responsible for the exquisite metamaterial-like performance of the system. The surface currents on the top and the bottom plane of the structure are examined to analyze the dual band absorption performance. The structure exhibits similar characteristics for both TE and TM modes of polarizations. It is also insensitive to oblique incidence upto ±45°. The simple design and thin substrate used, establish the applicability and the utility of such a structure for practical applications.

articleTitle: An Encryption based Security Enhancer Tool for IaaS Applications in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Now a days, Cloud computing has become an enormous and popular technology among many users and enterprises in various industries due to the high class service it is able to provide to its customers. But still there exists a set of concerns that bring down the reliability of cloud-based services restricting its popularity to a great extent. The industries as well as individuals are forced to keep their confidential documents and data away from the cloud because managing user identities in the clouds still continue as a paramount issue in this area. Scientists are meticulously working on the issue of security and privacy which are leading causes of impeding its development and are main hindrance to ensuring the reliability in cloud-based environments. Exhaustive research is going on in this area as part of which we propose a new method to improve the data security and authentication of a user in a cloud. This is a SaaS application that will completely empower a user to manage his content in the cloud based on two levels of authentication and with the help of two types of encryption. This method proves to be a good approach that will amplify the pace of security and reliability in the cloud computing environments without vitiating its current efficiency and scalability.

articleTitle: Investigation of Performance of DSTATCOM with Improved Current Sensorless Controller
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The performance analysis of Distribution static compensator with a modified current sensorless controller which is designed for unbalanced load condition is presented in this paper. The investigation of the controller is performed with the presence of voltage sag and swell. To control terminal voltage and dc link, the proportional integral controller is used. The DSTATCOM is placed in IEEE 13 industrial system. The analysis is done in PSCAD/EMTDC package.

articleTitle: Design & Comparison of Lossless Polyphase Decomposition using Filter Bank for Onboard Digital Signal Processing Payload
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The M-channel transmultiplexer's for geo communication satellite are design and simulation in this paper. The mathematical description has been discussed in detail. Modified Discrete Fourier Transform(MDFT) and and cosined Discrete Transform(DCT) have chosen for advanced communication satellite. MDFT and DCT provide perfect reconstruction. The theory of filter bank satisfying the perfect reconstruction using proto FIR filter of length N= 2*M*m+1; where M = No. of channel. A new set of objective functions has been derived to satisfy the transmultiplexer's requirements based on these approaches. This work is done under the technology development program of ISRO. In this paper a comparison of the MDFT and DCT approaches are also described.

articleTitle: Implementation of VoIP Systems by Replacing EPABX Voice System
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Existing circuit switched network is limited only for voice communication as well as for each call, separate circuits need to be established. Whereas Voice over IP (VoIP) are cost effective when compared to EPABX. VoIP uses less number of cables and therefore provides simple connectivity. With the major disadvantage of complex connectivity, EPABX is little bit expensive for voice calling, video calling as well as for Short Message Service (SMS). Even though EPABX provides reliability, stability and accessibility but it requires more cables to connect other devices to one another. Thus, existing EPABX voice system is replaced by implementing VoIP system which establishes the call using data network. It also offers low cost for long distance and much more additional features like call management, instant messaging etc. As a result of this, VoIP technology is going to dominate the world swiftly unlike other new technologies which progresses slowly. Skype for business (SFB) is an application used to place and receive calls.

articleTitle: Voice Based Security System with Electronic Eye
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Voice is most prominent and primary mode of communication among of human being. Voice has potential of being unique and important mode of interaction with computer. This paper aims to identify a person through voice and card for bank locker security. A Voice recognition system is designed to identify an authorized person voice and Resistive card for unique id. Proposed work aims at providing two levels of security to user with respect to card and voice. For the result of testing the system, it successfully recognizes the specific user's voice and rejects other user voice. Using this method the accuracy of whole system is successfully maintained in recognizing the user's voice. And for further security purpose GSM sends a message to the user as authorized person or unauthorized person and wireless camera keep on monitoring as live video stream. After accessing voice and card of authorized person bank locker will be opened. If in case any of voice or card is not recognized, buzzer alerts an alarm.

articleTitle: Electronic Walking Stick for Blind Person
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Many guidance systems are available for visually impaired travelers to help safely against obstacles and other accidences faced. The entire model which consists of obstacle detection system sensors like IR sensor, Float sensor, vibration motor, earphones and other hardware components needs to be mounted on the stick. The proposed model for obstacle detection using commonly available electronic devices to alert blind person. The user can walk himself without anyone's help in common public places. If the user is in some problem by which he/she cannot respond, the proposed system informs pre-specified social contacts by sending message. Alerting the pre-specified social contacts is completely application development oriented.

articleTitle: Intelligent Based Alarm Management System for Plant Automation
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Currently SCADA system collects all alarms from the devices and show up to the operators. Alarming system in SCADA alerts the operator of any abnormal operating conditions in plant. If the alerts are not taken care at appropriate time then it may lead to device failure which can increase the cost of the inventory. Thus, alarm management system prevents or helps to at least minimize any physical or economic loss. The operator should respond with speed and accuracy to any high priority alarming condition. At times, it becomes very difficult for operators to analyze and take corrective action on very important alarms in shortest possible time i.e. problem of alarm flooding occurs. Hence, to solve the problem of alarm flooding, we proposed an alarm management system which uses machine learning techniques to filter the most important data to operators based on risk parameters. In this paper, we have also shown the implementation results of pre-processing phase of our proposed system. The results show that pre-processing phase improve the accuracy of system.

articleTitle: Enhanced Security of Sensitive Images by Cryptography and Hiding Methods
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Natural image based Visual Cryptography is an efficient technique used to secure sensitive images. Here images are hidden inside shares which appear as noise-like images. Now a days utmost concern is given to the privacy of images which includes fingerprint, signature and other secret information. This scheme suffers a high transmission risk since the secret images are hidden inside shares. In this paper, the generated share is firstly hidden in a printed media using QR technology and secondly in a cover media with the help of steganographic techniques. It enhances the security and reduces the risk of eavesdropping in the transmission phase. Experimental results show that steganography performs better. The average PSNR values of Steganography and QR technology are 26.81 dB and 22.45 dB respectively.

articleTitle: Verification and validation of data on Wi-Fi Over The Air(OTA)
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Automatic systems are not cost effective by any yardstick. As sophisticated door management system comes with the price tag struck immediately along with the utility. So, a simple prototype is designed for such robust system and it could be developed using OTA firmware with ESP8266 Wi-Fi module. ID's attached with RFID tags are the currently trending way of accounting the whereabouts and deriving more information through attached software system i.e. database. For the widespread use of RFID system whether in a huge IT sector or a small scale industry, the cost of deployment needs to be at the minimal. Using low powered SoC ESP8266 Wi-Fi module, EM-18 Serial RFID reader along with PC or raspberry pi as a server would effectively reduce the overall cost of deployment. PC loads all the data to the cloud which can be maintained as centralized server for sharing information globally between infrastructures.

articleTitle: Optimization for P&ID Development: The Time Efficient Approach
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This Piping and Instrumentation Diagram (P&ID) standardization in process industry makes a lot of sense. P&ID is a kind of control document. Many projects of similar kind are executed over time with some project specific changes. For such a project, designing fresh P&ID or editing old P&ID does take huge time. The mistakes in old versions are carried forward in next project as well. Instead of preparing new P&ID from scratch or editing previous projects P&ID, we standardize it. Standardizing is not only referring standard philosophy but also minimizing development hours to reduce time to market. Our method proves to be time efficient as well as fewer howlers. Onetime efforts can save many man hours. In this paper Instrumentation and other equipment option for an application are prepared in AutoCAD. Document thus prepared can be very much helpful while bidding also. As P&ID is the document of high importance in initial phase of project, if it could be completed in very short time then will be much beneficial to organization. Time and quality are measure constraints of project management, time invisibly refers to cost, and thus time for development of P&ID must be reduced.

articleTitle: Hybrid POS Classification Using Long Short Term Memory
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: A Part of Speech classifier is an important tool that is used to develop many NLP tasks. In this paper we described Deep Neural Network based architecture, that given a sentence, outputs a part-of-speech tag sequence. For Part of Speech classification, we trained a LSTM network by semi-supervised learning. We further applied a probabilistic approach to improve Part of Speech prediction of the LSTM network. Word2vec deep learning tool is used for learning high-quality distributed vector representations of words that capture a large number of precise word relationships. By using a small amount of labeled dataset of words and applying cosine similarity we assign Part of Speech tags to words. If some words don't show nearness to any word in labeled dataset, then we apply probabilistic approach for classification of unclassified words of input sentence. This hybrid neural Part of Speech classifier is evaluated over a corpus of 1000 sentences having a total of 7,400 words; part of speech classification system achieved the accuracy of 94.71 %.

articleTitle: Text Identification in Noncursive English Handwritten Script
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Handwritten script identification and converting it to printed electronic document as vast application. It helps to translate humanly readable to machine-readable text. This paper presents a technique to identify non cursive scanned, handwritten English script to digital document in notepad/MS-Office format using neural networks. Initially preprocessing of the input document image as conversion from RGB image to 8 bit gray scale, nonlinear contrast enhancement and mean normalization for correcting non uniform illumination and binarization are performed. Further the lines, words and characters of the input documents are localized in the preprocessed image and extracted from gray input image. Each extracted character of the gray input image is resized, normalized and used as input to the neural network for classification. The network consists of two layers feedforward network with sigmoid output neurons. The error back propagation algorithm is used for training. The proposed technique is tested on sample images from publically available CEDAR database as well as self created database with 1600 images for training and 620 images for testing purpose belonging to 62 classes. Overall Recognition accuracy of 95% is obtained. The performance of the proposed technique is also compared with the other existing technique.

articleTitle: Design and Hardware Implementation of Battery Charge Controller for Telecommunication System
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Telecommunication facilities are faced with the challenge of configuring a power supply that supports the network requirements as reliably and economically as possible. The telecommunication equipment generally requires 48VDC input power. Such power systems consist of multiple parallel-redundant rectifiers that convert AC power to required DC power. This power is utilized to charge lead-acid storage batteries and supply power to critical-loads. A charge controller or charge regulator is basically a voltage and/or current regulator to keep batteries from overcharging. It regulates the voltage and current coming from DC source going to the battery and load. This paper presents the improved charge controller for the telecommunication system using microcontroller (Renesas-RL78) based buck converter.

articleTitle: Design and Comparison of Optimized Low Power Reversible XS-3 Subtractor and Adder
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Excess (XS)-3 code is a self-complementary binary code which is basically used for performing arithmetic operations in digital circuits. One very basic use of the XS-3 code is that, we can easily compute subtractions involving 9. This paper explains the design and implementation of 4-bit excess-3 subtractor and adder using reversible logic in a single circuit, which can perform both addition and subtraction operations on encoded XS-3 bits. The motivation behind using the reversible logic is to enhance the energy efficiency by reducing the power dissipation. The principle of reversible logic operations is that, they can dissipate arbitrarily less heat. According to Landauer's theory the energy dissipated per irreversible logic operation approaches the fundamental limit of kT*ln(2), where k is Boltzmann's constant and T is temperature. Hence, the use of reversible logic operation overcomes this issue. The simulation results of this project are obtained by using Xilinx ISE Design Suite 14.2 and for power analysis Cadence Virtuoso is used.

articleTitle: Application of Quantum Cellular Automata in Image Steganography with an Improved Fault Tolerant Majority Voter
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Quantum Cellular Automata (QCA) is one of the powerful alternative to CMOS technology because of its low power and high speed. Because of the nano structure, Quantum dot cells are prone to get displaced or omitted during fabrication. Thus, it is very important to have the architecture of QCA gates to be resistant to such fabrication errors. Though many architectures have already been proposed for providing fault tolerance, percentage of fault tolerance provided by them is less than the architecture that we are proposing in this paper. In this paper we are proposing a new architecture to Majority Voter(MV) so as to make it fault tolerant to fabrication errors. We have also compared the proposed architecture to the existing ones for the cell misplacement effects namely single cell omission, extra cell deposition. Also, kink energy associated with the proposed architecture is calculated and is proved that the proposed architecture dissipates less power. Fault tolerant encoder and decoder are designed and simulated using the proposed fault tolerant MV. These encoders and decoders find application in Image Steganography.

articleTitle: Stagewise and Basis Pursuit Algorithms for Pattern Division Multiple Access (PDMA) in 5G Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In this paper, the Compressed Sensing Algorithm based 5G technique called Pattern Division Multiple Access (PDMA) is proposed for communication systems. A resource group is defined using PDMA patterns in terms of either time or frequency for data transmission. Users sharing the same resources are differentiated by utilizing those set of patterns, and the patterns are designed with different sparsity so as to increase the overall performance by preserving the estimation complexity to a normal extent. In a field containing large number of users, the number of people taking part in transfer of messages is quite less. Hence considering those inactive users to be sparse, an underdetermined PDMA system utilizes the Compressed Sensing (CS) techniques such as Stagewise Orthogonal Matching Pursuit (StOMP) and Basis Pursuit (BP) Algorithm where the active locations are caught in order to estimate the message signal. Hence, an improved performance in terms of Spectral efficiency, bit error rate and uplink-downlink performance is obtained through StOMP algorithm.

articleTitle: Double Stegging Design To Hide Message In Video Using AES And DWT Methods
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Steganography is an art of hiding the secret data or information inside the digitally covered information. Nowadays security aspects play a vital role in every system. Hacking is being developed in such a way that any style of encryption could be break, henceforth here there is an efficient approach to encrypt the plaintext or information within the video frames using dual stegging way of embedding into the carrier messages. The proposed work is carried out through Advanced AES and DWT techniques to hide desired message in video with advanced encryption and it is simulated using MATLAB.

articleTitle: Reliability Analysis of Memristor using Supervised Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This paper presents an approach to analyse reliability of memristor by considering different parameters from linear drift model of memristor. LTspice is used to collect the dataset of model with different frequency of operation, and effects of frequency on flux, current and charge are analysed. scripting languages python and its numpy, pandas, matplotlib and sklearn libraries are used to perform linear regression and gradient boosting regression. 97% and 99% of accuracy is obtained respectively at 0.1 learning rate. analyse will help in predicting the performance of memristor in advance with respect to input parameters.

articleTitle: 3D Object Recognition Framework
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Object recognition is one of the inherent characteristics which humans own since adolescence. In reality, it is astonishing to see that humans can recognize any object at a single glance. Machines however, find it difficult to recognise objects since the object appearance may have variation due to photometric effects, clutter, occlusions or rotation. But, all these variations are instantaneously handled by human brains. In spite of the fact that the objects may vary depending on point of view or any changes in size or scale, humans can smoothly identify the object. This task is yet a major problem for machines. Hence, there is a need to develop a model which can efficiently and effectively recognize 3D objects. This paper proposes a 3D object recognition framework in order to solve the problem faced by computer vision systems. In the proposed model, key points are extracted using Intrinsic Shape Signature (ISS). The geometric information surrounding these points is determined by using Fast Point Feature Histogram (FPFH) descriptor. The resulting feature matrix is the local feature of an object. Feature sets are formed by using Efficient Match Kernel (EMK) and these feature sets are used as weights in Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifier to classify the object in a scene to the category in a training set.

articleTitle: Adaptive DOA Estimation Using Subspace Method for Underwater Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In this paper, the incoming signal is processed from a given source by employing an array of hydrophones and estimating the signal parameters. This work is concerned with estimating and projecting the motion of the signal parameters like Direction of Arrivals (DOA) of multiple emitters using ESPRIT method in underwater scenario. The algorithm is employed in an adaptive manner as the targets that are considered are in continuous motion. For targets that move with constant accelerations, their motion is projected based on the time series. The robustness of this approach is validated with several numerical simulation results. This helps us to develop a system that will yield the most accurate results.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Low Power 6:3 Fast Counter based on Symmetric Stacking
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In modern VLSI Design, low power and high speed are the parameters of utmost importance. This brief presents an efficient implementation of a 6:3 fast counter, a technique of counting which employs bit stacks. Further, an innovative technique is used to form a bigger stack using combination of 2 small stacks. 6:3 counter is built using this technique which has no multiplexers and XOR gates in the critical path. Simulation results are used to verify the advantages of the proposed approach. Further, low power implementation using Switch Rail Charge Recovery Logic (SCRL), a variant of adiabatic logic is done. The 6:3 counter built using symmetric stacking is 21% faster than the traditional counter based on Full adder. Also, it is evident that SCRL achieves a power saving of nearly 79% when compared to the conventional CMOS logic. The overall power delay product of SCRL implementation is 0.161*10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-18</sup> which is a significant improvement over the traditional implementation.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Dual Band Microstrip Yagi-Uda Array
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In this paper an antenna structure that comprises a concept of Yagi-Uda array and Microstrip Patch Antenna is presented. A design of Yagi- Uda antenna of 4 element Omni directional is done in C-band and x band configurations using HFSS simulator at a central frequency of 5.8 GHz and 10.8 GHz respectively. To determine the effects that causes by elements to the antenna performance that will gives a larger gain this analysis has done. The gain can be increased by using a concept of Yagi-Uda antenna with application of array. The simulation result indicates the return loss is good in the operating bandwidth at frequency ranges of 4-8 GHz and 8-12 GHz coverage standard of C-band and X- band. The antenna is designed using the substrate called as FR-4 with 4.7 dielectric constant and 1.6 mm thickness and comparison and analysis of the results are studied.

articleTitle: Analysis of User Behavior Based on Tweets
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Microblogging today has turned into an exceptionally well known specialized communication tool among Internet users. A great many messages are seeming day by day in well-known sites that give administrations to microblogging, for example, Twitter, Tumblr, and Facebook. Sentiment analysis can be an extremely valuable viewpoint for the extraction of helpful data from text documents. The main idea for sentiment analysis is how people think for a particular online review i.e. product review, movie review etc. Sentiment analysis is the process where these reviews are classified as positive or negative. In our paper we are deciding polarity in seven different categories like Strongly Negative, Weakley Negative, Negative, Strongly Positive, Weakley Positive, Positive and Neutral. The machine learning algorithm is used in determining the polarity of the tweets.

articleTitle: Energy Efficient Routing in WSNs Based on Dynamic Cuckoo Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Implementation of Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) with energy efficient network routing has remained a persistent research issue over the years as, it is of prime importance to implement a sensor network with maximum lifetime. In this paper, we present a bio-inspired heuristic route optimization scheme named Dynamic Cuckoo search algorithm to find a sensor node with optimal fitness function corresponding to maximum residual energy to cover and route the data from a Point of Interest (PoI). Simulations show the effectiveness of our algorithm and confirm that our proposed scheme outperforms existent conventional technique such as, Ant Colony optimization.

articleTitle: Low Dose Cardiac CT Angiography(CTA)
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In spite of universal accord that X-radiation (CT) overpoweringly edges patients once used for applicable indications, problems square measure raised regarding the potential risk of cancer induction from CT owing to the exponentially exaggerated use of CT in medication. Keeping radiation dose as low as fairly achievable, in step with the diagnostic task, remains the foremost necessary strategy for decreasing this potential risk. In Medical Image process, the aspect impact of radiation the foremost difficult task of CT angiography, is to own wonderful temporal resolution so as to cut back motion artefacts caused by unsteady heart beat and a high spatial resolution to differentiate little coronary structures. However this can be not achieved in CT angiography, as quick scanning takes place and a few of the views could be skipped throughout acquisition so as to realize high temporal resolution. The quantity of pixels in a very reconstructed image is usually unrelated to the particular spatial resolution of the image, this results in poor spatial resolution. This discrepancy may end up in interpretation and inaccuracies throughout the designation. During this analysis work we have a tendency to propose Wright Huang- extremely strained back Projection (HYPR) formula as most promising dose reduction technique. The planned technique involves generation of composite image that exhibits higher spatial resolution created from underneath sampled, high temporal and poor spatial resolution time slices of CTA. Then a weight image is built that possess smart temporal characteristics. Multiplication of weight and composite image ends up in HYPR image. We have a tendency to measure the ensuing image quality of the developed formula through mean sq. error and modulation transfers operate. The CTA dataset were collected from native diagnostic centre yet as from on-line analysis community. Our experimental results have indicated that the strategy will cut back the quantity of projections by 50-75% whereas achieving comparable or higher image quality than the standard reconstructions. We have a tendency to additionally analyse the most impact and interaction impact of input factors over responses exploitation applied mathematics analysis by Mat lab software package.

articleTitle: Dynamic Performance and Analysis of an Asynchronous Motor Drive with the Interface of Z-Source Isolated Bi-directional DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This paper proposes a bi-directional dc-dc z-source converter. Z-source dc-dc converter has an impedance network which performs buck-boost operations. In this the input current is continuous and also the voltage stress across the switches is less. It can also boost the input voltage using reduced passive component with better reliability and decreased cost. Compared to the existing dc-dc converter circuits, they reduce in-rush and harmonic current. Therefore this paper aims at a soft switched quasi z-source converter. That the proposed converter has the better voltage profile with most reduction of voltage regulation. H-bridge dc-dc sources are preferably connected to the voltage sources and sometimes current sources. This is used to minimize the current stress as well as to improve the system efficiency. Z-source isolated bi-directional dc-dc converter boosts the dc voltage up to the 600 V, which is used to supply to the inverter. Inverter is being incorporated with space vector modulation technique for its driver circuit control. From this that the inverted output is supplied to the asynchronous motor drive to get the dynamic responses of the drive from its performance parameters like stator phasor current, torque and speed. Respective results are analyzed by using MATLAB software.

articleTitle: FPGA Based Efficient Feed forward FFT Architecture
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Feed forward FFT architectures provide an efficient method to compute FFT with a better hardware utilization, by making use of parallelism and pipelining concepts. Multipliers form an integral part of FFT architectures. Right choice of multiplier leads to improved area and speed. In this paper, we present a study on rotator allocation based Radix-2 feed forward FFT architectures with two different multipliers introduced into the architecture individually. The two architectures are designed considering 16 sample points with 4 inputs arriving at a time in parallel. The comparison of the architectures shows that the architecture with multiplier based on Modified Booth algorithm is more area efficient and has an improvement in speed. The synthesis is done on Virtex-6 FPGA, XC6VSX475T-l FF1156.

articleTitle: Generalized Synchronization of Two Different Fractional Order Chaotic System Using Nonlinear Control
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In recent years fractional order chaotic system have received a great deal of consideration from researchers of different domains. This paper deals with the investigation of synchronization aspects of two different chaotic systems using nonlinear control theory technique. Further, generalized proof in this regard has also been provided to validate the theoretical analysis, two different example systems i.e. FO Lorenz and FO Chen chaotic systems are considered. At the end numerical simulations are provided to show effectiveness of the desired results.

articleTitle: An IoT Based Railway Security System for Automated Manning at Level Crossings
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Railways is considered as one of the widely spread mode of transportation all over the globe. Nowadays there is an enormous increase in road and railway traffic. This rapid growth has given rise to more and more accidents at the level crossings. This is a serious concern for both railway and road traffic users. There are no easy ways for tackling this problem, but the main concern is regarding its feasibility for the fluctuating environmental conditions. In this paper, we are proposing an IoT based technique as an alternative and efficient solution for manned and unmanned level crossings. To implement this technology, we are fixing two Infrared Sensors at a pre-calculated distance to calculate the speed of train and time taken by the train to reach level crossings. With this data we are trying to automate closing and opening of gates at level crossings and to regulate road traffic users waiting time. This real time information is sent to database server with the help of Wi-Fi module through Internet of Things (IoT). With the help of GSM module, we send the intrusion detection information to the concerned train driver, station master and control room for efficient monitoring.

articleTitle: Design of secure SMART card reader and Wi-Fi interface for Point of Sale terminal
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The electronic point-of-sale (POS) terminal is one of the modern forms of monitoring device used at merchandising locations. For the functional processing of the POS terminal i.MX6 processor is used. POS terminal is embedded with the smart card reader for convenient and secure transactions. Typically smart card is a type of chip card that contains an embedded computer chip either a memory or microprocessor type that stores and transacts data. Smart card's data will be usually a value, information, or both, such as PIN codes of payphones, identity number of mobiles, credit or debit transaction information related to banking, monetary value for small purchases like amount currently stored, and subtract the amount for the goods or services being purchased, patient's history in health centers, which is stored and processed within the smart-card's chip. The transaction of card data is carried-out through a reader, which is a part of a computing system. Wi-Fi network is used to transfer data periodically to a global server. Systems developed with the smart card system has got several applications in areas like healthcare, banking, entertainment, and transportation, and in industrial products such as TV-satellite decoders and in GSM digital cellular phones.

articleTitle: An Electric Powered Smart Velocipede for Transport & Surveillance
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Day to day hike in oil prices and pollution underlines the requirement for the replacement of current conventional vehicles with electric power driven vehicles. This work is a small step towards a better and brighter future where the pavements will be replaced by electric vehicles. In remote areas for rescue operations unmanned vehicles are an essential requirement and hence prime factor is wireless communication. The speed, steer and direction of the velocipede is controlled by bluetooth communication. In this paper a bluetooth controlled electric powered smart velocipede is introduced and simulated in Proteus. The vehicle could be handy for mobility and surveillance in remote areas.

articleTitle: Energy Management Strategy in Standalone DC Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In the context of depletion of fossil fuels, the issue of integration of various renewable energy sources has raised which can be addressed with the help of microgrid. Standalone DC Microgrids and the energy management of renewable energy sources have gained importance while there are certain issues which need to be addressed. The proposed system implements the Energy Management System (EMS) for standalone DC Microgrid and provides bus voltage regulation and power sharing. The entire system is modelled and simulated using MATLAB/SIMULINK 2017a. The partial implementation and testing of EMS with PWM controller has been done.

articleTitle: A Novel Match-Line Sensing Technique for Low Power CAM array
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Content-addressable memory (CAM), also called associative memory, is a type of computer memory that is used in applications that require very high speed search operations to be performed. Large-capacity CAMs are advantageous in applications which need high-speed look-up tables. It is used extensively in CPU design, computer networking devices and cache controllers. CAM, due to its high power consumption and large silicon area, is used only when less costly methods of searching cannot be applied. Due to constant switching, the match-lines and MLSA happen to be the most power-hungry components of the CAM. This is a major drawback of CAM and power becomes a design main parameter that needs to be minimized. This paper presents a novel low power match-line sensing approach to reduce the power consumption in a CAM memory array. Using the proposed method, the power consumed in an example 3x4 CAM array is reduced greatly compared to conventional methods.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis on Big Data Tools: Apache Solr Search and Hibernate Search
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In the following paper, an in-depth comparison of Apache Solr Search and Hibernate Search is presented. In the modern-day scenario, a lot of software enterprises require high performance and efficient searches in SQL based databases which consist of billions of entities. Since SQL's `like' clause cannot provide these functionalities in the most efficient manner, several other libraries came into existence. Apache Lucene is one of the many common libraries used for the same in the software industry. It is a very powerful yet complex library with a wide variety of applications and advantages over conventional searches. Apache Solr Search and Hibernate Search are both implementations of Lucene with a variety of optimizations from the developers so as to facilitate its performance as per different requirements whilst making it user-friendly. In this paper, the search query execution times for both of the frameworks have been compared for several kinds of search methodologies on a test Big Data(110 Million Entries in MySQL) database. Upon comparison of the execution times, Solr Search was clearly performing better with Full-Text Searches, Fuzzy Searches, Wildcard Searches, etc. while Hibernate Search trumped when it came to Spatial Searches, Range Searches, etc. As both Solr and Hibernate Searches provide similar functionalities to some extent, software firms often struggle with picking a suitable one to best suit their needs. The following paper is directed towards helping such companies out by providing them with verified analysis and results on different types of searches, thereby helping them select the platform yielding most optimal results for them.

articleTitle: Spectral Models of Bigmoon: Experimental Results
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Spectral models of the moon are important for the lunar space studies and applications. This preliminary research and experimental work examines spectral studies of the lunar eclipse images during Super moon and studying the variation of spectrum in space domain and attempt to derive a spectral model of the eclipsed moon. The preliminary experimental investigation reveals that spectral properties of the moon are characterized and helps in deriving a spectral model of the moon during eclipse and compare it with the normal moon. From our spectral analysis and studies of lunar images during Bigmoon helps in deriving a spectral model of the moon using power spectral density (PSD) and FFT techniques. The preliminary studies during eclipse helped to derive moon spectral model in terms of power spectra. From the magnitude spectrum studies for is may be observed that, for the normal moon is about 110 Hz/dB whereas 170 Hz/dB for the blood moon and we can conclude that the big moon appears about 28% brighter than the normal moon.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of modified slotted ALOHA protocol for RFID readers
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: RFID (Radio Frequency IDentification) is a proven technology for authentication of objects. Sensors and radio frequency identification technologies are implemented in health care environment for efficient tracking of critical equipment. It has excellent features which makes it preferable over other identification techniques like barcode reader and camera based techniques. RFID techniques consists of a reader and a tag. Reader is typically a powerful device with ample memory and computational resources, and tag is basically an IC with a metallic coil. Collision due to simultaneous tag responses is one of the key issue in RFID system. Since tags share the same communication channel (air), the signals can be garbed and the reader may not be able to extract the original information of the signal. It results in bandwidth wastage, increased identification delays and inefficient tracking which can lead to authentication problems. To minimize collisions, RFID readers uses anti-collision protocols. The main existing anti-collision protocols are ALOHA based protocols which can be classified into ALOHA (Abrahmson‘s Logic Of Hiring Access) and Slotted ALOHA. This paper focuses on the comparison of the existing ALOHA based protocols in terms of time taken to read the tags, mathematical modelling of throughput, developing a modified slotted ALOHA protocol and the hardware implementation of all the protocols using ARDUINO- MEGA 2560 board, EM-18 RFID readers and passive tags.

articleTitle: Over Current and Over Voltage Protection and Working of LED Operation in D60 Using Enervista Ursetup Software
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
