In this paper, a comparative study between two maximum power point tracking algorithms for photovoltaic system is presented. A model free, deterministic perturbation based extremum seeking algorithm is compared with perturb and observe method, under varying conditions of solar irradiation, temperature and load. The performance analysis is carried out in terms of steady state characeristics and transient response, by simulations using MATLAB-Simulink platform. The results present the efficacy of extremum seeking algorithm over the conventional perturb and observe method for extracting maximum power.

articleTitle: An Efficient E-Health Monitoring with Smart Dispensing System for Remote Areas
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Medicines play a crucial role in maintaining health, to prevent illness, to manage chronic conditions and to cure diseases. An efficient E-health Monitoring with Smart Dispensing System for Remote Areas is a system designed to provide the basic medicines and diagnosis for the people during the emergencies. Medicines are essential need of survival during the emergency cases. Dispensing is one of the processes, where the system will dispense the required medicine based on the user's choice. The monitoring system will help in providing the basic diagnosis to the people. This paper provides an innovative idea of dispensing the basic medicines to the people round the clock and also to diagnose the basic parameters like heartbeat, body temperature and blood pressure by using the wearable sensors. The implementation of the system is done by using advanced microcontroller which controls all other subsystems such as global system for mobile communication (GSM), RFID Reader, medicine dispenser, heartbeat sensor, temperature sensor and blood pressure sensor. Moreover, this system would help in preventing the hours wasted by waiting in queues at clinics for small problems like cold and headache.

articleTitle: Online Monitoring of Transmission Line Parameters Using LabView
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In power system, the power flow in a transmission line is calculated based on the designed line impedance which is assumed to be constant. But, practically the line impedance changes due to the harmonics, frequency change and many more environmental factors. This change in the line impedance makes the power flow calculations wrong. There should be monitored mechanism to calculate the line impedance for accurate analysis of power flow which helps in improving the reliability and security of the power system. In this paper, the monitoring technique is developed using Fast Fourier transform which provides the fundamental frequency information for voltage and current from which the line impedance is calculated. The proposed method is tested on a scaled down laboratory model of 300km transmission line. The voltage and current signals are sampled using a simultaneous sampling DAQ. These sampled signals are given to the FFT algorithm which is developed in the LABVIEW software. From the obtained phasor values, the line parameters are calculated and compared with other measurement techniques and designed values. The change in line parameters values due to change in frequency is not observed by direct LCR measurement and indirect offline measurement and is possible through the proposed method.

articleTitle: Realization of Microstrip Patch Antenna for LTE Application Using Different Substrates
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Compact nature of the microstrip structure gives the flexibility for the design of antennas which takes less space, cost and provides good performance. The proposed paper presents the design of microstrip patch antenna for the application of Long Term Evolution(LTE)which operates at 2.4GHz. The structure is designed based on the mathematical relations between the microstrip parameters such as Length(L), Width(W), Height(h) with the Frequency, impedance, Gain, VSWR, and the Return Loss of the antenna. Two microstrip patch antennas are designed for the same operating frequency with different substrates such as FR4 Glass epoxy and RT Duroid with Dielectric constasnts (εr)4.4 and 2.2 respectively. The effect of dielectric substrate and other parameters on the performance of the microstrip patch antenna is discussed and analyzed with the obtained results. The antenna parameters are analyzed by varying the thickness of the substrate and by providing Inset Feed. The designed antenna with FR4 substrate gives a gain of 2.04dBi, VSWR≤ 1.7, S11 = -12dB and with RT Duroid gain is of 4.6 dBi, VSWR ≤ 1.9, S11 = -10dB. This shows the designed antenna is useful for LTE applications.

articleTitle: Stampede Monitoring and Alarm System using Viola-jones algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Now a day, people are facing many problems relating to the crowd control, security issues, medical emergencies, detecting and tracking of the pilgrims in the holy areas and a place where a large number of people takes place. Especially during pilgrimage, in political rallies the authority finds it difficult to manage the situation. To avoid this condition a pre-stamped alarm system is implemented, in order to recognize and to monitor the stampede. In pre-stampede alarm system a camera is used to monitor the stampede area continuously and also finds the high density of people by using image processing tool. The means of sending or receiving data with base station is done through global positioning system or through GSM. When a pre-stampede system is starts working then the people around the pre-stampede area can be detected by camera and it compares with the fixed threshold level, if very high density of people is detected then the alert message is send to the authorized person.

articleTitle: Assured Privacy and Authentication of Health Data in Cloud Using Cryptographic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In this modern era many health care centers and other individual care takers create a prolific path to share and store data. So there are many applications developed for sharing data which reduces healthcare cost, but use of public clouds for this purpose includes high risks since the data is shared among multiple users, security issues are more deep-rooted and data will be vulnerable to theft. Currently, cloud service providers have the full control over the key than the patients which makes patients to feel in harm's way. The technical terms like confidentiality, availability and integrity well defines the security of data, so it is very important for the health department to secure the data. The trusted concept used in this paper is asymmetric Elgamal algorithm from the number theory concept for the web based healthcare applications along with that keyword search engine to match a particular word with existing keywords over the encrypted data. For the protection of end to end security we use protocols to protect data among authorized users. Design of webpage helps the patient to upload the encrypted data to the cloud and the authorized user can only download the data if and only if the key is present with him, finally memory usage and encryption time is calculated. This system provides end to end security for sharing of health data between a patient and an authorized user.

articleTitle: An Innovative Smart Railway Platform Assist in Domestic Railway Stations
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Now-a-days India is moving in a smarter direction by promoting the smart cities and smart railway stations, in this aspect we have taken a small initiative by adding an innovation in domestic railway platform in the Indian railway structure. The motivation for this innovation is to address few problems faced by physically challenged people and senior nationals in crossing of foot over bridge between the two railway Platforms. To overcome this issue, a modified smart platform is proposed in this paper. The smart Platform is participated amidst the railway tracks in the side of the crossing point Platform. At the moment that there is no train arriving in the station, the smart Platform will be opened. The physically challenged individuals will use the smart Platform to cross between the Platforms. Proximity sensors are set on the two sides of track. If the train reaches one sensor the smart Platform will consequently close and enables the trains to o through the tracks and when the train leaves the second sensor the smart Platform will automatically open between the Platforms. The train approaching the railway stations will be proclaimed in a voice system and illustrated by LED signals. The proposed structure gives the best response for the movement of physically challenged individuals from one platform to another Platform without using foot over bridge.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Low-Power 16-bit Parallel-Prefix Adiabatic Adders
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Adders are the elementary components of all the general-purpose microprocessors and signal processing units which include filters, MAC, Arithmetic Logic Unit, ... The efficient design of an adder determines the overall performance efficiency of the system. Parallel Prefix Algorithm is one of the proficient way of implementing an adder. The increase in the number of portable devices has increased the need for low power design techniques. Adiabatic Logic is the one of the promising technique to recover and recycle the power back to the source. This work provides a comparison in terms of area, power and latency between Adiabatic Ripple-Carry adder (RCA), Kogge-Stone Adder (KSA) and Han-Carlson Adder (HCA) and their Static CMOS counterparts. CMOS 180 nm technology is used for schematic entry. Functional verification is performed using Cadence Virtuoso - Spectre Simulator. Analysis of the adders shows that Adiabatic KSA has the least latency, whereas Adiabatic HCA provides a good trade-off between latency and power dissipation.

articleTitle: Design Of Low Power Floating Gate Miller OTA
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In this work, a low power low voltage operational transconductance amplifier (OTA) is presented using a nonconventional technique. The proposed amplifier consists of floating gate input differential pair with pole splitting effect provided by a miller capacitor connected between the input and output of the amplifier. Different compensation techniques are tried, and results are compared. This work uses very low 0.4V power supply with a power consumption of 27.06μW. Simulation results are performed using LT Spice SOnm CMOS Technology. The parameter such as gain, unity gain bandwidth and power consumption are taken into consideration. The workability of the circuit has been verified and a Bi-Quad filter design is realized using the proposed OTA Circuit.

articleTitle: An Improved Agriculture Monitoring System Using Agri-App for Better Crop Production
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In agriculture-based countries, crop development is main source of economy generating fields and farmers depend on crop fields for survival. To yield better crop production, an agriculture monitoring system is developed to monitor and assess crop information for better yielding. We propose an agro-app based improved monitoring system for better crop production. This paper aim is to improve the crop production for better yield by developing the system with sensor stack such as soil moisture sensor and temperature sensor to sense moister and temperature of the soil in the crop fields, and water is supplied according to the sensor information, and with the help of RFID tag geo-fencing is provided to the crop fields from animals and unauthorized person's entry, if entry is there alert is given to the farmer by alarming. And also crop disease analysis is done by capturing crop leaves images with the help of camera. This processed information is uploaded to the app and appropriate suggestions are generated from the app, the corresponding information can be seen by farmer. The farmer can analyze the environmental conditions to achieve maximum crop productiveness, for the better productivity and to achieve remarkable energy, overall cost, and crop protection.

articleTitle: Time Efficient Design and FPGA Implementation of Distributed Canny Edge Detector Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Edge detection is one of the basic operations carried out in image processing and object identification. As it plays an important role in image processing which needs to be optimized, accurate and less latency architecture. This paper focuses on Edge detection using Adaptive threshold technique. The efficient Canny edge detector has been used in real time application. In this paper, the Gaussian filter is applied as preprocessing block to remove the high frequency edges. The Canny coefficients are approximated to suite the hardware requirements with less LUT's and further the adaptive threshold technique is applied to obtain the finer details of edges. The proposed method of edge computation using adaptive threshold reduces memory elements significantly, because it occupies less area, reduction in delay and increased efficiency without effecting detection performance. The proposed edge detection architecture is implemented using Xilinx system generator tool on Spartan6 ATLYS (XC6SLX45) board. It is observed that the proposed method is better in terms of time performance as compared to existing architectures.

articleTitle: Real Life Care: A Smart Method for Aquaculture
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Aquaculture termed in the manner that fish or crustacean farming deals with the breeding, rearing and production of water plants and organisms. Numerous real water parameters influence the yield of aquaculture result. This paper aims at the implementation of an automated aquaculture farm. The proposed system gathers the data such as the water pH, level, temperature and it execute suitable variations in the water habitat at appropriate times in the absence of human mediation. This system will inform the farmer as pH of water exceeds maximum threshold or if it reduces under the minimal threshold.

articleTitle: Density Based Traffic Control with Emergency Override
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The human population in cities is increasing day by day and therefore number of vehicles is increasing exponentially. Traffic control signals have been playing significant role in managing traffic flow in cities. But the conventional traffic control signals fails in time management. It allocates equal time slots to each road irrespective of the traffic density. This creates unnecessary waiting for drivers, which is not possible every time. Therefore, we propose density based traffic control system, which allocates different time slots to each road according to vehicle density. The vehicle density is measured in three zones low, medium and high. The traffic density in each lane is measured using IR sensors. Accordingly the traffic signal lights give the green light based on the vehicle density. This system also comes with RF signal override control in case of emergency vehicles such as fire brigade and ambulance. The RF transmitter and a GPS module are placed in the emergency vehicle. Whenever the override feature is activated, the green light is given in the desired lane for some time by blocking all the other lanes by giving them red light. So this is also a priority based system. This system, therefore, offers advantages over conventional traffic control system. This system can be readily implemented for places having high vehicular density. It can be extended for the dynamic traffic management of an entire city also.

articleTitle: Smart Fertilizer Dispensary System for Automated Drip irrigation
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This paper presents work on the design and development of prototype models for wireless smart fertilizer dispensary systems with the help of ZigBee and GSM technology. The field station prototype is developed with the help of ATMEGA 328 based embedded platforms, four solenoid valves to control three different fertilizers and water with their associated driver circuit, ZigBee and GSM module. A MATLAB based GUI platform is designed to interact with a field station wirelessly using 2.4 GHz ZigBee transceiver from the remote monitor unit. A GSM mobile can also be used as a wireless remote control to operate the solenoid valves as well as to receive various event notifications from the field. The system offers a duel wireless flexible mode to operate the valves for fertilizer delivery. To optimize the power level solar panel and DC to DC converters is used. The system can be operated automatic and manual mode. All the field event can be monitored in the base station for further statistical analysis. Intelligent algorithms also embedded to reduce the water losses and over watering. Overall the system provides cost-effective, power optimized and flexible fertilizer dispensary system integrated with drip irrigation system.

articleTitle: Feature based Fruit Quality Grading System using Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The conventional post-harvesting process of horticultural fruit and vegetables is exorbitant and highly subjective which susceptible to errors. This process is extremely unreliable in terms of accuracy, throughput, speed and cost. An automated fruit grading approach is desirable to reduce the manual efforts and increase the efficiency. In this paper, we are developing a computer vision based an image acquisition and classification system for fruit grading. This system is divided into three modules image pre-processing, image segmentation and Classifier. In the first phase, we are extracting the image features such as image quality, area, perimeter, mean, variance, color, intensity. Next Otsu algorithm works on automatic threshold calculation and image binarization part. In the second phase k-means clustering is used for image segmentation. In last phase the vectors of color, intensity, segments, and image quality feature were utilized for training of the support vector machine structure. The image k-means clustering approach is embedded with support vector machine classifier to improve the speed and accuracy of the classifier. As a result, the system will be able to classify the fruit into three different categories. The proposed algorithm is implemented with an example of tomato fruit grading. The experiments consider real tomato image dataset of 200 samples.75% of the total dataset is used for training and remaining 25% used for testing purpose. Training dataset is distinguished into three categories depending on the maturity of tomato.

articleTitle: Power Optimization Techniques and Physical Design Flow on Repeaters for High-Speed Processor Core in sub 14nm
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In present semiconductor industry, designing the IP cores with shrinking in the silicon area is becoming challenging day by day, on top of it power and speed (timing) are the major challenges which decides the profit of the core. So to design IP cores with good quality in short period of time we can automate the design. RLS (RTL to Layout Synthesis) is Synopsys automation tool used for core design. Here timing, power, area and quality are the major challenges faced in design flow because any small issue can render the whole chip useless which may lead to heave economic loss. Hence it is imperative that the whole design of the functional unit which in total forms a core be as optimized as possible and meeting all the specs. But there will be tradeoff between power, area and timing. To achieve a good quality core various design techniques are applied in synthesis flow and in ECO mode also. Such that design timing get converged and power, area optimization can be achieved. In this project work major focus is on designing the repeater FuBs (Functional unit Blocks) and detail explanation on timing convergence, power optimization and achieving good quality on the design block.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive survey on Electric Springs and it's Applications in Smart Grids
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Demand side management plays a vital role in the integration of the Renewable energy sources into the Smart grid. Smart grid must fulfill the overpoweringly increasing load demands. This can be achieved with the renewable energy sources and energy storage added into the smart periphery with new and intelligent control techniques. Electric Springs is the newest control paradigm confirming the load demand to trail the power generation. This paper explores the literature of modelling, control and applications of Electric Springs that leaves its scope for further deployment in power distribution systems.

articleTitle: Energy Efficient Protocol to Supervise Overground Pipelines using WSN
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) is a prominent field which is actively researched by many researchers. WSN is a network which contains the huge number of tiny wireless sensor nodes having ability of communication, signal processing, sensing the information from its domain and one of the important, transmitting the information to the sink node after performing some mathematical computations. It is widely used in different applications as directory control, ecology, military, health issues and miscellaneous parts of pipelines. Each node of the network has the different amount of energy and nodes lose their energy in receiving and transmitting information. Due to usability in remote areas, the energy of these sensor nodes can not be recharged again. So it is important to find out the way of saving energy of nodes in transmitting the sensed information. In pipelines, a WSN with non-rechargable sensor nodes is needed that is having the property of sensing and routing the information to sink. So that every abnormal activity can be reported to the sink. Since, it is a remote area so the data communication should be in efficient manner to increase the lifetime of WSN. In this paper, we consider an overground gas pipeline that is monitored underground, on the pipeline and around the pipeline. For this, we have designed an architecture of WSN to collect information about any abnormal activity using an energy efficient approach.

articleTitle: Bus Voltage Control of DC Microgrid using Sliding Mode Control
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The world is witnessing tremendous growth in the contribution of renewable energy sources (RES) to meet the power demand. Continuous development and decreasing costs of renewable energy technology and semiconductor devices can be considered as key players behind this. With power semiconductor devices supporting efficient power conversion, DC compatible systems have made their places in not only industrial but also in domestic environments. DC microgrids consisting of microsources, group of loads and their corresponding power electronic interface have proved themselves to be more efficient than their AC counter parts. In DC microgrids, keeping the bus voltage constant and providing an uninterrupted power to sensitive loads are a major concerns. Point of load converters which are strictly controlled when supplying a simple resistor make up a Constant Power Loads (CPL) and posses' negative incremental resistance characteristics makes the system vulnerable to instability. The Battery Energy Storage (BES) system with bidirectional DC- DC converter is usually assigned a duty to keep the power balance and bus voltage unchanged. A non linear Sliding Mode Control (SMC) is implemented to control this DC-DC converter and the performance of the same is evaluated using MATLAB simulation.

Author Keywords: Constant Power Loads (CPL) Solar photovoltaic system

articleTitle: Secured Transportation System To Enhance Child Safety
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Now a days, we see a lot of children along with their parents standing on the roads waiting for their respective school bus, in this aspect they needs to communicate from and to home and school daily. Secondly, in recent days, safer transportation of school children has become a serious issue as it is often observed that child is forgotten to exit and enter the respective stops. So this paper proposes the solution for this issue by developing a bus safety system which controls entry and exit of the student by sending SMS to the parents via tracking exact location of school bus. The system consists of RFID (Radio Frequency Identifier) card. To identify which student has entered or exited the bus, GSM (Global system for mobile communication) to send the notification, GPS for the exact location of the bus. Fire sensor, if any fire ignition and Panic switch if any emergency.

articleTitle: Simulation and Analysis of Dynamic Voltage Restorer
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In continuous process industries, it is essential to maintain the voltage at a specific level to ensure the smooth operation. In this paper Dynamic Voltage Restorer (DVR) method is analysed for maintaining the voltage profile. A 220V, 50Hz line is compensated with a DVR. Behavior of uncompensated line is simulated for analysis purpose and presented. Further the performance of the line is improved by compensating it with a DVR. Compensated line results are presented and compared with the results of uncompensated line. For obtaining simulation results, MATLAB Simulink v9.1 has been used. The result reveals that by using the DVR the voltage across the load is maintained at nominal value irrespective of faults and other abnormal conditions.

articleTitle: Demand Side Management of Energy Efficient Street Lighting System through CCMS
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This paper presents the Demand Side Management (DSM) conservation technique to improve overall energy efficiency of the street lighting system and also by using energy efficient appliances like Light Emitting Diodes (LED)s, Centralize Control Monitoring System (CCMS), Individual Lighting Device Control (ILDC) etc. Also leads to substantial savings in electricity consumption. In order to conduct DSM analysis, the street lighting system is simulated in DIALux evo 7.1 software and reveals the data to construct a designed system with an efficient manner. Moreover, the experimental results have been carried out in the field and shown that the power consumption can be saved up to 40-55%. In addition, the energy saving can be extended more up to 60-65% by adding Individual Lighting Device Control, Dimming control technology and voltage optimization. The main aim of this paper is to introduce new LED technology, save electrical energy consumption, reduce maximum demand and reduce CO2. Future more, monitoring using a web site-based application called CM DASHBOARD is embedded to continuous monitoring of the equipment's. The conclusion of this paper is to save electrical energy, reduce the maximum load demands and construct the efficient street lighting system by using DIALux evo software. This work carried out with the help of Energy Efficiency Service Limited (EESL) private limited.

articleTitle: IoT Enabled Ignition Interlock Device
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: An ignition interlock device(IID) analyzes the blood alcohol level in a driver's breath which is sampled before the ignition can be turned on for a vehicle. If the results of the BAC level breach the threshold to which the device is programmed (which varies depending on the country), the IID device prevents the ignition from turning on, by interrupting the signal from the ignition to the starter. This paper attempts to better the existing IID devices which can be of limited use, by incorporating Internet of Things application to the device, such that it's use can be extended to all vehicles in the future to prevent attempts at drunken driving. The IID device is designed to be better by incorporating features such as facial recognition, fatigue and pulse monitoring of the driver and real-time data logging of breach of threshold.

articleTitle: Prediction of Power of a Combine Gas and Steam Turbine Using Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In Combine cycle power plant gas and steam turbine are used to produce the electrical energy. Actually, the gas and steam turbine joined in combined cycle using energy gas and heat flow from one turbine to another turbine. Finding an efficient and accurate method of electrical power output based on parameters which are getting from full load power output i.e. hourly. To maintain the efficient operating conditions of the plant is performed with actual operating data from power plant control unit. The information collected over a six-year (2006-2011) whose data points corresponds to average hourly when the plant is working at full load, and factors are ambient temperature, atmospheric pressure, relative humidity, and vacuum. From these variables, the best subset of the data set is explored among all the subset and find the most successful method of machine learning regression for predicting full load electrical energy output. This can predict hourly but only when the plant working at full load electrical power. This paper presents a machine learning regression technique by using a feed forward neural network.

articleTitle: Tracking and Analysis of IRNSS and GPS Satellites by Using Satellite tool kit
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Independent regional Navigation Satellite System is the independent navigation and tracking system that has been developed by Indian Space Research Organization. This system will replace the global positioning satellite system which is being used for navigation and tracking purpose currently. This paper deals with the comparison of the available IRNSS and GPS satellites in space, the coverage area and the visibility of satellites with respect to receiver and the speed of the satellite motion and distance between the satellite and the receiver by using satellite tool kit. This study concludes that the coverage area of IRNSS satellite system is 1500 km around the Indian boundary region and it can provide uninterrupted service for twenty four/seven in all whether condition.

articleTitle: Design of GaAs MMIC 6-bit Digital Phase Shifter
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This paper presents the conventional method to design a 6-bit digital phase shifter. Phase shifters are consecrate in antenna beam directing circuit and in RF design to give a phase shift. In this phase shifting circuit, the delay element is introduced to produce a required phase shift. 6-bit Digital Phase shifter provides total 64 phase shift states in steps of 5.625°. Along with six-bit phase shifter, an absorptive type of SPDT switch is designed. Phase shifter and SPDT switch have been designed using 0.25µm GaAs MMIC (Monolithic Microwave Integrated Circuits) technology in Advanced Design System (ADS) software. SPDT switch has insertion loss less than 1.1dB and isolation better than 27dB.

articleTitle: Low Cost Wireless Data Acquisition for Renewable Energy Conversion Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In the current situation, sustainable power sources enhance green energy. Various detectors and sensors are attached to data loggers for acquiring respective physical conditions of renewable resources. Data loggers for renewable resources are very much expensive in present global market, and it is not economically feasible to purchase them for getting utilized in curriculum-based projects purpose. This paper mainly deals with the low-cost data acquisition system using Arduino, sensors, Node MCU and Wi-Fi module to log the data pertaining to the voltage and current parameters based on the requirement. In this work data acquisition of Photovoltaic system is considered as test case.

articleTitle: DC Link Voltage Regulation of a Battery Integrated Solar Photo Voltaic System
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: There is a vast potential for use of Solar Photo Voltaic (SPV) systems in industries because of the large roof top area available. Since the renewable sources produce power that are intermittent in nature, it has to be supported by the Battery Energy Storage System (BESS). This paper presents a battery integrated solar PV system for industrial applications. A prototype of 3kW has been simulated in MATLAB Simulation. A synchronous boost converter is utilized to interconnect the solar array to 500V DC bus. Another synchronous bi-directional boost converter is proposed for the interconnection of battery to the SPV system. The results obtained from simulation analysis show that the use of synchronous boost converter increases the efficiency of the system. The controller implemented ensures maximum power point tracking, DC link voltage regulation and proper power sharing between the sources.

articleTitle: An Automated Approach for Diagnosing Diabetic Retinopathy in Retinal Fundus Images
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Diabetes mellitus and its associated complications, including diabetic retinopathy (DR) have been identified as a growing global public health problem. Early treatment and constant monitoring of DR can prevent 90 percent of visual loss. Manual screening of fundus images by ophthalmologists is tedious and time consuming. Hence, a computer-aided diagnosis system can significantly act as an efficient solution for the time consuming detection process. The propounded algorithm includes various stages such as pre-processing, feature extraction and classification. In literature, different approaches for preprocessing such as dual guassian, second derivative of Guassian and Gabor filter, mathematical morphology, K-mean clustering algorithms etc. are employed. In the proposed algorithm, preprocessing was done using Adaptive Histogram Equalization (AHE) and image de-noising using non-local means (NLM) filter. NLM takes the means of all the neighbouring pixels and weightage is given by checking the similarity between these pixels to the target pixel. Laplacian edge detection, by identifying the zero crossings of the second derivatives of the image intensity was used in both the methods. In the feature extraction stage, features like HOG, area, perimeter, mean and standard deviation are extracted. Lastly, Support Vector Machines (SVM) algorithm, k-nearest neighbours (KNN) and Artificial Neural Network (ANN) was used for the categorization of the images to healthy and diseased. The comparison on the functioning of AHE and NLM validates that NLM outperforms AHE. Parameters like accuracy, error rate, specificity, and precision were used to analyze the working of the classifiers. SVM with 0.875 accuracy, 0.12 error rate, 0.75 specificity and 0.80 precision outperformed well when analogized to the other methods.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of DC-DC Buck Converter using Cadence Tool
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: With the evolution of technology, scope for power management chips are increased. Due to this there is a large need for DC - DC converter. In this proposed paper a buck converter is designed for 1.2 V which uses Pulse width Modulation (PWM) technique in voltage mode. The simulation is carried out using cadence tool with 180nm technology and hardware implementation is also done to compare the simulated results. The switches used are PMOSFET and NMOSFET for the proposed system design. A comparator and an op-amp with a large gain and good stability has been designed for fulfilling the closed loop requirements of the buck converter. The voltage of the input is varied from 3V to 8V and the converter is switched at 1MHz.

articleTitle: Vehicle Speed Control and Over-Speed Violation Alert Using IoT and Hall Effect Sensor
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In today's world road and transport has become an integral part of every human being. The present transport system has minimized the distances but it has on the other hand increased the life peril. The focal idea of this paper is very functional to implement as road safety measure. This paper proposes a novel system where it is able to automatically control the speed of the vehicle by detecting the speed signs labels from speed sign boards, which are laid on the road side and take necessary steps to take it to the knowledge of the driver by sending a caution notification. When the driver does not speed down even after the sign of caution, details of the vehicle are notified to the authorities (traffic officials) and the speed of the car is reduced to threshold speed limit as on the speed label. This paper proposes an innovative approach by using two wide scoped fields and relevant knowledge to its fullest. a real time image processing software MATLAB identifies speed sign label, ARDUINO UNO to send that data to cloud and GPRS module to send location of the vehicle. The sent data gets analysed by PHP in the cloud and necessary steps are executed according to the results of the analysis.

articleTitle: Improvising process scheduling using machine learning
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: CPU process scheduling is of utmost importance in order to reduce the idle time and improve efficiency of processes and processor. In this paper, we introduce process scheduling techniques and memory layout of processes. Two types of executions are considered - individual execution and parallel execution. Then, multiple attributes of processes are taken into consideration by the Machine Learning (ML) algorithms to predict their Turn-around-time (TaT). These are used to assign appropriate time slices in Linux scheduler. Our experiments could successfully reduce TaT by this approach.

articleTitle: Fall Detection System using Tri- Axial Accelerometer
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Falls are noticeably the major cause of injury and death among the elderly thereby disturbing their ability to routinely function due to the decline of their physical fitness. Fall detection is hence a major challenge in the healthcare for the aged and hence timely and dependable action after a fall is necessary to lessen the negative impact of falls. This system is also effective in other situations which include detecting the fall of a worker at a construction site or of a trekker who might fall from tripping on the surface of a hill top or a rocky terrain. The proposed fall detection sensor is a wearable device which includes hardware components like ESP8266- the microprocessor, MPU6050 sensor-tri axial accelerometer and gyroscope and a GPS NEO-6M module- location scanner. The axial values of the sensor are pushed onto a server which is created on the MQTT cloud. Using the login credentials set beforehand, we can access the values on MQTT client and get alerts as to when the fall has been detected as well as location of the fall. The device uses minimal hardware along with an algorithm which ensures less power requirements and easy to use features.

articleTitle: Privacy Management on Un-Regulated Privacy Settings in Social Media
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Online Social Networks (OSNs) are the hottest trend in the internet, allowing people to socialize and share information among themselves. The social networking platform especially Facebook presents the problem of non-restrictive change in the privacy policy associated with an object and the risks affecting the privacy of other users. Research communities have identified and discussed the problems that arises when a user changes the privacy of a particular post previously posted under `public' privacy settings into `only me' settings in Facebook. Any post allows other users to comment on it when it is in public mode. Changing the privacy settings to `only me', grants restricted access to the post where only the owner can access that post and its related comments, there by violating the privacy of other users who had commented on the said post. We propose a novel approach to tackle this problem. We introduce an additional option called `My Comments' through which a user can access his comments even after the post's owner changes the privacy of that post from `Public' to `only me'. This feature will provide the owner of the comment unprecedented access to all his comments/ likes for any post allowing him the freedom to delete, edit existing comments.

articleTitle: A 15GHz 6W GaAs HEMT RF Amplifier for 5G Communication
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: A cascaded three stage GaAs HEMT RF amplifier designed and simulated for the front end of transmitters in 5G mobile communication networks has been described in this paper. The amplifier produces an output power of 6W for 1mW input power at 15GHz with a gain of 32.38dB and low noise figure of 2.07dB. The 3dB bandwidth of the amplifier was 2.15GHz from 14.5 GHz to 16.65GHz. The Power Added efficiency (PAE) of the amplifier was 84.76% for Power output (P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">out</sub>) = 37.38dBm. The S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub>, S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">22</sub> and S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sub> of the amplifier were -25.11dB, -26.82dB and -46.93dB respectively. The entire power amplifier will fit into an FR4 epoxy PCB layout of area 128.5mm × 109mm with a standard substrate thickness of 1.6mm. A stage by stage description of the amplifier and its corresponding results have also been discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: Study of Suppressed Carrier Scattering Effects and Carrier Quantization in Tri-Gate FinFET for SoC Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In this paper, the carrier Quantization effects and carrier scattering has been described in accordance with the leading 22nm technology for the multiple gate device. Also, the various short channel effects and their impacts on the device parameters. The subthreshold swing and DIBL was found to be within the acceptable limits and thus the variation in the threshold voltage with respect to the drain voltage and its impact on the device on-state current has been studied. The device may also be used for ultra-low power, high performance and high-density System on Chip (SoC) Applications and will be an ideal option when it's come to improved electrostatic control as compared to the existing technology as Steep Retrograded Doping Profile has been used in the device. The device was simulated using the Sentaurus TCAD and the mathematical operations have been out using MATLAB and Origin Pro.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Security Using RSA Parallelization Process
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Key exchange for cryptographic system is always a challenge. A private key algorithm is used to encipher and decipher the message, but after the symmetric key encrypts the message the digital envelope concept is used where the public key method or symmetric key algorithms are used to send the private key to the other party. A significant amount of research has focused on methods to improve the efficiency of cryptographic algorithms. Public key based cryptographic algorithms are usually considered as slower than their corresponding symmetric key based algorithms due to their root in modular arithmetic. So for encrypting the large message, symmetric key algorithms are used whereas for the relatively smaller key, asymmetric key algorithm is used. Here we are implementing this digital envelope system using asymmetric key algorithm. The goal is to improve the system by implementing the algorithm with parallelization using OpenMP on the GCC infrastructure.

articleTitle: A CNN based framework for Translation Invariant Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The contribution of this paper is to classify the images with transformation present in it. Transformations in the images are translation, rotation, scale and noise. The accuracy of classification decreases because of translations in the images. The proposed framework uses Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for classification of transformed images. It consists of two convolutional neural networks, first CNN1, it is the standard CNN trained by images formed by data augmentation approach. Then its performance is tested for dataset of transformed images. The second one CNN2 is trained on only translated images. In the first stage, the images are classified using CNN1. And in the second stage, images misclassified by CNN1 are fed to CNN2 for further classification. The proposed framework is evaluated on hand written digits dataset- MNIST and alphabets dataset by NIST. The result shows that framework proposed outperforms single CNN.

articleTitle: Neo Magnet MEMS Electromagnetic Vibration Energy Harvester for Wireless Sensor Nodes
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Micro-electro mechanical system (MEMS) based on electromagnetic vibration energy harvesters (EM-VEHs) are very ravishing devices in the field of digital world. The main ambition of development of the EM- VEHs is to transformation of circulatory energy in to desired electrical energy. It generates energy through the mechanical vibrations and provides power in to wireless sensor nodes (WSNs) for the imminent internet of things (IOTs). An EM-VEH produces energy and power because of the corresponding motion of the silicon spring between two NdFeB magnets. The electromagnetic energy harvester includes a silicon spring, two miniature NdFeB magnets (one is tuning magnet and other is transducing magnet) and a planner copper micro-coil. In this work the MEMS electromagnetic vibrational energy harvester has been modeled, simulated and it is concluded that a designed structure is able to generate efficient energy density and mechanical stress.

articleTitle: Design of Ultralow-Voltage High Speed Flash ADC in 45nm CMOS Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Analog to Digital Converters has an indispensable part in todays digitized world as they are suitable for a large range of applications. Flash ADC is the fastest ADC available, but it's power consumption is very large. This paper aims at developing an ultralow-voltage design policy for high speed medium resolution flash ADCs to improve the energy efficiency. The power consumption of a digital system can be minimized by reducing the voltage supply, but only with the hike in the delay time. Here a voltage boosting based comparator with forward body biasing technique is used to develop a flash ADC operating at ultralow-voltage(ULV) area using 45nm CMOS technology. This method reduces the power consumption by keeping the delay time almost constant as the supply voltage reduced. Body-bias calibration technique is used for offset compensation. Here, as a prototype a 5-bit flash ADC operating at 0.4V is developed in Cadence Virtuoso 45nm technology. The power and delay analysis of this proposed comparator shows a reduction in power with a constant delay time when the supply voltage is reduced. The power-delay(PD) product of this comparator is lesser than the conventional ones. The Figure-of-Merit Delay(FD) product of the flash ADC also shows a fair reduction of 0.54 p J n S/c-s.

articleTitle: Multilevel Inverter based PV-STATCOM
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The solar farm inverter is found unutilized in the night time. It can be acted as a STATCOM in the night time. It is called PV-STATCOM. A Multilevel inverter based PV-STATCOM is presented in this paper for reactive power flow control to regulate bus voltage and hence increase grid power transmission limits. Five level cascaded H-bridge multilevel inverter is demonstrated as PV-STATCOM. It reduces harmonics and thereby filter requirement can be minimized. MATLAB Simulation results show reduced THD significantly.

articleTitle: Detection and classification of vehicles from heterogeneous traffic video data collected using a probe vehicle
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: On typical roads in India where traffic are heterogeneous, road planning and management become crucial. Vehicle detection and classification is useful for traffic survey, planning, signal time optimization, and surveillance. A vehicle with a video camera placed at the top can be used for collecting video of the traffic for a two lane undivided road. The camera is placed at an angle of approximately 45 degrees. Both audio and video are used for detection and classification. The data collected is later processed for detecting and categorizing vehicles in the traffic into seven categories namely, one vehicle, more than one vehicle, no vehicle, two wheeler, three wheeler, cars and heavy motor vehicle. The presence of vehicle is identified by analyzing the short time energy of the audio peaks and the process of adaptive background subtraction. Selection of detected vehicles is carried out using Speeded up Robust Features (SURF) matching algorithm. Histogram Oriented Gradient (HOG) features of selected vehicles is extracted and classification is performed in two stages, using Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifier.

articleTitle: Communication Assisted Coordinated Protection Scheme for DC Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Increase in energy demand and environmental concern has led to the development of renewable energy based power generation. DC microgrid concept is more viable since it has very minimal transmission losses due to its small and localized structure. It requires a reliable protection scheme to provide continuous supply to consumers and to avoid unnecessary disconnection of any healthy part of the network. In this work, coordinated overcurrent protection scheme is proposed to detect and isolate DC faults. This protection scheme coordinates the relays to ensure correct selection of primary/backup relays to clear the fault. Intelligent Electronic Devices (IEDs) which provides efficient communication helps to send the status signals between each other and warning signals to the control centre during protection failure. A fast acting high performance relay mechanism is implemented to trip the DC circuit breaker in case of faults. The proposed protection technique was tested and validated in a 3 bus DC microgrid system with ring and radial configuration.

articleTitle: Three-Phase Grid Connected SPV Inverter with Flexible Control of DC Link Voltage
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Growing concerns on climatic changes and rapid depletion of fossil fuels results in immediate action to accelerate the clean energy generation using renewable energy resources. Alternative input from solar energy for daily needs is one such platform which has immense potential and is universally accessible with least environmental effects. The proposed system deals with a solar powered source connected to utility with a grid interfaced inverter using adaptive DC link technology which reduces the overall power loss in the whole system. This methodology stands over the constant DC link technology. This project operates with a three-phase grid-coupled solar photovoltaic (SPV) system which includes a two-stage operation. The first stage deals with a boost converter which accomplishes the maximum power point tracking (MPPT) using Incremental Conductance (InC) technique which is more easier and accurate. The output of the boost then feeds the DC link capacitor which is made adaptable to grid voltage variations. The second stage consists of a voltage source converter (VSC) which enact as a PV inverter and delivers the power to the grid via boost converter. The proposed strategy was designed for a 20 kW SPV system and was simulated in MATLAB Simulink 2017b.

articleTitle: Short-Term Load Forecasting with Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Load forecast performs a vital function in scheduling and operation in power system which makes grid smarter. The superiority of forecast of the short-term load has a major influence on the financial functioning of the power system as numerous assessments related to these predictions have important financial penalties. The generalized feedforward network is proposed in this paper with backpropagation algorithm for short-term load forecasting. Inputs to the Artificial Neural Network (ANN) model week code, hour of the day and temperature and output of the ANN model is predicted load. Load during weekdays and weekends are different. So, far better forecasting, week codes are used. The performance of the model is evaluated by different types of performance indices.

articleTitle: Structured Compressed Sensing Matrices for Causality Detection
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Compressed sensing enables sparse signals to be stored and transmitted in a linearly compressed fashion and finds applications in magnetic resonance imaging, photography, transmission electron microscopy etc. Linear compression is achieved by matrix multiplication of the input sparse signals with a random sensing matrix (for e.g., independent Gaussian entries) and recovery is enabled by nonlinear optimization techniques. However, causal relationships between input signals are no longer preserved by such a compression. In this work, we design structured sensing matrices having Toeplitz and Circulant structure that preserve causality (as measured by Granger causality index) between sparse autoregressive coupled input signals in the compressed domain. A potential application of causality detection in the compressed domain is in neural signal processing.

articleTitle: Analysis, Physical Design and Power Optimization of Design Block at Lower Technology Node
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The VLSI trend is getting complex day by day, especially the complexity of IC technology. It is very important to have better design approach and power optimization methods with constraint on timing closure and physical verification. The IC's designed today are complex and hence require a good Physical Design optimization and strategies. The methodology used in this paper is top down approach. In this paper, different floorplanning of preplaced cells in the design are used as an approach to analyze in terms of timing, area, leakage power and cell densities which is named as Run1, Run2 and Run3. The various optimizations are approached in each stages of physical design specially to reduce the leakage power. Based on the analysis of utilization factor, cell density, QoR and leakage power report generated before and after optimization, finally conclude that Run1 floorplanning is best among Run2 and Run3, with 13.33% improvement in leakage power, 0.417% improvements in area and cell density is better which avoid congestion while routing.

articleTitle: EMI shielding for DSRC Electronic Toll Collection using grid based Carbon fiber /epoxy composites
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Dedicated short range communication based electronic toll collection are gaining popularity due to their advantages like spatial and timely distribution of traffic., cashless, server based toll collection, safety regulations, saving of time, fuel and so on. They have been installed in many developed countries like Korea, Japan and are now being installed in India also. DSRC-ETC is based on the backbone of wireless communication network and thus inherits its demerits like signal interference called as Electro Magnetic Interference (EMI) which can cause loss in terms of wrong interpretation of the user's data leading to false payments. In order to remove this, a microwave absorber design has been proposed in this work, which can be easily integrated to the pillars and sidewalls of the toll system. The absorber is based on the filler incorporated polymer composites utilizing grid for frequency selection. Carbon fiber/ epoxy polymer composite being light weight, temperature resistant, chemical resistant, structurally strong fits the requirement of the above application. The grid is based on carbon fibers, thus can be easily incorporated to the existing layers. The absorber is designed for typical ETC specifications that are -11 dB absorption at around center frequency of 5.8 GHz. Thus using this absorber, the ETC system can be made more reliable and user friendly.

articleTitle: Detection of Abdominal and Mediastinal LYMPH Nodes Using CT Images
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Lymph nodes are small structures that contain immune cells which help to carry the unwanted substances to be removed and also fight against infections. The condition of lymph nodes in cancer staging is very important, which decides the treatment to be used, and also determines the prognosis. Computed Tomography (CT) imaging modality is most commonly used in clinical routine for lymph node assessment. Due to the low contrast of surrounding structures in CT, it is difficult to segment the lymph nodes manually. Thus Lymph node segmentation is an important yet challenging problem in medical image analysis due to its varying size, shapes, and similar surrounding structures. In this paper, our aim is to automatically segment Lymph nodes in abdominal and mediastinal CT images. To get clear visibility, firstly the CT image was pre-processed using TopHat Filter to enhance the contrast of the image and then the lymph nodes was segmented automatically using Histogram Thresholding, K means Clustering and Region growing The presented method helps physicians for proper detection of lymph nodes for diagnosis of cancer.

articleTitle: Simulation and Feasible Analysis of System Standalone PV-Wind Hybrid System for Rural Electrification
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Ever increasing demand of electricity, geographically dispersed locations of villages, population growth, fast depletion of fossil fuels and global environmental issues are some of major challenges to satisfy the electricity need of all the society in a country. Current research contributions and day to day experiences news show used of alternative energy sources either in standalone or grid integrated form are solving the problem. In the country Ethiopia, there are many rural villages geographically located far from the main grid that is a challenge to address the electricity need from the main electricity grid due to economic, operation, safety and maintenance problems. The techno-economic simulation and feasible analysis of system standalone hybrid photovoltaic-wind turbine generation system for a rural village located in Adama and Robe, Oromia Region, Ethiopia, is successfully done in this research. The feasible analysis, cost of energy, optimization cost of the components and the electricity produce by the system is done by HOMER software.
